name: Devon Ke Dev...Mahadev
description: He is the supreme being and the destroyer of evil. Witness lord Shiva's story, his avatars, and a union that shaped the universe - his marriage to Parvati.

videos.title: Daksh Punishes Sati
videos.overview: Sati, who is the daughter of Prajapati Daksh, finds a rudraksh while drawing water from river along with her sisters. Prajapati Daksh, an opposer of Lord Shiv, dares to place Vishnu's incomplete idol in the temple. Prajapati Daksh performs Narayani Yagna to please Lord Vishnu as the statue was not entering the temple. Sati loses her way while collecting Parijat flowers in the forest. Sati gets visions of the solution for the statue enterting the temple in Rishi Dadhichi's ashram, whom she meets while finding her way back home. Accordingly, Sati places Shiv's idol in the incomplete Vishnu's statue and the statue enters the temple. Sati becomes emotional when she sees Lord Shiv for the first time.

videos.title: Sati’s punishment
videos.overview: When Shiva reveals himself in all his glory, Prajapati Daksh mocks him and claims he is superior. Shiva vows to destroy his arrogance. Daksh turns on Sati and blames her for the dishonour Shiva caused him. He asks her to choose between obedience to her father and her devotion to Shiva.

videos.title: Sati vows to keep her word
videos.overview: After announcing punishment for Sati, Prajapati Daksh decides to punish the sculptor who made the shivaling. He is unmoved even as his wife Prasuti pleads in Sati’s favour. Sati’s sisters are concerned that she may not be able to fulfil the conditions of her punishment.

videos.title: Sati's wish
videos.overview: Sati has to travel far to gather one lakh lotuses and write Vishnu’s name on them as part of her punishment. Meanwhile, the sculptors gather to beg Daksh’s forgiveness but he expels all of them from his kingdom. Saddened, they turn to leave, when Maharishi Dadichi arrives in the royal court.

videos.title: Daksh expels the sculptors
videos.overview: Maharishi Dadhichi asks Prajapati Daksh not to be so cruel towards the sculptors. But Daksh asks him not to interfere in a king’s decisions. At this point, an exhausted Sati returns to the palace and faints. Is Prajapati Daksh moved by his daughter’s condition?

videos.title: Sati is exhausted
videos.overview: Sati’s sister Khyati pleads with Saptarishi Bhrigu to stop her father from punishing Sati further. Prasuti also tries to make Daksh change his mind. But the Prajapati vows revenge on Shiva for using Sati to humiliate him. Meanwhile, Sati has a vision that leaves her mesmerised.

videos.title: Shiva's presence attracts Sati's attention
videos.overview: Seeing Shiva's aura,Sati wakes up from a dream clueless about the hidden significance of it. A perplexed Sati shares about her dream with Aaditi unable to hide her curiosity. As Sati describes about seeing a faint picture of an Ardhanarishvara, Aaditi calms her down. On the other hand, King Daksh hides his emotions for his daughter behind his traits of being a Prajapati. While in search of lotuses, Sati meets the sculptor community and fails to avert the strong presence of Shiva.

videos.title: Shiva reveals himself again
videos.overview: Narad Muni arrives in the court of Prajapati Daksh, just as he announces that his literature will completely ignore Shiva. Narad Muni asks Sati about including Shiva in her father’s Vishnu sculpture. Sati says it was a mistake. Narad then leaves for Kailash, where Shiva is in deep meditation.

videos.title: Narad Muni comes to Daksh’s court
videos.overview: Narad conveys the news from Daksh’s court to Shiva. Shiva is aware of Narad’s plan and says he cannot be tied down by Grihastha. Narad leaves, telling Nandi that Sati will change all that. Sati, meanwhile, is still troubled by the visions of Ardhanarishwara and decides to forego her sleep.

videos.title: Shiva's explanation
videos.overview: Sati is trapped in a forest during a storm. Thoughts of Shiva continue to trouble her. Agitated, she demands that Shiva should stop occupying her thoughts and declares that she will not let him conquer her or her father. She returns to the palace and vows to finish her task.

videos.title: Shiva occupies Sati’s thoughts
videos.overview: Sati stays at her task and everyone is concerned as her condition deteriorates. She refuses to give up, and Prajapati Daksh boasts that his daughter will always uphold his principles. When Sati completes her task, Daksh gets a terrible shock. It is not Vishnu’s name that is written on the flowers.

videos.title: Daksh gets a terrible shock
videos.overview: Sati begs her father’s forgiveness for Shiva’s name on the lotuses and asks him to give her a harsher punishment. But he forgives her and asks her to take over the arrangements of the spring festival. Then, Nandi appears and worships Sati. What will happen if Prajapati Daksh sees him?

videos.title: Daksh forgives Sati
videos.overview: Daksh is angry when he sees Nandi worshipping Sati. She, too, is surprised to learn that Nandi is Lord Shiva's vehicle. In Kailash, Nandi describes Devi Sati to Shiva. He tells Nandi about his Vairagya and that the Grihastha’s life is not for him.

videos.title: Nandi tells Shiva about Sati
videos.overview: Sati weeps before her father and wonders why Nandi and Shiva are pursuing her. Daksh tells her she must never fear anything, because she is the daughter of the all-powerful Prajapati. He decides to show her how even the five elements obey him.

videos.title: Daksh flaunts his powers
videos.overview: Daksh convinces Sati that Shiva and his followers have been using her to try and get to the Prajapati, because he is all-powerful. Meanwhile in Kailash, Kan and Pret criticise Nandi for having brought the lotuses with Shiva’s name on them. Then, Sati finds a lotus in the palace garden.

videos.title: Sati is convinced
videos.overview: Narad Muni reports to Shiva about the events in Prajapati Daksh’s kingdom. Daksh is planning a gathering of the Mahasabha and wants Chandrama to be present. Chandrama’s father Rishi Atri agrees that he should go. What role will Chandrama play in the union of Shiva and Sati?

videos.title: Daksh summons Chandrama
videos.overview: Daksh announces his desire to destroy Shiva. In Kailash, Nandi goes running to tell Shiva that the sculptor community, descendants of Vishwakarma, have been thrown out by Daksh. Shiva gives them shelter. The sculptors thank Shiva but ask if he would protect Sati, too.

videos.title: Shiva shelters the sculptors
videos.overview: Daksh punishes the sculptor and his family. Laxmi is upset with Daksh for the punishment he has given Sati. Sati's sister expresses her concern about Sati fulfilling her promise.

videos.title: Daksh invites Shiva
videos.overview: Daksh announces his decision to invite Shiva to his Mahayagna. In Kailash, Nandi is distressed that every spring season, Shiva retires to the cremation grounds and goes into the ‘samadhi’ state. Narad Muni then explains to him why Shiva does what he does.

videos.title: Shiva is angry
videos.overview: Narad Muni tells Nandi about Shakti’s connection to Shiva’s Samadhi state. Nandi wants to know if they will be reunited and Narad Muni assures him it will all be revealed in time. But Shiva fumes when Nandi asks him about Sati.

videos.title: Attempts to bring Shiva to earth
videos.overview: Narad Muni decides that it’s time for Shiva and Sati to meet. He creates a situation by singing so badly that a group of singers who are travelling to the Spring Festival lose consciousness. Narad then calls Shiva to come and save them. Will Shiva oblige?

videos.title: The spell of Mahadev’s music
videos.overview: Mahadev arrives on earth and sings a raga that revives the group of singers. Sati, who has gone to fetch water for the yagna, also hears the song and begins to dance. When Mahadev sees her stand before him, he vanishes. Narad Muni says his singing was for the betterment of the universe.

videos.title: Is Sati in love?
videos.overview: When Sati returns to the palace, the singers speak about the magic of Mahadev’s music. Sati confesses that it has had a great effect on her. Meanwhile, dancer Madanike is invited for the Vasant Utsav. She takes one look at Sati and makes a surprising deduction.

videos.title: Mahadev is invited to the yagna
videos.overview: Madanike insists that Sati has fallen in love, which Sati denies. Meanwhile, Rishi Dadhichi reaches Kailash and extends an invitation for Daksh’s yagna. Mahadev turns him down, saying he has no need for the ways of Mahamandals. Will the rishis be able to change his mind?

videos.title: Shukracharya is displeased
videos.overview: Mahadev agrees to go to the Mahamandal and tells the rishis he will be entirely responsible for its outcome. Angered that Mahadev is attending the yagna, Shukracharya vows to take on the deities. Narad Muni asks Mahadev not to go to Daksh’s court. But Mahadev has an answer for him.

videos.title: The Vasant Utsav begins
videos.overview: Placing his faith in Vishnu, Daksh assures the gods that he will protect them from Shukracharya’s army of asuras. Daksh asks Chandrama to ensure that the Vasant Utsav goes off well. In Kailash, Mahadev is again displeased with Nandi for talking about Sati.

videos.title: Madanike warns Sati
videos.overview: The Asuras decide to attack the gods if the Mahamandal goes against them. During the Vasant Utsav, Sati sings the same melody she heard Mahadev sing in the forest. Madanike learns about Sati’s feelings and warns her of the consequences.

videos.title: Sati won't act on her feelings
videos.overview: Madanike tells Sati that her love for Mahadev will be disastrous. Sati assures her that she knows the enmity between her father and Mahadev and will not do anything to make it worse. Meanwhile, Shilaad wants to take Nandi with him and Mahadev agrees, but Nandi does not want to leave Mahadev.

videos.title: Madanike is a Shiva bhakt
videos.overview: Nandi leaves Mahadev against his will. Shilaad comes back to Mahadev to tell him of Nandi’s condition. In Daksh’s palace, Sati is surprised to see Madanike worshipping a Shivaling. Madanike praises Mahadev’s virtues and speaks of her worries for Sati, who is caught between Daksh and Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev brings Nandi back
videos.overview: Mahadev makes Nandi special by ensuring that devotees will henceforth whisper their prayers in his ears and he will convey them to Mahadev. In Daksh’s palace, while Revati complains to her mother about being unhappy in her marriage to Chandrama, Sati sets out to go with Madanike to fetch colours.

videos.title: Sati and Madanike are separated
videos.overview: Madanike sees a bad omen and doesn’t want to take Sati with her to Rangraj. When they are alone, Sati again tells her that she has no place for Shiva in her heart. But a storm separates them while they are walking through the forest. Prasuti then sends out a search party for Sati.

videos.title: Shiva saves Sati in the storm
videos.overview: At the time when two seasons meet, the demon Vrittasura unleashes a terrible storm and Sati, who is separated from Madanike, is caught in it. That is when Shiva himself comes to protect Sati from Vrittasura. Rishi Dadhichi and the sculptors also witness the magnificent power of Mahadev.

videos.title: Sati has a change of heart
videos.overview: While Shiva is deep in trance, he is troubled by thoughts of Sati. She too is lost in Mahadev’s thoughts. Sati looks forward to the Mahamandal, longing to see Mahadev. Meanwhile, Indra tells Daksh that Shukracharya and his army is heading for the Mahamandal.

videos.title: Mahadev’s charisma sweeps off Sati’s heart
videos.overview: Smeared with ash, draped in animal hide, sitting atop a rock in the shamshan and drinking bhang (Mahadev’s Prasad), Mahadev is absorbed in his meditation amongst the Aghori ascetics. Narad Muni instigates Nandi to question Mahadev about bringing Devi Sati to Kailash. Withdrawn from the complexities of life, Mahadev smirks at Nandi’s question thinking about Sati, leaving behind the materialistic life for Kailash. On the other hand, Sati falls for Mahadev and confesses her love before Madanike.

videos.title: Sati decides to meet Mahadev
videos.overview: Fearing the results of her love for Mahadev, Madanike scolds Sati. Sati says she cannot help her feelings for Shiva. Although worried, Madanike agrees to stand by her side. Rishi Dadhichi prepares a special place for Mahadev in the Mahamandal. Restless to meet Shiva again, Sati heads for Kailash.

videos.title: Shiva rejects Sati
videos.overview: Shiva is angry when he sees Sati in Kailash and forces her to return. Sati goes back saddened that he has refused her love. Meanwhile, Shukracharya believes that Shiva is on the side of the gods since he is going to the Mahamandal and he prepares his army for war.

videos.title: Mahadev arrives for the Mahamandal meeting
videos.overview: Undeterred by Mahadev's rejection, Sati ascertains Madanike about bringing the Mahayogi out of his Vairagya. Preparing for Shaalimar and Tulsi's marriage, enamoured by Mahadev's love, Sati sees Shivaling in place of Shaalimar. Shukracharya questions Prajapati Daksh about inviting Lord Shiva in the Mahamandal. True to his words given to Maharishi Dadhichi, Mahadev embarks his presense in the Mahamandal meeting. But, as soon he advances towards his seat, Daksh gets his seat demolished.

videos.title: Daksh humiliates Mahadev
videos.overview: As Mahadev approaches his seat, Daksh has it pulled away and destroyed. He continues to insult Shiva. He declares that Shiva’s Vairagya is against the principles of his reign. He then unleashes a terrible curse on Mahadev. It angers Shukracharya, who declares vengeance for the insult to Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev reiterates his feelings
videos.overview: Mahadev is unaffected by Daksh’s curse that no one in his kingdom will worship him. Daksh sends written instructions to Sati and leaves for Brahma Lok. Sati is torn between her devotion for Mahadev and her loyalty to her parents. Later, Madanike asks her a question that leaves her speechless.

videos.title: Sati is torn
videos.overview: Just as Sati prepares to open her heart to her father, she is shocked by his letter, in which he threatens to go to any length to keep Mahadev out of her life. In Kailash, Narad Muni asks Mahadev why he does not accept Sati, with whom he has been united since the beginning of time. What is Mahadev’s answer?

videos.title: Prasuti's advice
videos.overview: Deeply upset, Sati tries to understand her mother’s feelings about her devotion to Mahadev. In Brahma Lok, Brahma tells his son Daksh that the union between Shiva and Sati has already been decided. But an arrogant Daksh vows to change that destiny with his powers.

videos.title: Sati wants answers
videos.overview: Sati’s love for Mahadev keeps growing. She decides to seek out Rishi Dadhichi, who led her to Mahadev in the first place, and ask him to explain to her what is happening in her life. The Rishi tells her the moment for her to accept her destiny has come. The Rudraksha she first found holds the key.

videos.title: Sati finds her answers
videos.overview: Rishi Dadhichi asks Sati to touch the Shivaling which will end all the conflict in her mind. She obeys and finds that all her doubts and questions are answered. Brahma goes to Mahadev and asks him not to punish Sati for Daksh’s mistakes.

videos.title: Mahadev and Sati dance together
videos.overview: Prasuti scolds Madanike for encouraging Sati’s devotion to Mahadev. Sati decides to dance until Mahadev joins her. They dance in union, before he disappears. When Daksh arrives on the scene, Sati is still dancing for Mahadev. Sati later faints.

videos.title: Sati becomes unconscious
videos.overview: Sati faints on an image of Shiva drawn with colours. Daksh is furious and blames Madanike for everything and decides to punish him. In Kailash, Narad Muni continues with his efforts to make Mahadev accept Sati. Meanwhile, Rishi Kashyap makes a terrible prediction.

videos.title: Sati enters the Yoga Nidra state
videos.overview: Rishi Kashyap informs Daksh that Sati has entered the Yoga Nidra state, after she and Mahadev danced together. He says she can only be awakened by Mahadev’s touch. Daksh refuses the solution and announces that he will give half his kingdom and powers to anyone who can awaken Sati.

videos.title: Sati’s condition gets worse
videos.overview: Rishi Dadhichi and Kashyap find Mahadev in Yoga Nidra Samadhi. Nandi warns of trouble if they attempt to wake him. The Rishis are confused about what to do with Mahadev. Meanwhile, Daksh summons the Navagrahas, the nine planets, to awaken Sati; will they be successful?

videos.title: Daksh decides to revive Sati
videos.overview: Sati begins to show signs of slipping into Chir Yoga Nidra, from which she can never wake up. An arrogant Daksh believes he can revive Sati and begins to summon all his powers. Meanwhile, Mahadev emerges from his Samadhi and comes to Sati.

videos.title: Shiva's advice to Sati
videos.overview: Sati is woken by Mahadev’s touch and is overjoyed to see him. But he asks her not to go against her father’s wishes. Sati explains to her mother that Shiva had only come to save Daksh from losing his kingdom. Prasuti responds angrily and asks Sati to first throw Shiva out of her heart.

videos.title: Madanike leaves the palace
videos.overview: Prasuti accuses Madanike of being disloyal to the family. Daksh also says that what she’s done cannot be pardoned. Sati manages to hand over the Shivaling to Madanike and pleads with her parents to stop Madanike from leaving. But they are unmoved.

videos.title: Prasuti tells Sati to be truthful
videos.overview: Sati is still lost in Shiva’s thoughts. Prasuti assures her husband that it’s only a passing phase and Sati will get over it. She advises Sati that she must be truthful and tell her father that she has given up the delusions about Shiva. Sati is confused by conflicting thoughts.

videos.title: Daksh draws a Daksh rekha
videos.overview: Sati confesses her love for Mahadev to her father. An angry Daksh creates a Daksh Rekha around her and tells her that she or Shiva must never cross it. Unhappy, Sati tries to burn herself by crossing the line. Mahadev stops her and reminds her again of her duty to her father.

videos.title: Daksh puts a curse on Chandrama
videos.overview: Revati is upset that Chandrama ignores her and prefers his other wife Rohini. Daksh tells Chandrama to give equal attention to Revati. When Chandrama doesn’t agree, Daksh puts a curse on him. Narad Muni pleads with Mahadev to do something as his silence is feeding Daksh’s arrogance.

videos.title: Mahadev’s anger worries the gods
videos.overview: An angry Mahadev sets out to destroy Daksh. The gods begin to fear that his anger may harm Sati. Narada rushes to Lord Vishnu asking him to help calm Mahadev. Even Brahma and Vishnu cannot do anything, because under Daksh’s law, they cannot worship Shiva. But Vishnu then comes up with an idea.

videos.title: Vishnu asks for a new planet
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu appears before Daksh and says he has upset the balance of the universe by destroying Chandrama and asks him to create a new planet in place of Chandrama. Meanwhile, Rishi Dadhichi announces that Shiva has taken his Rudra-roop. What calamities will it cause?

videos.title: Lakshmi disguises herself as Sati
videos.overview: Sati is sent to bring soil from the River Saraswati for a planet that Daksh is creating. Goddess Lakshmi takes the form of Sati and comes to the palace. By the river, Sati meets two rishis, who ask her to help them with a Shiva puja. Lakshmi disappears after leaving a bunch of lotuses on the throne.

videos.title: Shiva’s anger is calmed
videos.overview: Narad Muni marvels at the miracles of Vishnu and Lakshmi, which they performed so that the Daksh Rekha could be removed and Sati could do the Shiva puja to calm Shiva’s anger. Narad tells Sati that she is Mahashakti, the other half of Mahadev. What will Sati do now?

videos.title: How Maha Shivaratri came to be
videos.overview: Mahadev saves Chandrama from Daksh’s plan to create a new planet. Shiva wears the crescent moon in his hair to protect Chandrama from Daksh. Vishnu says the day will be celebrated as Maha Shivaratri, when Mahadev will grant the wishes of his devotees.

videos.title: Mahadev agrees to meet Sati
videos.overview: Sati is deeply saddened by Mahadev continuing to ignore her and shares her feelings with Madanike.  The dancer consoles her and then requests Mahadev to meet Sati. They meet on the auspicious night of Maha Shivaratri.

videos.title: Mahadev reveals the truth
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Sati that it is impossible for them to be together. She begs him not to punish her because of his enmity with her father. Mahadev then explains the reality of the human body and why she cannot marry him. Prajapati Daksh arrives on the scene and declares that Sati will be put to death.

videos.title: Mahadev spares Daksh’s life
videos.overview: Angered by Daksh, Mahadev aims his Trishul at him. But he lets Daksh go when Sati pleads for his life. Sati blames herself for hurting her father and seeks his forgiveness. Daksh expresses his happiness at getting his daughter back. But he is not done with Mahadev yet.

videos.title: Sati's Nanda Vrat
videos.overview: Prajapati Daksh swears that Sati will never be joined with Mahadev, but Anusuya asks her to keep the Nanda Vrat and attain the Lord through devotion. She also warns her that the Vrat must never be interrupted. Brahma and Vishnu try to get Mahadev to marry Sati for the good of the world.

videos.title: Daksh's plans
videos.overview: Revati gives Sati the Nanda Vrat, the book which prescribes its rituals. But she is very disturbed when she is unable to open it. Revati assures her that the next day will be a new beginning. However, the next day, Daksh makes a shocking announcement about Sati’s fate.

videos.title: Sati continues with the Vrat
videos.overview: Daksh assures Sati that her marriage will only be with his consent. Sati, meanwhile, follows the rituals of the Nanda Vrat and shapes a clay Shivaling. She goes to the graveyard to collect ash, when Mahadev appears before her. He tells her to give up the Nanda Vrat and vanishes even as she objects.

videos.title: The Jal Samadhi
videos.overview: Sati tries to stop her parents from doing Jal Samadhi. But Daksh is sure that he has fulfilled his role as a father and must leave the world. As Daksh and Prasuti enter the water to end their lives, Sati’s sisters demand that she stop them by agreeing to the marriage her father will fix for her. Will Sati agree?

videos.title: Sati agrees to obey her father
videos.overview: Sati promises Daksh that she will marry the man he chooses for her. Lakshmi expresses her concern about Sati to Vishnu. Vishnu asks her not to fear. Meanwhile, on earth, Sati decides to end her Nanda Vrat.

videos.title: Tarakasur Boasts of his Power
videos.overview: Daksh is delighted on learning about Sati's devotion in Lord Vishnu. Sati decides to immerse the Shivling. Tarakasur boasts of his power and learns from Narad that Mahadev is going to renounce his reclusive life. He vows to ruin Mahadev and Sati's upcoming marriage and is determined to kill Sati.

videos.title: Plans to immerse the Shivaling
videos.overview: When Sati goes to immerse the Shivaling, Lakshmi asks Vishnu why she is being kept apart from Shiva when she was born to marry him. Vishnu asks her to wait for events to unfold.

videos.title: Mahadev saves Sati
videos.overview: Mahadev slays the monster which attacks Sati. On Nandi’s request, Mahadev asks Sati not to immerse the Shivaling. She agrees and hands over the sacred object to Nandi. It is a gesture that will change her destiny.

videos.title: Trying to forget Shiva
videos.overview: Daksh goes ahead with plans for Sati’s marriage. Revati tells Prasuti about Sati’s devotion to Mahadev and she conveys it to Daksh. Sati throws the Rudraksh away and orders the maids to close the windows so she does not have to see the Himalayas. Then, Prasuti sees the Trishul mark on Sati’s arm.

videos.title: Daksh's wish
videos.overview: Prasuti tells Daksh about the Trishul mark on Sati’s arm. Enraged, Daksh demands an explanation and vows to destroy the symbol. Even as Rishi Kashyap goes in search of a cure, Sati decides to burn the mark on her arm.

videos.title: The Trishul mark on Sati's arm
videos.overview: Sati fails to burn away the mark on her arm. She requests Mahadev to stay out of her life. To Prasuti’s surprise, the mark on Sati’s arm vanishes on its own. Prajapati Daksh is shocked when all prospective grooms turn down Sati’s marriage proposal. What will Daksh do now?

videos.title: Brahma agrees to help
videos.overview: Prasuti asks Prajapati Daksh to seek Brahma Dev’s help in Sati’s marriage. Brahma holds Daksh responsible for the problems, but promises to find a suitable match for Sati. She decides to return the Nanda Vrat book to Anusuya, even as Revati asks her to follow her heart.

videos.title: Mahadev saves Sati from Gantak
videos.overview: Even as Tarakasur sends Gantak to kill Sati, Mahadev comes to her rescue. An angry Tarakasur beheads Gantak for not following his orders. Meanwhile, Daksh visits Angira Rishi with Sati’s marriage proposal for Sadhbhish. The Rishi agrees to accept Sati as his daughter-in -law on one condition.

videos.title: The gods approach Mahadev
videos.overview: Prajapati Daksh tells Sati that Rishi Angira will seek her hand in marriage for his son. She agrees to obey her father. Brahma, Vishnu and Lakshmi try to persuade Mahadev to stop the marriage because Adi Shakti cannot marry a mere mortal. Will Mahadev listen to them?

videos.title: Revati tries to convince Sati
videos.overview: Narad muni, Chandrama and Nandi request Mahadev to visit Sati, but in vain. Prasuti forces Bhrugu Maharishi to take the responsibilities of Sati’s marriage. She insists Daksh to reconsider Sadbhish as an appropriate groom for Sati. Asur Chakri suggests Tarakasur to kill Sati before the marriage. Revati tries to convince Sati, but Sati faints on the day of Sadbhish’s visit.

videos.title: Prajapati Daksh is worried
videos.overview: Prajapati Daksh is worried about Sati’s health and also anxious about her marriage to Sadhbhish. Revati is also upset by her sister’s condition and prays to Mahadev to heal her before her marriage. Prasuti questions Daksh’s wisdom in arranging Sati’s marriage.

videos.title: Prasuti Protests Against Daksh
videos.overview: Sati's health deteriorates. Daksh is adamant on getting her married to an ugly Sadhbhish and prepares for the same. However, Prasuti is dejected about Daksh’s choice of groom for Sati. Later, she strongly protests against Daksh's decision. Prasuti is concerned about Sati's well-being.

videos.title: Prasuti is against Daksh’s plans
videos.overview: Prasuti is unhappy with Daksh’s choice of groom for Sati and says it is a curse on her daughter to be married off to the ugly Sadhbhish. Daksh, however, is adamant. Prasuti tries to persuade Sati to reject the proposal, but she insists on obeying her father’s orders.

videos.title: Lakshmi appears before Daksh
videos.overview: Lord Brahma tells Daksh that Jata can make Sadhbhish handsome, even as Prasuti protests that he is not a suitable groom for her daughter. Lakshmi appears before Daksh in the form of an old lady and asks the king to follow her barefoot to find Jata.

videos.title: Daksh goes to meet Jata
videos.overview: When Daksh reaches Jata’s abode, he has to first get past his servant who has vowed to humble the arrogant Prajapati. In the palace, Sati is so distracted by conflicting thoughts about Mahadev’s rejection and her loyalty to her father, she doesn’t notice her clothes catching fire during the puja.

videos.title: Jata promises to help Daksh
videos.overview: Prajapati Daksh seeks Jata’s help to transform Sadhbhish into a handsome person. Jata’s servant tries to prevent Daksh’s wish being granted. But Jata promises Daksh that he will help him. Daksh is happy and returns to give the good news to Prasuti and Sati.

videos.title: Sati hears Jata sing
videos.overview: Prajapati Daksh welcomes Jata to his palace where he sings a song that mesmerises Sati. Later, Jata agrees to transform Sadhbhish on the condition that Sati stays with him until his work is finished. However, Daksh and Prasuti are against that. Will Jata finish what he promised to do?

videos.title: Sati feels healed
videos.overview: Sati believes the music she heard is a blessing from the gods and feels healed. Daksh, meanwhile, asks Jata to complete his task. Daksh tells Prasuti that though Jata is arrogant, he is a skilled sculptor. On her father’s request, Sati asks Jata to work on transforming Sadhbhish.

videos.title: Jata’s true nature revealed
videos.overview: Jata asks Sati to stay around him, while he is engaged in sculpting a figure of Sadhbhish.  Jata’s servant reveals that his master is none other than Mahadev himself. Sati is again lost in thoughts of Mahadev and expresses her unhappiness at having to marry Sadhbhish.

videos.title: Mahadev blesses a boy
videos.overview: Jata refuses the comforts of the palace and wishes to stay in a village. There, a small boy stands on a Shivaling while reaching for a Bilva fruit. The villagers curse the boy for disrespecting the idol, but Mahadev appears before him and grants him two boons.

videos.title: Jata saves Sati
videos.overview: Jata arrives at Sukarna’s house, carrying fruits and toys, and introduces himself as his maternal uncle. Sukarna’s mother knows it is Mahadev. Sukarna doesn’t want Jata to leave, but his servant says he must go so he can bring him an aunt. Meanwhile, a crocodile is about to attack Sati.

videos.title: Sevakram tells Sati a love story
videos.overview: Jata’s servant Sevakram tells Sati the story of Jata’s love for a princess who betrayed him. Sati, in turn, tells Sevakram about her connection with Mahadev. A rishi warns Daksh to marry off Sati at the earliest. Daksh seeks Jata’s advice to ensure Sati’s welfare.

videos.title: Sati learns who Jata is
videos.overview: Sati sees Mahadev in Jata and he reveals that he has come to earth as a sculptor. He assures her of his immense love for her and says he has had to sacrifice his love for her welfare. Sati is angry at Mahadev for renouncing her. He, in turn, reminds her of her promise and loyalty to Daksh.

videos.title: Sati's request to Mahadev
videos.overview: Sati is angry when Mahadev insists on her marrying Sadhbhish. She tells Revati the truth about Jata and Revati asks her to marry Mahadev. Sati pleads with Jata to use his powers as Mahadev and stop her marriage with Sadhbhish.

videos.title: Prasuti and Daksh are pleased
videos.overview: Prajapati Daksh and Prasuti are pleased by the new image of Sadhbhish. Even Sati appreciates Jata’s work. As Jata is leaving, Daksh asks him to create an idol of Shiva which can be displayed at Sati’s upcoming wedding with Sadhbhish.

videos.title: Marriage rituals begin
videos.overview: Sati is pursued by Sadhbhish, who has a monster within him. Rishi Dadhichi is not able to help Sati, but Mahadev slays the monster. Sati returns to the palace and the marriage rituals begin. But Sadhbhish’s actions leave everyone shocked.

videos.title: Sadhbhish changes back
videos.overview: Sadhbhish confesses his guilt to Prajapati Daksh and Sati. His attractive image sculpted by Jata changes back to his original ugliness. Daksh is furious and curses him and his father Angira Rishi. Sati begins to weep before a Mahadev idol when her father appears.

videos.title: The truth about Jata
videos.overview: Sati tells Revati that Mahadev had arrived on earth only for her and that she wishes to go with him to Kailash. But Jata advises her to obey her father. Daksh goes ahead with the marriage plans for Sati and insists that all his citizens should attend.

videos.title: The rishis make a prediction
videos.overview: Joyous after her meeting with Jata, Sati decides to take his advice. Rishi Kashyap is annoyed by Daksh’s arrogance and predicts that Sati’s marriage will only be with Lord Shiva. Rishi Atri reveals Jata’s real identity to Daksh. How will Daksh respond?

videos.title: Prasuti's efforts
videos.overview: Prasuti tries to enlighten Daksh about Lord Shiva’s real nature, expressing her desire that her daughter should be united with Mahadev. But Daksh is set in his opposition to Mahadev. He is not willing to listen to Rishi Kashyap or Revati. What will Sati’s decision be?

videos.title: Daksh arranges a Swayamvar
videos.overview: Daksh wants to conduct Sati’s marriage quickly. Prasuti is in despair and prays to Lord Shiva to protect Sati. Rishi Kashyap, Revati and Aditi also join in the prayers. While Daksh goes about organizing a Swayamvar for Sati, her destiny seems already decided.

videos.title: Mahadev appears before Sati
videos.overview: Daksh is furious to see that Sati has garlanded an idol of Lord Shiva. Sati is in deep prayer and Mahadev, moved by her devotion, appears before her.  Sati is overjoyed to see the Lord, but Daksh again declares his opposition to him and attacks Mahadev with his words.

videos.title: A celestial wedding
videos.overview: Prajapati Daksh drags Sati away from the marriage venue. Brahma and Vishnu appear before Daksh and insist that he should give Sati in marriage to Shiva. Daksh has no option but to agree and the marriage of Shiva and Sati takes place.

videos.title: Prasuti blesses Shiva and Sati
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu and Brahma wish Mahadev and Sati on the auspicious occasion. Lord Shiva asks Sati to seek the blessing of her parents. Prasuti blesses the bride and groom with all her heart. But when Sati turns to Daksh, his blessings are half-hearted.

videos.title: Sati expresses her happiness
videos.overview: After their marriage, Sati tells Mahadev that her every desire has been fulfilled. She apologises to him for all the humiliation he has suffered. The new bride also learns that Mahadev would want to live amidst nature, and not in the confines of a palace.

videos.title: The wedding feast doesn’t go well
videos.overview: Vijaya, Sati’s sister, arrives just as the wedding feast is being planned. She taunts Shiva for making his home in the Himalayas. Nandi, Pret, Kan and others from Kailash come to the wedding feast. But it ends in chaos.

videos.title: Sati apologises to her father
videos.overview: The guests from Kailash don’t know the ways of the palace, but Mahadev is happy to eat with them. Vijaya wishes to break Mahadev and Sati's marriage and shares her plans with Daksh. Sati apologises to Daksh for marrying against his will, and he consoles her. But Daksh has other plans.

videos.title: Mahadev at Daksh's yagna
videos.overview: On Daksh’s invitation, Mahadev decides to attend his yagna before leaving for Kailash. Vijaya keeps trying to influence Sati against Mahadev. Rishi Bhrigu predicts that there will be faults in Sati's married life. Mahadev is taken aback when he arrives at the yagna.

videos.title: Daksh insults Mahadev
videos.overview: Daksh stops Mahadev from participating in the yagna, saying that with the animal skin around his waist and the snake around his neck, he is not clean enough to attend the ritual. Although he is unable to participate in the yagna, the gods appear and present the offerings made to the hawan to Mahadev.

videos.title: Daksh apologises to Mahadev
videos.overview: Vijaya asks Daksh to persuade Lord Shiva to stay on in the palace with Sati. Daksh has a change of heart and requests Shiva to stay. Mahadev leaves the decision to Sati. Tarakasur, meanwhile, aware that his death will be at the hands of a child born to Sati, plans to attack Lord Shiva and Sati.

videos.title: Sati decides to leave for Kailash
videos.overview: Sati does not wish to stay at the palace and wants to leave for Kailash with her consort at the earliest. Daksh agrees and Prasuti blesses Sati. On learning about Sati's departure, Rishi Brighu tells Daksh that it is not an auspicious move. Will the prediction come true?

videos.title: Mahadev tames River Saraswati
videos.overview: The waters of the Saraswati river rise up in the path of Mahadev and Sati. He dips his foot in  the river and Saraswati appears before them. Mahavev gives Saraswati a boon and declares that the spot would become the holy Tirthraj. Mahadev and Sati cherish their time together before she bids goodbye to her family.

videos.title: Daksh has not given up
videos.overview: Sati’s sisters bid her a sad farewell. Daksh is still angry because his daughter is departing with his curses, rather than his blessings. Vijaya reminds her father that he must take revenge on Shiva. Daksh assures her that it is the sole purpose of his life.

videos.title: Sati leaves for Kailash
videos.overview: Sati assures Prasuti that she will perform her marital duties perfectly. Daksh gifts some luxurious things to Shiva as Sati is used to live a royal life. But Shiva refuses to accept the gifts, saying that being a demigod Sati will not require these things. Vijaya asks Sati not to become callous like Lord Shiva. Sati leaves her family along with Lord Shiva with gloomy eyes.

videos.title: Sati's three promises
videos.overview: Sati makes three promises to Lord Shiva: she will obey him at all times; she will never lie to him; and she will never hide anything from him. Rishi Atharva brings his scriptures to Lord Shiva, who declares they will henceforth become the Atharva Veda. Lord Brahma’s sons are angered by this.

videos.title: The story of Atharva Veda
videos.overview: Saraswati is made the judge for the debate between Lord Shiva and Lord Brahma’s sons.  Lord Brahma intervenes and orders his sons to accept Rishi Atharva’s work as the fourth Veda. They apologise to Sati and accept the Veda. But when Brahma’s sons praise Mahadev, Daksh puts a curse on them.

videos.title: Lord Shiva slays Chitrasur
videos.overview: Chitrasur disguises himself as Mahadev and comes to kill Sati. Lord Shiva is enraged and beheads the asura. Sati is scared to see Lord Shiva’s anger. Tarakasur continues his attacks on the gods in order to become the ruler of the heavens.

videos.title: Sati is now aware of her power
videos.overview: Sati enters Kailash after performing the necessary rituals in the presence of Lord Brahma, Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi. She faints when she sits in Mahadev’s meditation seat. Lord Shiva gives Yoga Vidya to Sati to make her aware of her powers

videos.title: Shiva-Sati union: Kailash gears up
videos.overview: Rati and Kamdev want to decorate Kailash for the union of Shiv and Shakti and Mahadev agrees. Sati awaits the moment with eager anticipation. Tarakasur calls out to the gods to come and fight him. Mahadev arrives to stop the war, but fails to convince Tarakasur.

videos.title: Lord Shiva stages a funny drama
videos.overview: Lord Shiva saves the gods from Tarakasur. Sati, however, is upset with him for leaving her alone on the first night of their marriage. Lord Shiva cheers her up by staging a funny drama, roping in Nandi. It is the beginning of Natya Sastra.

videos.title: Daksh clashes with Mahadev
videos.overview: Both Mahadev and Daksh are invited to a yagna at Brahma's abode. Mahadev comes forward to bless Daksh. But he turns away and denounces Shiva. He announces a major yagna, to which Mahadev will not be invited. Meanwhile, Tarakasur’s son Vidyunmali summons Shiva and asks him to be his bodyguard, keeping death away.

videos.title: Sati prays to Mahadev
videos.overview: Tarakasur covers the sun and Sati prays to Lord Shiva and asks him to save mankind from the demon. But he is in the service of Vidyunmali. Sati asks Vidyunmali to release Lord Shiva. He agrees, but on one condition: his father, Tarakasur, must be freed from his bondage.

videos.title: Sati angers Shiva
videos.overview: Sati is reluctant to believe that Rama is a god and that he is virtuous. She takes the form of Sita to test him. But Rama realizes who she is. When Shiva learns this, he is angry and says he cannot consider her his wife. Meanwhile, Vijaya plots to make Sati come to her father’s yagna without Shiva.

videos.title: Lord Shiva fumes at Sati
videos.overview: Sati decides to test Sri Ram to find out if he is God. However, Sri Ram learns she is Sati. Lord Shiva is livid with Sati and refuses to consider her his wife. Meanwhile, Narad Muni rewards Tarakasur for saving his veena and grants him a boon. Vijaya plots to take Sati to Yagya without Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Sati's decision
videos.overview: Tarakasur disguises himself as Narad Muni and persuades Sati to go to her father’s yagna without Lord Shiva. Vijaya, too, convinces Sati. Then she overhears Saptrishi Bhrigu say that the whole universe will be destroyed if Sati comes to the yagna without Lord Shiva and she is scared.

videos.title: Sati argues with Shiva
videos.overview: Lord Shiva is pleased with Shukracharya’s penance and grants him the boon of Sanjeevni Vidya. Sati wishes to go to Daksh’s yagna with Lord Shiva; but he refuses to go without being formally invited. Sati is set on going and argues with Lord Shiva about it.

videos.title: Sati set to go to Daksh’s yagna
videos.overview: Sati insists that Mahadev should come to Daksh’s yagna, but he is firm in his refusal.  Meanwhile, Daksh seeks Lord Vishnu and Lakshmi’s presence at the yagna. Mahadev tries to enlighten Sati about the significance of contemplation in life. Finally, Sati decides to join Daksh’s yagna despite Mahadev’s opposition.

videos.title: Daksh doesn’t welcome Sati
videos.overview: Mahadev and Nandi try to stop Sati, but she is determined to attend her father’s yagna. Lord Vishnu and Brahma request Mahadev to go to the yagna, but he is unshaken. Proud of organising the ultimate yagna, Daksh stops Sati from joining the rituals. Should she have listened to Mahadev?

videos.title: Rishi Dadhichi curses Daksh
videos.overview: Rishi Dadhichi curses Daksh that he will not able to complete the yagna because the Prajapati has disrespected Lord Shiva. Sati orders the Rishi not to abandon the yagna. Daksh turns his anger onto Sati and tells her not to call him ‘father’ anymore. Sati realises her mistake.

videos.title: Sati tries to give up her life
videos.overview: Daksh continues to humiliate Sati by heaping abuse on Mahadev. She criticises Lord Brahma, Vishnu and Lakshmi for not controlling Daksh. She then decides to give up her life for the sake of Mahadev and attempts to jump into the fire, but Prasuti stops her. Mahadev is angered by what is happening to Sati.

videos.title: Sati shows herself as Adi Shakti
videos.overview: Daksh’s ceremony is ruined. Unable to stand her father’s atrocities, Sati decides to end her life in the fire. She prays to the Agni Devta to consume her, but the fire god refuses. Eventually, she summons her own powers and reveals herself as Adi Shakti in all her glory. Will she renounce her life?

videos.title: Mahadev declares war on Daksh
videos.overview: Sati destroys herself, triggering Mahadev’s anger. He does the Tandav and declares a war of revenge against Daksh. While Mahadev’s devotees take on Daksh’s army, Lord Brahma and Vishnu urge Daksh to surrender. Will Prajapati heed their advice?

videos.title: The Gods Fear Destruction
videos.overview: The deities urge Lord Brahma to stop Mahadev from avenging Sati’s death. As the war between Mahadev and Daksh continues, Lord Vishnu and Brahma pray to Mahadev to calm down and protect the universe from destruction.

videos.title: Daksh dies
videos.overview: Mahadev is tormented by Sati’s death. Lord Vishnu conveys to him that Daksh has redeemed himself with his death and reminds him of the importance of Daksh's reincarnation. Mahadev gives new life to Daksh, who apologises for his sins. Mahadev takes Sati's body away.

videos.title: Tarakasur rejoices
videos.overview: Lord Brahma and Lord Vishnu come to console Lord Shiva, who tells them he feels lifeless without Sati at his side. Meanwhile, Tarakasur rejoices over Lord Shiva’s misery and Shukracharya reprimands him. But Tarakasur convinces him to take advantage of the situation and attack the gods.

videos.title: Vishnu disposes of Sati's body
videos.overview: Tarakasur’s armies begin to attack common people and saints. The deities approach Lord Vishnu, who asks them to choose between Tarakasur’s death and an end to Mahadev’s sorrow. With the consent of the gods, Lord Vishnu makes Sati’s body fall to earth in several parts.

videos.title: Mahadev’s grief continues
videos.overview: Nandi is tormented by Mahadev's grief and wants to make him understand Sati's power. But Mahadev pays no attention to him. Meanwhile, Tarakasur intends to attack the gods. Lord Vishnu declares that Adi Shakti herself will choose when she is to be reborn.

videos.title: Mahadev recalls Sati
videos.overview: Mahadev realises Sati’s existence on seeing parts of her shakti peethas. Lord Vishnu and Brahma pray to Adi Shakti for Mahadev’s welfare. Mahadev recalls Sati by playing the veena. Meanwhile, Tarakasur orders his warriors to destroy Sati’s shakti peethas to ruin Mahadev’s power.

videos.title: Mahadev returns to his God state
videos.overview: The spirit of Sati appears before Lord Shiva and asks him to return to his Godly state and do what he must for them to be reunited. Nandi is overwhelmed as Lord Shiva once again becomes God. Egged on by Tarakasur, Dudumbhi torments Rishi Dadhichi. Will Shiva come to his recue?

videos.title: Shiva sets up the Shakti Peetha
videos.overview: Lord Shiva assumes the form of Kalbhairav, defeats the asuras and blesses Rishi Dadhichi. The two of them establish a Shakti Peetha in one of the places where Sati’s remains have fallen; that is Kashi. Tarakasur commands the Earth to swallow up the other remains, or ‘pind’ of Shakti.

videos.title: Shiva rejoices at seeing Sati
videos.overview: When the Earth refuses to obey Tarakasur and destroy Sati’s remains, he threatens to demolish the Planet. Failing to stop Tarakasur, Shukracharya asks the Earth to send Sati’s remains to Lord Shiva. He rejoices at seeing Sati in front of him. But Tarakasur’s attack on Earth seems unstoppable.

videos.title: Mahadev saves the Earth
videos.overview: Adi Shakti urges Mahadev to act against Tarakasur and protect the universe from him. Mahadev summons his powers and saves the earth from destruction. Meanwhile, he finds out that two parts of Sati’s ‘pind’ are missing. Tarakasur is bent on destroying them.

videos.title: Shakti Peethas are established
videos.overview: Vidyunmali fights with Him Naresh to destroy the ‘pind’ that he is protecting. Shiva arrives there and Vidyunmali runs away. Shiva establishes all the Shakti Peethas. Rishi Markandeya predicts that Ganga, the daughter of Him Naresh and Menavati, will join Mahadev sometime.

videos.title: Brahma's request to Ganga
videos.overview: Tarakasur plots to destroy the purity of the heavens. Brahma meets Him Naresh and asks him to send Ganga to heaven so it can be purified. Lord Vishnu tells Lakshmi that Adi Shakti will be born as the daughter of Him Naresh and Menavati.

videos.title: Adi Shakti is born
videos.overview: Indra asks Ganga the reason for her sadness and she tells him that she wishes to marry Mahadev. Indra, in turn, reveals to Ganga the facts about the birth of Adi Shakti. The other half of Shiva is born as the daughter of Him Naresh and Menavati. Tarakasur learns this and sends Bahurupa to destroy the child.

videos.title: Adi Shakti is named Parvati
videos.overview: Bahurupa, who sets out to kill Adi Shakti, is redeemed from a curse by the Goddess. Rishi Markandeya takes the child back to Menavati. Narad Muni christens this avatar of Adi Shakti as Parvati. Rishi Markandeya removes Menavati’s doubts about the glory and powers of Mahadev.

videos.title: Parvati plays the damru
videos.overview: Him Naresh goes to war, leaving Parvati and Menavati in Rishi Dadhichi’s ashram. Tarakasur sends out spies to find Parvati and is angry when he fails to get any information.  Menavati and Rishi Dadhichi are surprised to see Parvati play the damru that is Shiva’s favoured instrument. What could it mean?

videos.title: Tarakasur plots to kill Parvati
videos.overview: Menavati scolds Parvati for her actions.  Rishi Dadhichi gives the little girl a Shiva idol and asks her to worship the Lord. Tarakasur learns where Parvati is and sends out his men to kill her. Parvati prays to Shiva. Will he come to her rescue?

videos.title: Menavati becomes unconscious
videos.overview: Menavati is worried for Parvati’s safety and wants to take her to another place. Menavati then falls and becomes unconscious. Rishi Markandeya reveals the Mrityunjaya Mantra and his own story to Parvati. The young girl prays to Shiva to save her mother.

videos.title: Parvati’s prayers save Menavati
videos.overview: Menavati is saved by Parvati’s prayers and tells her daughter that she will not come in the way of her devotion to Shiva. When Rishi Dadhichi tells Him Naresh that Parvati will wed Shiva, the king refuses to accept it and says she is promised to someone else. Can Narad Muni convince Him Naresh to change his mind?

videos.title: Him Naresh meets Daksh in Kashi
videos.overview: Him Naresh takes Parvati to Kashi. There, they meet Daksh and Prasuti. Daksh tells Him Naresh not to repeat the mistakes he made. Menavati and Him Naresh are shocked to see what their young daughter does next.

videos.title: Parvati meets Sati
videos.overview: Menavati scolds Parvati for dancing in the graveyard. Parvati is shocked when her mother says that she will not allow her and Shiva to be joined as long as she is alive. When Parvati goes to throw away the damru, she encounters Sati.

videos.title: Parvati listens to Sati
videos.overview: After meeting Sati, Parvati tells her mother that she will respect and obey the sentiments of her parents. Him Naresh and his family return to their kingdom. Meanwhile, in heaven, the gods decide it is time to awaken Mahadev from his yoga state.

videos.title: Parvati learns cooking
videos.overview: Menavati teaches Parvati various feminine skills such as cooking and is amazed to see how talented she is. In heaven, Lord Brahma, Vishnu and Lakshmi discuss how Shiva and Parvati will come together. Parvati comes of age.

videos.title: Menavati enlightens Parvati
videos.overview: Jaya informs Parvati that she will marry the Vindhyachal prince. Menavati and Him Naresh want Parvati to abandon her devotion to Mahadev. Meanwhile, Lord Vishnu predicts that Parvati will gain Mahadev's love.

videos.title: Menavati's advice
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu appears before Him Naresh and informs him that Parvati is destined to marry Lord Shiva. He persuades the king to remove any obstacles in their way. Meanwhile, Menavati convinces Parvati not to marry Shiva.

videos.title: Parvati's decision upsets Naresh
videos.overview: Menavati wants Parvati to marry Rajkumar Dandak and urges her to give up her feelings for Mahadev. Parvati vows to obey her wishes. Naresh is upset with Parvati’s decision and persuades her to devote herself to Mahadev.

videos.title: Dadhichi enlightens Parvati
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu sends Rishi Dadhichi to inform Parvati about Mahadev. Dadhichi helps Parvati awaken her devotion for Mahadev and gives her Bel Patra in order to meet him. Meanwhile, Tarakasur tries to attack Shukracharya.

videos.title: Parvati pleads Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati crosses obstacles to meet Lord Shiva on Dadhichi’s instructions. She pleads Lord Shiva to teach her how to become a good wife to him.

videos.title: Indradev's order
videos.overview: Sati’s sisters give Lord Shiva’s rudraksh and veena to Parvati so that Lord Shiva can recognise her. To help Parvati, Indradev assigns Kamdev to break Lord Shiva’s meditation.

videos.title: Kamdev helps Parvati
videos.overview: Sati’s sisters groom Parvati like a bride. Parvati makes a wish in Nandi’s ears that Lord Shiva accepts her as his wife. Kamdev helps Parvati by giving his arrow to break Lord Shiva’s meditation.

videos.title: Mahadev is angry
videos.overview: An angry Mahadev burns Kamdev with his trinetra for interrupting his meditation. Devi Rati is upset about Kamdev’s death. Lord Vishnu tries to convince Mahadev to accept Parvati’s love but he rejects the proposal.

videos.title: Rati curses Parvati
videos.overview: Rati blames Parvati for Kamdev’s death and curses her with infertility. Lord Vishnu persuades her to remove the curse. Menavati finds out that Parvati has gone to meet Lord Shiva but Parvati promises she will not do anything without Menavati's permission.

videos.title: Parvati's determination
videos.overview: Parvati agrees to marry Rajkumar Dandak, as proposed by Menavati. Lord Vishnu and Nandi convince Lord Shiva to acknowledge Parvati as his wife. But Menavati asks Parvati to forget Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Vishnu enlightens Mahadev
videos.overview: Menavati allows Parvati to marry Mahadev. But Mahadev continues to ignore Parvati’s devotion. Narad advises Parvati to transform herself to seek Mahadev’s love. Meanwhile, Sati crosses the river to reach the cremation ground to prove her devotion to Mahadev.

videos.title: Narad's suggestion
videos.overview: Narad advises Parvati to fast for sixteen consecutive Mondays and to use bel leaves to worship Shiva, instead of fruits and flowers. However Mahadev informs Nandi that he will not let Parvati love him.

videos.title: Lord Vishnu helps Parvati
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu helps Parvati make a Shivaling. Mahadev challenges her, saying she cannot perform the puja. Narad advises Parvati to proceed to Manasarovar Yatra.

videos.title: Narand and Nandi help Parvati
videos.overview: Him Naresh helps Parvati reach Manasarovar. Mahadev wants Parvati to perform the rituals by herself. Narad reminds Mahadev of Sati’s existence in Parvati and requests him to be more compassionate to her.

videos.title: Mahadev's devotee prays Parvati
videos.overview: Parvati wants Mahadev to welcome her to Kailash, but is saddened to find that he is no longer there. Mahadev sticks to his decision even though Narad and Nandi request him to understand Parvati’s devotion to him.

videos.title: Mahadev saves Parvati
videos.overview: Menavati interrupts Parvati before she finishes the puja. Nagraj Kadru and Vidyunmali hold Naresh hostage. To save her father, Parvati agrees to marry Vidyunmali. Vidyunmali tries to attack Parvati but Mahadev comes to her rescue.

videos.title: Mahadev's test for Parvati
videos.overview: Tarakasur seeks Shukracharya’s permission to take Vrithasur’s help. Mahadev instructs the Saptarishis to test Parvati by letting crocodiles attack a small boy in front of her.

videos.title: Mahadev blesses Parvati
videos.overview: Parvati passes the test and the Saptarishis shower her with blessings. Mahadev also appears before her in the form of a devotee to offer his blessings.

videos.title: Tarakasur attacks Devraj Indra
videos.overview: Mahadev is delighted by Parvati’s devotion to him. Tarakasur attacks Devraj Indra and the deities. The deities seek help from Mahadev, who predicts that they will be saved by Bhagirath.

videos.title: Mahadev punishes Indra
videos.overview: Bhagirath tries to protect the environment and the deities from Tarakasur’s attack. Mahadev is furious after learning that Indra is attempting to disturb Parvati’s Sadhana. He asks Nandi to take care of Parvati, but she requests Nandi to not disturb her during the ritual.

videos.title: Dadhichi rescues the deities
videos.overview: While Indra apologises to Mahadev, Rishi Dadhichi uses his miraculous powers to save the deities from Tarakasur’s attack. Mahadev advises Bhagirath to seek Ganga’s help to make the earth pure. He also decides to wear Ganga in his crown and fulfil her wish.

videos.title: Parvati refuses to eat
videos.overview: Mahadev instructs Ganga to flow after placing her in his hair. She follows Bhagirath, aiming to deliver holy water to the whole world. Meanwhile, Naresh persuades Parvati to have food as she is starving herself.

videos.title: Lord Shiva is impressed with Goddess Parvati's devotion
videos.overview: Lord Shiva is impressed with Goddess Parvati's devotion and remarkable tenacity and accepts her as his wife. He feels sad for hurting Goddess Parvati and breaks into tears. Goddess Parvati blesses the pair of pigeons, who had supported her during her austerity, with immortality and to live in the Amarnath cave forever.Lord Shiva explains the cognitions of love to Goddess Parvati and asks her to come along with him to Kailash to start their married life. But, Goddess Parvati's refuses to go with him.

videos.title: Mahadev revives Kamdev
videos.overview: Lord Brahma, Lord Vishnu, Goddess Saraswati and Goddess Lakshmi are delighted by Mahadev's decision to accept Parvati as his wife. Mahadev revives Kamdev as per Rati’s wish. In the meantime, Vrithasur forces the saints on earth to chant Tarakasur’s name.

videos.title: Tarakasur's plan of destruction
videos.overview: Tarakasur is outraged when he learns about Mahadev and Parvati’s relationship. He orders his sons to capture Swarglok and destroy the gods. Indra, Brahma and Dadhichi seek Vishnu’s help to rescue the deities. Mahadev proceeds to meet Parvati’s parents.

videos.title: Menavati agrees to the marriage
videos.overview: Menavati is happy with Mahadev’s dance performance. But she is furious when she finds out about his intention to marry her daughter. Parvati then tries to convince her mother.

videos.title: Mahadev's disguise
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu informs Mahadev that if Him Naresh performs Parvati’s Kanyadan, the earth will turn into a desert. Mahadev disguises himself and appears in front of Menavati and Naresh to test them. Meanwhile, Shukracharya persuades Tarakasur to allow his sons to worship Mahadev.

videos.title: Parvati's reminder
videos.overview: Parvati assures Him Naresh that Mahadev was criticizing himself and reminds Naresh of his responsibilities. Mahadev sends the Saptarishis to meet Parvati’s parents about the proposal.

videos.title: Vishnu acts as Parvati's brother
videos.overview: Dadhichi and the Saptarishis put forth the proposal to Naresh. He readily agrees to the marriage and visits Kailash for pre-marriage rituals. Lord Vishnu performs the ritual as Parvati’s brother. In the meantime, Tarakasur plans to annihilate the Gods.

videos.title: Mahadev protects the deities
videos.overview: Parvati’s grandmother is worried when she finds out that Mahadev is entirely different from them in terms of thoughts and rites. Tarakasur plans to kill the Devas but Mahadev assigns Nandi to protect them.

videos.title: Nandi sacrifices himself
videos.overview: Parvati assures an angry Menavati that Mahadev will never disappoint her. Meanwhile, Tarakasur attacks Nandi in Mahapash. Nandi, in his attempt to save the gods from Tarakasur’s Amogh Shakti, loses his life.

videos.title: Shukracharya revives Nandi
videos.overview: Shukracharya calms Mahadev by reviving Nandi’s life using the Sanjeevani Vidya. Parvati is astonished that Ganga will be attending the marriage ceremony. Parvati and Mahadev perform marriage rituals.

videos.title: Naresh invites Daksh
videos.overview: Daksh extends his blessings to Parvati through Naresh. Meanwhile, Mahadev refuses to accept the many gifts offered to him.

videos.title: Parvati's orders for Anusuya
videos.overview: Anasuya is given the task of supervising the preparations for the wedding. Narad Muni tells Mahadev about Durvasa’s plan to curse him. Mahadev orders his servants to take part in the wedding procession from Parvati’s side.

videos.title: Durvasa curses Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev’s devotees misbehave with Durvasa. An angry Durvasa curses Mahadev’s marriage. He later feels guilty about it as Lord Vishnu warns him about the consequences of his curse.

videos.title: Mahadev's wedding procession
videos.overview: Parvati assures a worried Menavati that her marital life will be wonderful. While Sukarna and Daksh take part in the wedding, Mahadev sits on Nandi for his procession.

videos.title: Mahadev reaches Parvati's place
videos.overview: Mahadev sets off on his wedding procession, accompanied by his devotees. Shukracharya and the demons also join the procession. Menavati is upset when she sees that Mahadev is in his ascetic form.

videos.title: Lord Vishnu grooms Mahadev
videos.overview: Menavati is outraged when Mahadev offers her a snake as a gift. Overcome by anger, she refuses to let Parvati marry Mahadev. Parvati then persuades Mahadev to turn into his graceful self. Lord Vishnu takes the responsibility of grooming Mahadev.

videos.title: Garlands are exchanged
videos.overview: Menavati is delighted to see Mahadev after he assumes his graceful form and welcomes him. Mahadev and Parvati exchange garlands. Rishi Atri is honoured to perform the ritual as Mahadev’s father.

videos.title: Mahadev eats the wedding food
videos.overview: Mahadev eats all the food prepared for the wedding and Nandi persuades Parvati to stop him. Parvati feeds Mahadev with her hands. Mahadev reveals that he has eaten only the mouthful which was fed to him by Parvati. Parvati is gifted with a Shivaling.

videos.title: Nandi defeats the scholars
videos.overview: Mahadev receives an invitation to participate in a debate. He sends his Shivgans, who answer all the questions in a witty manner. Mahadev announces that he will create the Upanishads so that the scholars can gain the divine knowledge hidden in the Vedas.

videos.title: Mahadev marries Parvati
videos.overview: Menavati requests Mahadev to marry Parvati in his actual form. Mahadev marries Parvati following all the customs and rituals and he brings to her attention, the importance of their marriage.

videos.title: Mahadev and Parvati tie the knot
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati tie the wedding knot. The couple performs all the necessary rituals following the wedding.

videos.title: Mahadev's decision
videos.overview: Parvati gets emotional as she leaves her parents. In an attempt to make Parvati happy, Mahadev decides to stay at Naresh’s house. But Parvati’s grandmother is angered by his decision.

videos.title: Parvati persuades Mahadev
videos.overview: The deities express their concern over Mahadev’s decision to stay in Naresh’s house. While Parvati persuades him to go to Kailash, Tarakasur assigns Shumbh and Nishumbh to attack the Devas.

videos.title: Parvati leaves her maternal home
videos.overview: Parvati receives blessings from her elders as she prepares to leave her maternal home. Menavati gifts Mahadev an idol made by Parvati in her childhood. Parvati bids farewell to her family with a heavy heart.

videos.title: Mahadev forgives Daksh
videos.overview: On the way to Kailash, Parvati wishes to repay Daksh’s debt. Mahadev forgives Daksh and releases him from his curse. Meanwhile, Shumbh and Nishumbh assure Tarakasur that Dhumralochan will kill the Devas.

videos.title: Dhumralochan attacks the Devas
videos.overview: Dhumralochan attacks the Devas, who seek Dadhichi's help. Parvati learns, while travelling through the Daruk Forest, that the rishis of Daruk were glorified as Gods by their wives.

videos.title: Parvati challenges Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati challenges Mahadev to make the rishi patnis worship him. Mahadev plays the flute which impresses the women. While Parvati becomes jealous, Raktabeej is angered by Dhumralochan’s defeat and challenges Dadhichi and the Devas to engage in a fight.

videos.title: Parvati enters Kailash
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati reach Kailash, where she performs the after-marriage rituals as Mahadev’s wife. In the meantime, Dadhichi and the gods seek Lord Vishnu’s help. He tells them that Parvati will be able to destroy the demons.

videos.title: Parvati's lunch invitation
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati invite their devotees for lunch, where she requests them to honour Anna Devta. Lord Vishnu announces the destruction of evil powers by Parvati. Naresh assures Menavati of their daughter’s well-being. Parvati worships the Shivaling while Mahadev performs his Sadhana.

videos.title: Parvati confronts Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati breaks into tears as Mahadev reveals the mysteries of his life. Mahadev feeds Parvati with his own hands in an act of affection. Tarakasur, Shumbh and Nishumbh seek Lekha’s help in plotting against Parvati and Mahadev.

videos.title: Lekha visits Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev fumes at Parvati for not obeying his orders. Lekha disguises herself as Parvati and approaches Mahadev for an apology. Using her supernatural powers, Parvati learns that Mahadev is with another woman who resembles her.

videos.title: Shumbh and Nishumbh kill Lekha
videos.overview: Mahadev challenges Lekha and Parvati to feed the demons in a crematorium in order to identify the real Parvati. Lekha goes to the crematorium, whereas Parvati becomes furious. Mahadev identifies the real Parvati. Meanwhile, Dhumralochan and Raktabeej mistake Lekha for Parvati and kidnap her.

videos.title: Mahadev fumes at Parvati
videos.overview: Mahadev gives Tantragyan to Parvati on her insistence. During the instruction, Parvati accidentally falls asleep. Mahadev punishes her by asking her to take rebirth as a fisherwoman.

videos.title: Sukarma finds Parvati
videos.overview: Determined to obey Mahadev, Parvati leaves Kailash. She is reborn as a fisherwoman and attains a new-born baby’s form. While floating in the Ganga, she is rescued by a fisherman named Sukarma who accepts her as a gift from holy river.

videos.title: Sukarma accepts Parvati
videos.overview: Sukarma adopts Parvati as his daughter and names her Matsya. He instructs her to concentrate on a conch while going fishing. Nandi delivers to Mahadev the soil, where Parvati was born as Matsya.

videos.title: Mahadev rescues Rishi Gautam
videos.overview: Pitambar provokes the people of Trimbak to kill Gautam. Mahadev comes to Gautam’s rescue and he, in turn, requests Mahadev to purify the polluted pond. Mahadev advises Gautam to pray to Ganga. Ganga agrees to flow into Trimbak.

videos.title: The Jyotirling in Trimbak
videos.overview: Mahadev establishes Jyotirling into Trimbak and names it Trimbakeshwar. Ganga starts to flow in Trimbak as Godavari. Meanwhile, Sukarma decides to give Matsya in marriage to the most experienced fisherman. Mahadev learns this and decides to disguise himself as a fisherman to marry Parvati.

videos.title: Sukarma proposes a marriage
videos.overview: When Matsya fails to catch a big fish, Sukarma announces that whoever succeeds in catching it will be chosen as Matsya’s groom. Mahadev, disguised as a fisherman, succeeds in catching the fish. Sukarma proposes that Mahadev should marry Matsya.

videos.title: Parvati recognizes Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev meets Matsya and presents her his idol. Matsya then recollects her past and recognises Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Parvati
videos.overview: Tarakasur orders Raktabeej and Dhumralochan to destroy the earth. Lord Vishnu advises the devotees to seek Mahadev’s help to save them from the attack. Mahadev reveals the power of Mund Mandal to Parvati and enlightens her about Tantravidya.

videos.title: Adi Shakti kills Dhumralochan
videos.overview: The gods split into two groups in order to attack Raktabeej. Parvati decides to save the gods, transforms into Adi Shakti and kills Dhumralochan. She then becomes Maha Kali and kills Raktabeej.

videos.title: Parvati insults Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati, in the form of Kali, steps on Mahadev’s chest as he attempts to calm her down. She apologises to Mahadev and becomes gloomy. Mahadev orders Nandi and the Shivgans to cheer up Parvati. Meanwhile, Menavati decides to go to Kailash.

videos.title: Mahadev invents a game
videos.overview: Mahadev invents the game of Chauser and succeeds in cheering up Parvati. Vishnu informs Indradev and the other deities that Mahadev and Parvati’s son will kill Tarakasur. In the meantime, Naresh and Menavati prepare to visit Kailash.

videos.title: Parvati sets the rules
videos.overview: Parvati and Mahadev play Chauser and Mahadev keeps winning as he sets no rules for the game. But then, Parvati sets the rules and wins the game. Tarakasur’s sons impress Mahadev with their devotion and are granted boons.

videos.title: Tarakasur's sons won't meet him
videos.overview: Parvati is angered by Mahadev’s act of giving boons to Tarakasur’s sons. Tarakasur’s sons, being strict devotees of Mahadev, refuse to meet their father. Meanwhile, Naresh and Menavati reach Kailash to meet Parvati.

videos.title: Parvati leaves
videos.overview: Naresh and Menavati decide to take Parvati to the Himalayas. Parvati is elated upon reaching her maternal home. Meanwhile, Tarakasur’s sons reunite with their father after he cuts his own head and sends it to them.

videos.title: Parvati misses Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati find it hard to stay away from each other. He disguises himself as an astrologer and visits her abode. Parvati recognises Mahadev and confronts him for not being concerned about her.

videos.title: Menavati apologises to Mahadev
videos.overview: While the astrologer reveals Mahadev's identity, Him Naresh asks his wife bid Parvati farewell. Parvati assures Menavati that she is happy about where she lives with Mahadev.

videos.title: The trip to Amarnath
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati decide to leave for Amarnath. Mahadev assures a distressed Parvati that they will be blessed with a child. Meanwhile, Tarakasur assigns Maidanav to build a fortress for demons.

videos.title: Entering the Amarnath cave
videos.overview: Parvati and Mahadev leave for the seclusion of Amarnath. Tarakasur orders his sons to kill Mahadev’s son once he takes birth but they refuse to do so. Meanwhile, Indradev assigns Agnidev to protect Mahadev and Parvati’s son.

videos.title: Tarakasur's attempts
videos.overview: Tarakasur arrives at Amarnath to destroy the energy from which Mahadev and Parvati’s son would take birth. Learning of his arrival, Indradev orders Agnidev to protect the energy. Unable to bear the heat produced by the energy, Agnidev runs away.

videos.title: Parvati curses the gods
videos.overview: Parvati attains the form of Durga and curses the Devas and their wives. She also curses Agnidev, who convinces Ganga to contain Mahadev and Parvati’s energy inside her. Mahadev accepts Agnidev’s apology and grants him a boon.

videos.title: Parvati curses Ganga
videos.overview: Ganga accepts Mahadev and Parvati’s energy. Mahadev orders Ganga to visit the Udayachal hills as Tarakasur attempts to snatch it from her. Mahadev attempts to console Parvati, who, in a fit of rage, curses Ganga.

videos.title: The six sons
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati’s energy transforms into six sons. A group of ladies from Kritika Lok saves Parvati’s sons from Tarakasur. The ladies then stake a claim to the sons and request Mahadev to make a decision.

videos.title: Mahadev names his sons
videos.overview: The Kritikas understand Parvati’s feelings and return her sons to her. Mahadev transforms his six sons into one and names him Kartikay.

videos.title: Narad is elated to see Kartikay
videos.overview: Parvati expresses her inability to remove Ganga’s curse. As a remedy, Mahadev blesses Prithvi. Tarakasur is bent on killing Kartikay. Parvati wishes to take Kartikay to Kailash but is stopped by Mahadev.

videos.title: The Kritikas cradle Kartikay
videos.overview: Upset over her son’s absence, Parvati builds a statue of him and adores it. Meanwhile, the Kirtikas cradle Kartikay. Mahadev informs Parvati that their son is to arrive. Tarakasur is advised that his sons will die if they help him.

videos.title: Kartikay's refusal
videos.overview: Mahadev informs the Kritikas that they are arriving to take Kartikay to Kailash. The Kritikas refuse to part with Kartikay, who also does not wish to leave with Mahadev and Parvati.

videos.title: The Kritikas bid farewell
videos.overview: The Kritikas persuade Kartikay to go with Mahadev and Parvati. Mahadev, in return, grants a boon to the Kritikas. They bid farewell to Kartikay. Meanwhile, Tarakasur’s sons create three new planets.

videos.title: Mahadev saves Kartikay
videos.overview: Tarakasur sends Badhvanal to kill Kartikay. However, Mahadev rescues Kartikay from danger. Meanwhile, Indradev is worried by Parvati’s desire to keep her son away from trouble forever.

videos.title: Taraksur meditates to Lord Brahma
videos.overview: Parvati is unhappy when Kartikay refuses to become a warrior and informs her that he is scared of Tarakasur. Meanwhile, Tarakasur meditates to get boons from Lord Brahma.

videos.title: Kartikay agrees to fight
videos.overview: Mahadev sends Nandi, transformed as a tiger, to attack Parvati and Kartikay. Kartikay bravely fights the tiger. Mahadev then assures Kartikay that he will be able to defeat Tarakasur and decides to train him.

videos.title: Mahadev trains Kartikay
videos.overview: Mahadev starts Kartikay’s training and orders him to compete with Nandi. Kartikay gives tough competition to Nandi. Meanwhile, Tarakasur’s father and Tare offer their support to fight the Devas.

videos.title: Kartikay passes Mahadev's tests
videos.overview: Kartikay passes Mahadev’s test and receives blessings from him and Nandi. Lord Vishnu suggests that Mahadev should appoint Kartikay as Senapati. Meanwhile, Tarakasur’s army plots against the Devas.

videos.title: Parvati blesses Kartikay
videos.overview: Parvati offers her blessings to Kartikay so he can defeat Tarakasur. Lord Vishnu appoints Kartikay as Senapati and teaches him his duties. Tarakasur’s father becomes furious as Kartikay vows to fight Tarakasur.

videos.title: Kartikay challenges Mahadev
videos.overview: Kartikay becomes over-confident about his powers and challenges Mahadev to fight him. Meanwhile, Indradev and the deities worry, while Tarakasur engages in intense meditation. They request Brahma not to grant him boons but Brahma refuses to listen to them.

videos.title: Kartikay and Tarakasur's battle
videos.overview: Mahadev challenges Kartikay to fight with one of the Shivgans. The Shivgan defeats Kartikay, who realises his mistake and apologises. After severe penance, Tarakasur receives a boon from Brahma. Tarakasur and Kartikay’s armies engage in battle.

videos.title: Kartikay kills Tarakasur
videos.overview: Tarakasur creates a Suraksha Vyuh and challenges Kartikay to reach him. Kartikay penetrates the Vyuh and is injured in the process. But he eventually succeeds in killing Tarakasur as Mahadev motivates him to accomplish the purpose of his life.

videos.title: Tarakasur's father vows revenge
videos.overview: Mahadev receives appreciation from everyone and Parvati calls him the best husband. Kartikay thanks everyone for their help in defeating Tarakasur. Meanwhile, Tarakasur’s father vows revenge against Kartikay. Indradev brags about himself after Tarakasur’s death.

videos.title: Kartikay finds a bow
videos.overview: Narad Muni suggests that Indradev’s position in heaven should be given to Kartikay. Mahadev disapproves and comforts his dejected son. In the meantime, Tare vows to avenge his father’s death.

videos.title: Indradev insults Kartikay
videos.overview: Indradev takes credit for defeating Tarakasur and insults Kartikay. Narad Muni orders Indradev to wait for Kartikay to sit on the throne. Meanwhile, Lord Vishnu informs Lakshmi that the bow will play a major role during Kartikay’s avatar as Ram.

videos.title: Meenakshi receives a boon
videos.overview: Meenakshi wishes to marry Mahadev, who informs her that he is already married to Parvati and grants her a boon. While Parvati apologises to Mahadev for being jealous, a dejected Kartikay leaves for Kritika Lok alone.

videos.title: Kartikay kills Tare
videos.overview: Kartikay visits the Kritika Lok but gets upset when they treat him as Senapati instead of their son. Tare challenges Kartikay to a fight. Kartikay accepts and kills Tare. Mahadev accuses Kartikay of cruelty.

videos.title: Mahishasur receives his orders
videos.overview: Kartikay is tormented by the killing and vows not to engage in any fights without Mahadev’s permission. Meanwhile, Tarakasur’s father assigns Mahishasur to kill Kartikay. Mahishasur sets out to kill Kartikay but becomes fascinated by Parvati’s beauty.

videos.title: Parvati kills Mahishasur
videos.overview: Mahishasur misbehaves with Parvati, who become furious and assumes the form of Mahishasur Mardini. She kills Mahishasur and apologises to Mahadev for her deeds. Mahadev, Brahma, Vishnu, Lakshmi, and Narad Muni praise Parvati.

videos.title: Kartikay meets Nav Durgas
videos.overview: Kartikay shares his feelings with Nandi and requests him to keep it a secret. Indradev dreams about Kartikay occupying his throne. Kartikay decides to set out in search of truth. Mahadev advises Kartikay to introduce himself to the Nav Durgas.

videos.title: Indradev's plans
videos.overview: Kartikay apologises to Mahadev and Parvati and assures them he will never let them down. Narad Muni cautions Indradev to apologise to Kartikay. However, Indradev plots to kill Kartikay. Meanwhile, Vajrang plots to attack Tarakasur’s son.

videos.title: Indradev attacks Kartikay
videos.overview: Indradev sends Indriyan to attack Kartikay, who fights them. He informs them that he has no fascination for Indradev’s throne. Vajrang sends demons in the disguise of Devas to attack Tarakasur’s son.

videos.title: Mahadev grants Bruk a boon
videos.overview: Kartikay asks a demon to warn Tripat to be careful. Bruk impresses Mahadev with his devotion and receives a boon to kill as he pleases. He kills innocent beings and sets out to heaven to test his powers. Narad warns Indradev about Bruk.

videos.title: Mohini lures Bhasmasur
videos.overview: Bhasmasur attempts to test his power on the gods but fails. He is fascinated by Parvati and decides to burn Mahadev. But Vishnu transforms into Mohini, who lures Bhasmasur with her dance and kills him.

videos.title: Tarakuasur's sons support Vajrang
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu sends Narad to invite Mahadev to a council. Tarakasur’s son plans to kill 1 lakh devotees of Mahadev in an attempt to stop Vajrang from committing suicide. Meanwhile, Kartikay plans to fight Tripat.

videos.title: Mahadev rescues his followers
videos.overview: Vidyunmali and his brothers kidnap Mahadev’s followers to kill them. Mahadev informs Brahma and Vishnu that they have to destroy the Tripurs to save the devotees. Mahadev rescues his followers from the demons. Parvati, using her powers, brings her daughter into existence.

videos.title: The gods seek Mahadev's blessings
videos.overview: The gods seek Mahadev’s blessings to fight the demons. Parvati teaches her daughter Ashok Sundari how to worship the Shivaling. Raja Bali refuses to take part in the fight against the Devas.

videos.title: Mahadev is overwhelmed
videos.overview: Mahadev traps Tarakasur’s son and destroys Tripur. Vishnu renames Tripur as Ujjain. Meanwhile, Ashok Sundari curses the demon to be killed by Nahush. Mahadev is overwhelmed when he meets Ashok Sundari.

videos.title: Durvasa curses Indradev
