videos.overview: Durvasa is furious when Indradev brags about himself and insults Mahadev. He curses Indradev. Meanwhile, Kartikay and his soldiers engage in battle with Tripat’s army. Lord Vishnu gives the name Tripurari to Mahadev.

videos.title: Kartikay kills Tripat
videos.overview: Kartikay kills Tripat. Meanwhile, Bali steals the Amrit Kalash and Indradev attempts to get it back. The Kalash falls into an ocean. Mahadev instructs Indradev to join the demons for Samudra Manthan.

videos.title: Indradev conspires against demons
videos.overview: Bali agrees to Samudra Manthan, on Mahadev’s request. Indradev plans to snatch the Amrit from the demons after the Manthan. Nandi and Shivgans decide to consume the poison with Mahadev but Parvati assigns them to look after Ashok Sundari.

videos.title: The Amrut Manthan Begins
videos.overview: The gods and the asuras assemble for the Samudra Manthan. Lord Brahma requests Lord Vishnu to take on the kurma avatar and begin the manthan. Vasuki becomes the rope and Mandar Parvat, the Mathani. Lord Indra plays a clever game. The asuras find it difficult as Vasuki starts spewing fire. The gods and asuras panic as the poison starts spreading.

videos.title: Mahadev consumes the poison
videos.overview: Mahadev drinks all the poison to save the gods and the demons. Parvati puts her hand around Mahadev’s neck to stop him from swallowing the poison. Lord Brahma names Mahadev ‘Neelkanth’.

videos.title: The demons deceive the gods
videos.overview: Mahadev leaves for Kailash as he senses a fight brewing between the gods and the demons. Three of the demons deceive the deities and steal the Amrit Kalash. Vishnu, disguised as Mohini persuades the demons to share the Amrit with the gods.

videos.title: Rahu betrays Lord Vishnu
videos.overview: Bali and Indradev agree to share the Amrit when Mohini threatens to throw it in the ocean. Mahadev punishes the three Devas and Vishnu splits Rahu’s neck after he deceives them and consumes the Amrit. Vishnu gives the Amrit Kalash to the gods.

videos.title: Parvati enlightens the Devas
videos.overview: Mahadev rebukes Varundev, Agnidev and Indradev for not realising the importance of the Amrit. Parvati enlightens the gods about Mahadev’s power.  Mahadev asks Indradev to repent for his sin.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Ashok Sundari
videos.overview: Mahadev narrates Hiranyakashyap and Prahalad's story to Ashok Sundari. He also enlightens Ashok Sundari with the knowledge of Agni Tapasya. Ashok Sundari and Kartikay express a desire to meet.

videos.title: The happy reunion
videos.overview: Kartikay is delighted to meet his family during their visit to the South. Parvati thanks Meenakshi for taking care of her son. Kartikay cherishes the moments he spends with Ashok Sundari.

videos.title: Kartikay is helpless
videos.overview: Kartikay expresses his helplessness to Mahadev who admires him for performing his duties. Brihaspati warns Indradev not to challenge Mahadev. Upmanyu receives blessings from Mahadev and Parvati.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Ashok Sundari
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens Ashok Sundari about Tapasya. Indradev sends a fairy to destroy Kartikay’s powers. The fairy fears Indradev and seeks Kartikay’s help to meditate and rescue herself from the demons.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Parvati
videos.overview: Ashok Sundari devotes herself to Tapasya. Mahadev enlightens Parvati about Ashok Sundari’s commitment and predicts her future. While the fairy conspires against Kartikay on Indradev’s insistence, Mahadev and Parvati offer their blessings to Ashok Sundari.

videos.title: Narad Muni apologises to Mahadev
videos.overview: Narad Muni suggests that Parvati should tie Mahadev to the Kalpavriksha and donate it to Sanat Kumar. He panics when Vishnu enquires about his idea and apologises to Mahadev.  Meenakshi and Kartikay decide to make Devsena stay at their place.

videos.title: Brahma's sons take Mahadev away
videos.overview: Parvati welcomes Sanaka, Sanatana, Sanandana and Sanatkumara and hands over Mahadev to them after tying him to the Kalpavriksha. However, she panics when they take Mahadev away. She pleads with them to return him to her.

videos.title: Lord Brahma's orders
videos.overview: Lord Brahma orders his son to release Mahadev. But Mahadev conveys to him that he has to go with them for a reason. Parvati disguises herself as an old woman and conveys to Brahma’s son that the world needs Mahadev. Brahma’s son is unhappy to let Mahadev go.

videos.title: Brahma's son lets Mahadev go
videos.overview: Brahma’s son decides to give Mahadev back to Parvati. Mahadev instructs Rishi Gautam to create Nyayasutra. Later, Menavati apologises to an angry Mahadev.

videos.title: Indradev in Rishni Gautam's house
videos.overview: Indradev is furious after learning about Gautam’s Nyayasutra. He disguises himself as Rishi Gautam and enters his house in his absence. Mahadev is angered by Indradev’s immoral act.

videos.title: Rishi Gautam's curse
videos.overview: Rishi Gautam curses Indradev and Ahilya. Indradev apologises to Parvati, who refuses to forgive him. Meenakshi persuades Devsena to express her feelings for Kartikay. Meanwhile, the Devas quarrel over taking Indradev’s throne in his absence.

videos.title: Parvati's son comes into being
videos.overview: Brahma informs Narad that Parvati and Mahadev’s son will come into existence and maintain the balance in the universe. Parvati’s new son is created and calls her mother.

videos.title: Parvati names her son Vinayak
videos.overview: Parvati explains to Vinayak that he has come into existence to remove the troubles of the world. Everyone congratulates Parvati, who is upset by Mahadev’s absence. She accepts Indradev’s apology.

videos.title: Vinayak's teachers are arranged
videos.overview: Parvati promises the Sant Kumars that they will be Vinayak's teachers. She assigns Nandi and the Shivgans to take care of Vinayak. Meanwhile, Devsena is in a dilemma about expressing her feelings to Kartikay.

videos.title: Vinayak rescues the rats
videos.overview: Vinayak orders the rats to steal laddoos for him but they get caught by the Shivgans. Parvati decides to send Vinayak to study, but Narad advises her to wait till Mahadev’s return.

videos.title: Mahadev completes Tapasya
videos.overview: Brahma informs Saraswati of Mahadev’s return after completing his Tapasya. Kartikay is displeased with Vinayak’s birth, while Lord Brahma and Lord Vishnu discuss Vinayak with Mahadev.

videos.title: Parvati's orders for Vinayak
videos.overview: Parvati prepares to welcome Mahadev back. She orders Vinayak to guard the door while she takes a bath. Vinayak orders the rats to bring laddoos for him.

videos.title: Vinayak stops Mahadev
videos.overview: The deities are thrilled with Mahadev’s return. Mahadev proceeds to meet Parvati but Vinayak, guarding the door, stops him from meeting her because he has to uphold the promise he made to his mother.

videos.title: Vinayak challenges the gods
videos.overview: Nandi and the Shivgans fail to convince Vinayak to let Mahadev meet Parvati. Vinayak challenges all of them to dislodge him and reach Parvati. They all fail.

videos.title: Mahadev chops off Vinayak's head
videos.overview: Vinayak defies the gods and defeats them. They seek Mahadev’s help. He orders Vinayak to stop the battle, but the obstinate son attacks Mahadev. An angry Mahadev beheads Vinayak with his trident.

videos.title: Mahadev revives Vinayak
videos.overview: Parvati is devastated as Mahadev kills Vinayak. She becomes furious and starts destroying the universe when Mahadev informs her that he cannot revive her son. Mahadev fixes an elephant’s head to Vinayak’s body.

videos.title: Parvati and Vinayak apologise
videos.overview: Parvati apologises for putting the world in danger and Vinayak apologises for his angry behaviour. Vishnu assures Parvati that people will worship Vinayak in his new form. Devsena reveals to Kartikay that she was sent by Indradev to trap him.

videos.title: Mahadev renames Vinayak
videos.overview: Parvati and Mahadev offer their blessings to Vinayak. Mahadev changes Vinayak’s name to Ganesha. Vishnu announces that Ganesha will also be known as Mangal Murti. Meanwhile, Baamdev curses Gandharvaraj for not obeying him.

videos.title: Parvati prepares modaks
videos.overview: Parvati prepares modaks for Ganesha while Mahadev enlightens him about spirituality. Meanwhile, Baamdev curses Gandharvaraj and turns him into a rat. Brihaspati advises him to proceed to Kailash. Mahadev awaits Kartikay’s visit to Kailash.

videos.title: Ganesha's request to Mahadev
videos.overview: Ganesha gifts Mahadev a dress. He requests Mahadev to wear it and Mahadev gladly does so. Ganesha, Parvati and the Shivgans are astonished to see Mahadev dressing up.

videos.title: A rat becomes Ganesha's Vaahan
videos.overview: Ganesha rescues people from a wicked rat’s terror and brings it before Mahadev for punishment. Mahadev sentences the rat to be Ganesha’s mode of transport.

videos.title: The Ghushmeshwar Jyotirling
videos.overview: Ghushm, a worshipper of Mahadev, loses her son, who is killed by her sister out of jealousy. Even during her son’s death, she worships Mahadev, who is impressed by her devotion. He revives her son and establishes Ghushmeshwar Jyotirling.

videos.title: Ganesha prepares kheer
videos.overview: Ganesha visits the villages and orders the rats to arrange for some food. He then learns that there is scarcity of food in the village and decides to prepare kheer for the villagers. The villagers show their gratitude to Ganesha.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens rishis
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens the Rishis about spiritual knowledge. Parvati teaches Ganesha the importance of worship. Ganesha decides not to have food until he completes his worship. Meanwhile, Daruka prays to Parvati seeking a boon for the demons.

videos.title: Parvati grants a boon to Daruka
videos.overview: Parvati becomes impressed by Daruka’s worship and grants her a boon. She makes Daruka the ruler of Daruka Van. Meanwhile, Ganesha refuses to have food until Mahadev gives him what he wants.

videos.title: Daruka misuses Parvati's boon
videos.overview: Daruka takes advantage of Parvati’s blessings and behaves ruthlessly with Mahadev’s devotees. The devotees seek Mahadev’s help. In the meantime, Ganesha expresses his desire to meet his siblings.

videos.title: Ganesha meets Ashok Sundari
videos.overview: Ganesha leaves Kailash to meet Ashok Sundari. He promises to bring Ashok Sundari with him to Parvati. Meanwhile, Daruka orders her soldier to kill Mahadev's devotees. Mahadev comes to their aid and warns Daruka, who in turn, prays to Parvati.

videos.title: The Nageshwar Jyotirling
videos.overview: Parvati is angry with Daruka for misusing the boon and advises her to seek Mahadev’s forgiveness. While Mahadev establishes Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, Ganesha learns that Ashok Sundari is doing Tapasya to marry Nahush. He goes to Nahush’s palace with the proposal and is insulted.

videos.title: Ayu and his soldiers apologise
videos.overview: Ayu apologises to Ganesha, who puts forth Ashok Sundari’s proposal. Ayu requests Ganesha to meet Nahush and discuss it with him. Meanwhile, Mahadev assures Parvati that Ganesha will bring back Ashok Sundari.

videos.title: The meeting with Ashok Sundari
videos.overview: Nahush and his parents meet Ashok Sundari. Ayu promises to get Nahush married to Ashok Sundari when he becomes eligible for marriage. Mahadev is impressed by his devotees Aahuk and Aahuka and grants them a boon that they will take birth as King Nal and Queen Damayanti.

videos.title: Parvati and Mahadev are overwhelmed
videos.overview: Parvati and Mahadev are excited to welcome Ashok Sundari back to Kailash. Mahadev sets off to bring Kartikay back to Kailash. He then informs a dejected Kartikay that he had an irreplaceable place in their hearts.

videos.title: Indradev incites Kartikay
videos.overview: Indradev feels threatened about Kartikay and Ganesha’s reunion. He incites Kartikay against his family. While Kartikay rebukes Indradev for his selfishness, Mahadev warns Ganesha against angering Kartikay. Meanwhile, Bali arranges a Mahayagya.

videos.title: Ganesha and Kartikay have a race
videos.overview: Kartikay arrives in Kailash and is happy to be reunited with his family. He gets jealous when Mahadev describes Ganesha’s greatness. Later, Ganesha and Kartikay decide to race.

videos.title: Mahadev is angry at Indradev
videos.overview: Mahadev warns Indradev not to cross his limits. Kartikay enlightens Ganesha with knowledge of war and brags about himself. Mahadev asks his sons not to let anybody disturb his meditation.

videos.title: Parshuram attacks Ganesha
videos.overview: Parshuram comes to Mahadev but Ganesha denies him entry. Kartikay introduces Parshuram to Ganesha, who offers his apologies but still denies entry. An angry Parshuram attacks Ganesha.

videos.title: Kartikay disapproves of Ganesha
videos.overview: After Ganesha's trunk is broken, a guilty Parshuram asks Mahadev to punish him for attacking his son. Vishnu suggests that Ganesha should be worshipped before everyone. Kartikay disapproves of the decision. Parshuram declares that Ganesha will write an epic with his broken tusk.

videos.title: Ganesha is announced the winner
videos.overview: Ganesha and Kartikay prepare for the race. During the race, Indradev cheats by capturing Kartikay. Meanwhile, Ganesh worships the Shivaling. Kartikay completes the race, but Mahadev announces Ganesha as the winner.

videos.title: Ganesha's reward
videos.overview: Mahadev is impressed with Ganesha and announces that he will be worshipped before any of the deities. Kartikay objects to his father’s decision and leaves Kailash.

videos.title: Parvati is worried about Kartikey
videos.overview: Ganesha assures a worried Parvati that he will bring Kartikay back. Mahadev orders Kartikay to return to Kailash. Kartikay feels guilty after Ganesha consoles him and vows to return to Kailash after he makes amends.

videos.title: Mahadev can't enter Kailash
videos.overview: Ganesha vows not to return to Kailash without Kartikay. Parvati is furious when Mahadev returns alone. Mahadev decides not to enter Kailash as Parvati warns him she will leave if her sons don’t return. Meanwhile, Kartikay feels guilty for treating Ganesha as a competitor.

videos.title: Vishnu helps Ganesha
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu assures Ganesha that he will convince Kartikay to return to Kailash. He informs Kartikay that being Tarakasur’s killer is the reason for his trouble and advises him to worship Mahadev. Parvati realises that Mahadev is hurt by her behaviour.

videos.title: Kartikay constructs a Shivaling
videos.overview: Parvati is determined to turn Mahadev from an ascetic into a social being. Mahadev decides to test Kartikay and appears in front of Kartikay and Ganesha in the disguise of a weak, helpless old man. Ganesha tends to Kartikay’s wound as he attempts to make a Shivaling.

videos.title: Mahadev tests Kartikay
videos.overview: Kartikay donates the Shivaling to the old man and passes Mahadev’s first test. Mahadev challenges Kartikay to answer his questions before he makes another Shivaling. Kartikay answers all the questions correctly and makes a Shivaling out of the rocks and donates it to the old man again.

videos.title: Kartikay passes the tests
videos.overview: Mahadev informs Kartikay that he has passed all the tests and establishes the Shivalings made by him as Pratigyeshwar, Kapileshwar and Kumareshwar. Meanwhile, Sumali believes that the demons will dominate after Hiranyakashyap’s rebirth.

videos.title: Parvati refuses to comb her hair
videos.overview: Parvati orders her sons to start preparations for Ashok Sundari’s marriage. She vows not to comb her hair until Mahadev fixes his own. Meanwhile, Sumali is elated to see Ravan, Kumbhakarna and Vibhishan doing Tapasya.

videos.title: Indradev's request to Brahma
videos.overview: After failing to sabotage Dashanan’s Tapasya, Indradev approaches Brahma and requests him not to give him any boons. Meanwhile, Parvati is determined to make Mahadev abandon his asceticism and become social.

videos.title: Ganesh wants a comb for Parvati
videos.overview: Ganesha requests Mahadev to make a comb for Parvati. Meanwhile, Dashanan, Vibhishan and Kumbhakarna ask him for boons.

videos.title: Mahadev completes Ganesha's wish
videos.overview: While Mahadev grooms Parvati, Dashanan cuts off his heads one by one to please him with his devotion. Indradev panics as he learns of Dashanan’s Tapasya. As a boon, Dashanan requests Mahadev to name him as his greatest devotee.

videos.title: Dashanan gets a boon
videos.overview: Mahadev grants the boon to Dashanan that he will become famous as his greatest devotee. Indradev learns that Dashanan is not a threat to him. Meanwhile, Mahadev and his family decide to have food, when it starts raining.

videos.title: Mahadev's family dine in the rain
videos.overview: Mahadev persuades his family to have food in the rain. Parvati suggests that they should build a house for their children, but Mahadev refuses. Parvati turns down Menavati’s gifts since she does not have a house to keep them in. Meanwhile, Rishi Markandeya decides to build a palace for Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev visits Kuber's palace
videos.overview: Mahadev informs the rishis that he wishes to make Kuber use his wealth for the welfare of the world. He visits Kuber’s palace disguised as a saint. Kuber instructs Dashanan to remove all the Vastu defects from his palace. Meanwhile, Menavati assures Parvati that Mahadev will build a house for them.

videos.title: Dashanan yearns to meet Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev appoints Kuber as the guardian of wealth. While Dashanan yearns to see Mahadev, Parvati assures Ganesha that Mahadev will construct a house for them. She decides to tell Mahadev about it.

videos.title: Mahadev's representative
videos.overview: Kuber invites Mahadev and his family to a banquet. Mahadev sends Ganesh as the family’s representative. Dashanan becomes upset as Kuber informs him of Mahadev’s absence.

videos.title: Ganesha eats all the food
videos.overview: Ganesha eats all the food prepared for the banquet and demands more. Kuber informs him that the food is finished. An upset Ganesha eats all of Kuber’s wealth and threatens to eat him too. Mahadev and Parvati arrive at Kuber’s palace when he seeks their help.

videos.title: Mahadev grants Parvati's wish
videos.overview: Kuber realises that his desire for wealth will never die and asks Mahadev for a second chance. Mahadev grants him the boon of being worshipped along with Ganesha. Mahadev allows Parvati to construct a house. Meanwhile, Sumali unites with Hund to kill Nahush.

videos.title: The search for the right house
videos.overview: Ganesha and Kartikay set out on a world tour in search of the best house. Narad suggests that Parvati should construct a house of her own. Meanwhile, Shanidev decides to visit Kailash.

videos.title: Parvati creates a replica
videos.overview: Parvati orders Mahadev to sit outside Kailash to prevent Shanidev from entering. She creates a replica of Kailash in an attempt to save it from Shanidev’s evil eyes. Meanwhile, Ganesha and Kartikay meet Nahush at Rishi Vashishtha’s ashram.

videos.title: Sumali orders an attack
videos.overview: Parvati breaks down as her dream of living in a house fails to come true. Mahadev confronts Parvati and reminds her of the vows they took during their wedding. Sumali instructs Marich to attack Vashishtha’s ashram.

videos.title: Parvati assumes the form of Kali
videos.overview: Mahadev is angry at Bhim for forcing him to appear in front of him. Ashok Sundari visits Vashishtha’s ashram to meet Nahush. Sumali’s soldier disguises himself as Ashok Sundari and lures Nahush and burns the ashram. Parvati transforms into Kali to save Ashok Sundari and the ashram.

videos.title: Vashishtha recieves boon
videos.overview: Mahadev grants a boon to Rishi Vashishtha so he can become Lord Vishnu’s guru. Vashishtha advises Kartikay and Ganesha to go north to find the best house. Ashok Sundari requests Parvati to make Nahush eligible for marriage using her powers.

videos.title: Mahadev announces the world's end
videos.overview: Mahadev is furious as Ganga complains that people are soiling her water. Mahadev warns people that they are doomed and that the time has come for the destruction of the world. Lord Vishnu request Mahadev to reconsider his decision.

videos.title: Ganga agrees to flow again
videos.overview: Ganga agrees to flow again as Vishnu and Brahma request Mahadev to forgive the people. Kartikay and Ganesha find the ideal house, which was made by Dashanan and decide to take him to Kailash.

videos.title: Dashanan is overwhelmed
videos.overview: Kartikay arrives at Kailash and informs Parvati that Ganesha and Dashanan are coming with a replica of their house. Dashanan applies ash from a pyre on his body and is overwhelmed to see Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev is impressed
videos.overview: Mahadev is impressed with Dashanan and blesses him. Nandi forbids Dashanan from building the mansion in Kailash but he sticks to his decision. Nahush’s parents seek Parvati’s permission for their son's marriage.

videos.title: Nandi panics
videos.overview: Dashanan instructs Nandi to not interfere in his matters. Mahadev assures Parvati that he will protect Nahush. Nandi panics as Mahadev and Parvati argue regarding Ashok Sundari’s marriage.

videos.title: Dashanan seeks Vishwakarma's help
videos.overview: Dashanan requests Vishwakarma to help him build a palace in Kailash. He requests Kuber to provide golden bricks for the palace. Meanwhile, Nahush’s parents send Shagun for Ashok Sundari and a letter for Mahadev.

videos.title: Nahush becomes an adult
videos.overview: Mahadev permits Parvati to make Nahush grow into an adult and agrees to Ashok Sundari’s marriage. Nahush grows into an adult with Parvati’s help. Ganesha prepares for Ashok Sundari’s marriage.

videos.title: Dashanan insults Nandi
videos.overview: Dashanan insults Nandi when he enquires if he is building a golden palace. He offers a golden seat to Mahadev for his meditation but he refuses to use it. Nandi requests Dashanan to allow them to contribute to building the palace, but he orders Nandi to stay away.

videos.title: Parvati inaugurates the palace
videos.overview: Dashanan requests Mahadev to inaugurate the palace, but Mahadev orders Parvati to do it. Mahadev enters the palace with his family and the Shivgans and examines every corner of the palace.

videos.title: Dashanan takes away the palace
videos.overview: Parvati instructs Dashanan to accept the dakshina. He requests the palace along with the dakshina thinking he would get Mahadev also. Parvati realises that they do not need the house and returns it to Dashanan.

videos.title: Dashanan wants to punish himself
videos.overview: Dashanan punishes himself for not being able to fulfil Mahadev’s desire. He wishes to win his heart. Indradev seeks Narad’s help in curbing Dashanan’s powers. Ganesha suggests Rishi Vashist’s ashram as the venue for Ashok Sundari’s wedding.

videos.title: Ashok Sundari's enlightenment
videos.overview: Parvati orders Nandi to bring turmeric from Nahush’s house. Mahadev and Parvati donate Shabala to Vashishtha who provides the necessary items for the marriage rituals. Mahadev and Parvati enlighten Ashok Sundari about marital life.

videos.title: Nandi brings turmeric
videos.overview: Nandi brings turmeric from Nahush’s palace. Ganesha, Kartikay, and Parvati apply turmeric on Ashok Sundari. Mahadev comforts Parvati as she worries about Ashok Sundari’s marital life.

videos.title: Vasishtha welcomes the party
videos.overview: Maharishi Vasishtha welcomes Ashok Sundari and her relatives and feels proud to host the wedding. All the gods arrive for the marriage along with Lord Vishnu, who worships Ganesha first as per the rituals.

videos.title: Nahush's marriage
videos.overview: Nahush and Ashok Sundari exchange garlands in front of the guests. Mahadev asks Nahush if he can look after his daughter the same way Vishnu takes care of Lakshmi. Nahush completes the ritual by applying vermilion on Ashok Sundari’s forehead.

videos.title: Ashok Sundari bids farewell
videos.overview: Nahush and Ashok Sundari seek the elders' blessings. She bids her family farewell with teary eyes. While Parvati thanks Vasishtha for the arrangements, Ganga bids farewell to Mahadev’s family. Indradev panics as Dashanan does Tapasya to please Mahadev. Meanwhile, Sumali tries to kill Nahush.

videos.title: Nahush kills Hund
videos.overview: Nahush and Ashok Sundari travel to the forest to perform Kuldevi puja. While Hund attacks Nahush, Kartikay and Ganesha protect Ashok Sundari. Mahadev feels proud when Nahush kills Hund. He then tells Parvati that Vishnu will face trouble because of the five Apsaras.

videos.title: Mahadev plays the veena
videos.overview: Mahadev plays the veena for Parvati. Lakshmi learns that her sisters are in Tapasya to marry Vishnu. Vishnu informs Lakshmi that he mostly meditates on her. Lakshmi’s sisters decide to commit suicide as Vishnu fails to appear before them.

videos.title: Vishnu stays with Apsaras
videos.overview: Goddess Lakshmi orders Vishnu to keep her in his heart but he tells her it is impossible. Lord Vishnu agrees to forget Lakshmi and his past and stays with the Apsaras. A devastated Lakshmi seeks Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev and Vishnu fight
videos.overview: Lakshmi realises that she was wrong to suspect Vishnu and pleads to Mahadev to bring back her Lord. Mahadev leaves to Patal Lok in Vrishabh’s disguise. Vishnu and Mahadev engage in a fight which goes on for years. Lord Brahma worries as Vishnu attacks Mahadev with Narayana Astra.

videos.title: Mahadev and Parvati remarry
videos.overview: Ganesha reminds Lord Vishnu about his identity with the help of the Apsaras. Goddess Lakshmi thanks Mahadev and Ganesha for bringing Vishnu back. Ganesha requests Mahadev and Parvati to remarry. Mahadev and Parvati then perform the rituals and are remarried.

videos.title: Parvati's moments with Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev transforms a desert into a lush green land and names it ‘Parvati Van’. Parvati and Mahadev spend time together there and she cherishes those moments.

videos.title: Indradev panics
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens Parvati about the importance of love. Nandi informs a worried Ganesha that his parents are spending time away from Kailash. Meanwhile, Indradev panics after seeing Trishula’s tapasya.

videos.title: Ganesha plays the drum
videos.overview: Indradev visits Kailash to seek Mahadev’s help but Ganesha sends him back. A furious Indradev sabotages Trishula’s tapasya with help from the Apsaras. Meanwhile, Ganesha plays the drum on Narad Muni’s request.

videos.title: Parvati wants a bouquet
videos.overview: Parvati requests Mahadev to gift her a bouquet consisting of flowers from all the seasons. She informs him that she will forget her past if he fails. Mahadev promises to return with the bouquet before the tree they planted grows.

videos.title: Indradev attacks Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati sends a message to Mahadev through the clouds while Mahadev collects flowers for her. He makes her a garland out of flowers. Meanwhile, Indradev kills the Apsaras when he fails to kill Trishula. Mahadev, in disguise, blocks Indradev’s way to teach him a lesson and Indradev attacks him.

videos.title: Indradev is sorry
videos.overview: Indradev apologises to Mahadev for his mistakes. Mahadev orders him to repent for his sins. Parvati is overwhelmed to meet Mahadev after a long gap. She requests him to decorate her hair with the flowers, but he soon finds out that the flowers have turned to ash.

videos.title: Parvati forgets Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati forgets everything about Mahadev and disappears. Mahadev returns to Kailash alone. He informs everyone in Kailash that Parvati has lost her memory. Narad Muni reports the incident to Naresh and Menavati and advises them not to remind Parvati of it.

videos.title: Ganesha wants Parvati back
videos.overview: Ganesha asks for Mahadev’s permission to bring Parvati back to Kailash. Parvati’s ten forms separate from her to approach Mahadev and get directions from him. She draws a dancing posture of Shivshakti while making rangoli. Meanwhile, a child comes into existence from Mahadev’s energy.

videos.title: Parvati doesn't remember Ganesha
videos.overview: Kartikay confronts Mahadev. While Mahadev orders him to perform his duties, Naresh and Menavati request Vishnu to help them restore Parvati’s memories. Vishnu informs them that Ganesha is coming to help them but Ganesha is devastated as Parvati fails to recognise him.

videos.title: Ganesha prays
videos.overview: Ganesha is tormented when Parvati fails to recognise him. He prays to Mahadev to restore Parvati’s memory. Parvati confronts Mahadev, who advises her to identify herself through her perception. She becomes speechless after Mahadev stabilises her.

videos.title: Indradev is scared of Jalandhar
videos.overview: Parvati is distressed after meeting Mahadev, who tries to remind her about her past. Mahadev decides to bring back Parvati’s memory using Yogvidya. Indradev is frightened by Jalandhar, born of Mahadev’s energy. Jalandhar helps him pull out his chariot from the mud.

videos.title: Jalandhar defeats the gods
videos.overview: Parvati keeps on reminiscing about her meeting with Mahadev. Ganesh visits Naresh in Gunesh’s disguise and informs him his guru is staying near Naresh’s kingdom and that Parvati is seeking a guru. Indradev attempts to kill Jalandhar and orders the gods to arrest him.

videos.title: Parvati feeds Ganesha
videos.overview: Parvati visits Swami Adiyogi’s ashram. Ganesha requests her to feed him as a ritual and is overwhelmed. Meanwhile, Matsyakanya sings Jalandhar a lullaby and comforts him when he has a nightmare. Indradev fails to threaten Jalandhar.

videos.title: Swami Adiyogi tests Parvati
videos.overview: Swami Adiyogi orders Parvati to meditate through her perception. Parvati finds it difficult to do so. She agrees to give the test on Ganesha’s insistence and passes it with his help. Jalandhar’s mother dies while trying to protect him from Indradev’s attack.

videos.title: Mahadev is impressed by Parvati
videos.overview: Mahadev is impressed when Parvati passes the test. Parvati expresses her gratitude to Swami Adiyogi. Jalandhar wishes to take revenge on Indradev for his mother’s death. Samundra Dev forbids Jalandhar from supporting Shukracharya.

videos.title: Jalandhar performs the last rites
videos.overview: Jalandhar conducts his mother’s funeral. He decides not to rest until he avenges her death. He meditates in water and returns as a powerful man. Meanwhile, Ganesha suggests Parvati should wait for Swami Adiyogi till he agrees to come to the palace.

videos.title: Adiyogi agrees for a visit
videos.overview: Swami Adiyogi agrees to visit the palace. Ganesha provides Parvati a list to start the arrangements for his visit. Meanwhile, Shukracharya tests Jalandhar’s powers.

videos.title: Jalandhar plans to unite demons
videos.overview: Jalandhar decides to unite the demons and informs Shukracharya about the same. Parvati welcomes Swami Adiyogi and thanks him for the visit. Adiyogi requests Parvati to return after taking a bath.

videos.title: Jalandhar's vow
videos.overview: Parvati bathes repeatedly and is ordered to leave for Kashi in order to meet Prajapati Daksh. Jalandhar unites the demons. Shukracharya is shocked to learn that he has vowed to defeat Swarnasur. Jalandhar then requests Shukracharya to reveal his mother’s killer's name.

videos.title: Mahadev rescues Parvati
videos.overview: Ganesha accompanies Parvati to Kashi. While Mahadev rescues her from the demons, Indradev informs Brahma and Vishnu that he wants to save himself from Jalandhar. Lakshmi rebukes him for killing Jalandhar’s mother. Meanwhile, Swarnasur vows to support Jalandhar.

videos.title: Jalandhar learns the truth
videos.overview: Shukracharya informs Jalandhar about his mother’s killer. He throws Indradev off the Airavat and takes the elephant with him. While Jalandhar defeats Ugrasur, Utpal and Vidal kidnap Parvati but she regains her powers and kills her kidnappers.

videos.title: The new king of Asuras
videos.overview: Shukracharya names Jalandhar the king of Asuras. He promises the Asuras they will regain their lost honour and respect by defeating the Devas. Mahadev instructs Ganesha to take Parvati to Dadhichi’s ashram, where she fails to recognise the Shivaling.

videos.title: Jalandhar insults Narad
videos.overview: While Jalandhar insults Narad Muni, Indradev insults the messenger sent by Jalandhar to get the gems he received during Samudra Manthan. Swami Adiyogi meets Parvati. Meanwhile, Dadhichi recognises Swami Adiyogi and seeks his blessings.

videos.title: Parvati serves the rishis
videos.overview: Parvati serves food to the rishis and they are elated. Dadhichi and Adiyogi are impressed with Parvati. Shukracharya worries upon seeing Jalandhar preparing for war.

videos.title: Swarnasur attacks Jalandhar
videos.overview: Jalandhar reveals that his second son Uktaasur is alive and wants to take revenge on Indradev. Swarnasur attacks Jalandhar and injures him. Vrinda tends to his injuries. Mahadev learns about Parvati’s distraction while meditating. Parvati reminisces about Sati and breaks down.

videos.title: Mahadev plans to kill Apasmaar
videos.overview: Jalandhar requests Vrinda to address him as Asur Raj. Vrinda becomes lost in thoughts of Jalandhar. Mahadev informs Apasmaar that he will kill him. Apasmaar provokes Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev kills Apasmaar
videos.overview: Mahadev performs Tandav Nritya and kills Apasmaar. He then informs Narad Muni that he cannot kill Jalandhar alone and that Parvati will help him once she regains her memory.

videos.title: Adiyogi enlightens Parvati
videos.overview: Jalandhar and Vrinda fight about worshipping Lord Vishnu. Meanwhile, Swami Adiyogi informs Ganesha that Parvati will regain her memory after completing Ashtanga Yoga. He enlightens Parvati about the asanas.

videos.title: Jalandhar asks Vrinda to join him
videos.overview: Jalandhar fights with Vritrasur and admires his warrior skills. He appoints Vritrasur as the commander of his army. Jalandhar warns the Asurs to be careful about the Devas' deceit. He then orders Vrinda to accompany him to war.

videos.title: Dadhichi's wife has a nightmare
videos.overview: Parvati requests Adiyogi to reunite Ganesha with his mother. Maharishi Dadhichi’s wife has a nightmare and wishes to meet Mahadev, who asks her to have faith in him. He assures her that nothing would happen without his wish. Meanwhile, Jalandhar waits for Vrinda to start the war.

videos.title: Dadhichi donates his body
videos.overview: Jalandhar attacks the Devas. Indradev panics on seeing the loss and seeks Mahadev’s help. Maharishi Dadhichi decides to donate his body for the betterment for the universe. He informs Indradev that he can kill Vritrasur by creating a weapon out of his bone.

videos.title: Shukracharya's decision
videos.overview: Mahadev advises Dadhichi to talk to Swarcha before sacrificing his life. Shukracharya decides to get Vrinda married to Jalandhar. Vrinda informs Shukracharya that Indradev could be seeking Trimurti’s help.

videos.title: Jalandhar praises Kartikay
videos.overview: Dadhichi seeks Mahadev’s permission before sacrificing his life. Indradev orders Vishwakarma to make a weapon out of Dadhichi’s spine. Mahadev instructs Kartikay to lead the Devas' army. Jalandhar praises Kartikay’s skills.

videos.title: Indradev stabs Vritrasur
videos.overview: Indradev stabs Vritrasur in the back. Kartikay is surprised to find Mahadev’s resemblance in Jalandhar. Kartikay returns the Vajrayudha to Swarcha. Shukracharya enlightens Jalandhar about Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev thanks Swarcha
videos.overview: Jalandhar decides to defeat the Trimurtis. Indradev apologises to Lord Vishnu and seeks his help. Mahadev thanks Swarcha for taking care of Parvati and assures him that his blessings will always be with her.

videos.title: Jalandhar refuses to help Vrinda
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu refuses to help Indradev. Jalandhar requests Shukracharya to help him fight the gods. Vrinda informs him that she will help the injured. Jalandhar informs her not to expect any help from him. Parvati thanks Swarcha for her hospitality.

videos.title: Indradev orders an attack
videos.overview: Indradev directs the archers to attack Jalandhar’s army. Vrinda is stunned to learn of Indradev’s attack on the medical camp. Jalandhar runs to save Vrinda. Meanwhile, Nandi becomes upset when Parvati fails to recognise him.

videos.title: Mahadev transforms into Mahakaal
videos.overview: Jalandhar takes an arrow to save Vrinda and fumes at the gods. Shukracharya insists that Jalandhar should marry in order to save his army. Mahadev enlightens Parvati about Pranayama. He later tells Vishnu that he will transform into Mahakaal.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Parvati
videos.overview: Nandi worries as Dushan attacks Ujjain. Vrinda is disheartened to learn that her father has chosen Sarpmani as her groom. While Jalandhar is furious, Mahadev enlightens Parvati about Shambhavi and instructs his sons to take care of her.

videos.title: The Mahakaleshwar Jyotirling
videos.overview: Mahadev kills Dushan and establishes Mahakaleshwar Jyotirling in Ujjain.Lord Vishnu assures Indradev that he will support him in battle. Meanwhile, Jalandhar informs Vrinda’s father that he will marry her. Sarpmani refuses to marry Vrinda as he is scared of Jalandhar.

videos.title: Vrinda marries Jalandhar
videos.overview: Jalandhar informs Vrinda that he will not die if she marries him. Vrinda accepts Jalandhar as her husband. Indradev realises that his powers are useless in front of Jalandhar. Meanwhile, Parvati loses consciousness as she attempts to recollect her past. Mahadev then enlightens her about her past.

videos.title: Mahadev's appearance
videos.overview: Jalandhar marries Vrinda. Narad provokes him to attack Tridev. Lakshmi attempts to make Jalandhar realise the importance of Tridev but Jalandhar boasts about his powers and insults Mahadev. Mahadev then appears before Jalandhar.

videos.title: Jalandhar learns about his brith
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens Jalandhar about his birth and convinces him to make proper use of his powers. But Jalandhar is unhappy and informs him that he will challenge Tridev. Indradev apologises to Mahadev and tries to provoke him against Jalandhar.

videos.title: Parvati recalls her past
videos.overview: Parvati recollects her past and becomes emotional. Shukracharya enlightens Jalandhar about Mahadev with the Lingo Bhava story. He informs Jalandhar that Mahadev alone cannot kill him as Jalandhar is a part of Mahadev.

videos.title: Indradev provokes Jalandhar
videos.overview: Indradev provokes Jalandhar against Mahadev. Jalandhar is shocked to find out that Shukracharya is a devotee of Mahadev. Mahadev enlightens Parvati about Chinmayi Mudra. Meanwhile, Lakshmi praises Mahadev’s patience.

videos.title: Jalandhar's shock
videos.overview: Jalandhar is depressed to learn that Shukracharya is a devotee of Mahadev. He orders Shukracharya to gather all the gods, especially Kuber and Yamraj. Mahadev admires Kartikay’s battle skills and enlightens Parvati about Pratyahar Mudra.

videos.title: Chitt Shuddi Sadhana
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens Parvati about Chitt Shuddhi Sadhana. Meanwhile, Samudradev informs Jalandhar that Mahadev will not be able to use his powers against him unless Parvati regains her memory. Yamraj promises to support Jalandhar to defeat Mahadev.

videos.title: Jalandhar has a nightmare
videos.overview: Jalandhar has a nightmare, in which Vrinda and his mother are burnt alive. He suspects that Mahadev is conspiring against him. Meanwhile, Ganesha worries whether Parvati will recognise him as her son.

videos.title: Jalandhar's attack on Brahmlok
videos.overview: Jalandhar provokes his army to fight against Trimurti and plans to attack Brahmlok. Parvati recognises Kartikay and Ganesha as her sons and emotionally recollects her past. Mahadev agrees to meet his family at Amarnath Kendra. Shukracharya fails to convince Jalandhar that Mahadev will not treat him as an enemy.

videos.title: Jalandhar tries to attack Mahadev
videos.overview: Shukracharya is shocked to learn that Jalandhar has reached Brahmlok. Jalandhar attempts to attack Mahadev, but fails. Jalandhar fumes at Vrinda for bowing down to Mahadev, who assures her that she will be worshipped as an ideal wife forever.

videos.title: Parvati meditates
videos.overview: Parvati thanks Mahadev for his guidance. He tells her that they now need to find the last stage of meditation, Samadhi. While meditating, Parvati gets flashes of being in the cave before. Will she regain her memory?

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Parvati
videos.overview: While Ganesha and Kartikay guard the cave, Mahadev also gets into Samadhi to help Parvati remember who they are. Jalandhar asks Shukracharya about Mahadev's strengths and weaknesses. Shukracharya narrates Parshuram's story and asks him to become Mahadev's devotee.

videos.title: Mahadev begins his meditation
videos.overview: Parshuram is furious with Jalandhar and sends him to Rishi Markand to seek answers to his questions. Rishi Markand tells Jalandhar about Sati and her re-birth as Parvati. By the time Mahadev reaches Kailash for his Samadhi, Parvati has already entered hers. Mahadev begins his meditation with Nandi by his side.

videos.title: Jalandhar enters the cave
videos.overview: Jalandhar emerges from his Jal Samadhi and Shukracharya tells him about a weapon that can be used only once. Jalandhar, disguised as Swami Adiyogi, manages to enter the cave, where Parvati is meditating. He uses the weapon Shukracharya gave him on her. What will Mahadev do?

videos.title: Jalandhar abducts Parvati
videos.overview: Jalandhar takes Parvati to an imaginary world. Shukracharya asks him to take her to Mahadev and apologise, but he refuses. Meanwhile, Yamraj attacks Kailash with his army of demons. Jalandhar also learns that he needs Adishakti to destroy Mahadev and become the only immortal.

videos.title: Shukracharya leaves Jalandhar
videos.overview: Yamraj orders Mrityu Devi to kill Kartikay and she challenges Kartikay to a fight. Meanwhile, Ganesha whispers all that is happening in Nandi's ears so that it will reach Mahadev. Shukracharya decides to leave Jalandhar as he has broken his promise. Will Mahadev emerge from his Samadhi?

videos.title: Vrinda prepares for a puja
videos.overview: Vrinda is upset with Jalandhar for kidnapping Parvati. He tells her that he will use Parvati as a weapon against Mahadev. As Vrinda prepares for a puja, Narad Muni tells Lord Vishnu that Jalandhar will become immortal if she completes the puja.

videos.title: Kartikay fights Yamraj
videos.overview: Vrinda starts the puja to make Jalandhar invincible. But Lord Vishnu disguises himself as Jalandhar and performs the puja with her. On the battleground, Kartikay orders Yamraj to leave Kailash. Yamraj gets angry and makes the Devas unconscious. Who will win the battle?

videos.title: Vrinda kills herself
videos.overview: Vrinda breaks down on learning that Lord Vishnu sat beside her during the puja. She curses him and commits suicide. Jalandhar is furious on learning that Lord Vishnu duped Vrinda and caused her death. Meanwhile, Mahadev brings Yamraj back to life.

videos.title: Shukracharya becomes Shukrawar
videos.overview: Jalandhar performs Vrinda's last rites. He tries to kill Parvati, but stops when he remembers Vrinda's words. He vows to avenge her death. Shukracharya apologises to Mahadev for supporting Jalandhar. Mahadev blesses him and he is declared Shukrawar, the fifth day of the week.

videos.title: Kartikay falls in battle
videos.overview: Jalandhar and Kartikay attack each other. Kartikay is beaten but he bounces back and keeps striking Jalandhar before his wounds heal. Jalandhar tricks and diverts Kartikay's attention using his powers. Kartikay finally falls unconscious.

videos.title: Jalandhar challenges Mahadev
videos.overview: Nandi, who takes Kartikay’s place in the battle, becomes unconscious and falls. Jalandhar challenges the gods to defeat him. Ganesha decides to fight him and Mahadev becomes furious on seeing Ganesha also on the ground. Jalandhar then challenges Mahadev.

videos.title: Parvati is angry
videos.overview: Parvati is furious with Jalandhar when he tells her how he fought and defeated her sons. Meanwhile, Jalandhar is confused about challenging Mahadev, who asks him to release Parvati. How will the battle between Jalandhar and Mahadev end?

videos.title: Parvati on the battle field
videos.overview: Jalandhar survives Mahadev's attack, but is shocked to see Parvati on the battle field. On seeing Shiva and Shakti together, Jalandhar realises the end is near for him. Mahadev enlightens Jalandhar about Karma. He tells him that he has disgraced Shukracharya and is responsible for his own death.

videos.title: The end of Jalandhar's journey
videos.overview: When Jalandhar accuses Mahadev of not guiding him, Mahadev responds that he was always helping Jalandhar without his knowledge. But now it's time for Jalandhar's journey to end. He burns and merges with Mahadev's third

videos.title: Dashanan begins to meditate
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati are reunited and spend some time together. Meanwhile, Lakshmi becomes worried about Vrinda's curse on Lord Vishnu. Dashanan meditates upon Mahadev. Shurpanakha tells Vibhishana that she suspects that Dashanan wants to impress Mahadev for his own benefit.

videos.title: Mahadev and Parvati return
videos.overview: Kailash is decorated for Mahadev and Parvati, and the gods welcome them back to their abode. Indradev seeks forgiveness from Mahadev. Meanwhile, Dashanan continues to meditate on Mahadev. He tells his grandfather, Sumali, that he wants to bring Mahadev to his golden palace.

videos.title: Dashanan visits Kuber
videos.overview: When Indradev apologises to Mahadev for his past actions, Mahadev enlightens him about Karma. When Kartikay refuses to be the king of the Devas, they choose Nahush.  In Kuber's place, Dashanan asks him for his Pushpak Viman to visit Kailash.

videos.title: Dashanan lifts Kailash
videos.overview: At Kailash, Dashanan misunderstands Nandi and insults him. Nandi is shocked on learning about the purpose of his visit. A saint from Kashi informs Mahadev about a demon wanting to destroy the Vedas. Dashanan lifts Kailash to take Mahadev with him.

videos.title: Dashanan is named Ravana
videos.overview: Dashanan impresses Mahadev with his devotion. In return, Mahadev blesses him and says he will be known as Ravana. He also gives him a sword, known as Chandrahas. Mahadev and Parvati begin their journey for Kashi. Will Mahadev prevent the destruction of the Vedas?

videos.title: Mahadev saves a sage
videos.overview: In Kashi, Mahadev saves a sage from Dudumbhi's tyranny. Devi Saraswati tells Lord Vishnu about Vyagreshwarling. Mahadev wants Ravana to spread the knowledge of the Vedas through music. Ravana happily agrees, but insists Mahadev join him.

videos.title: Ravan's Wish Shocks All
videos.overview: Happy with Ravan's devotion, Lord Brahma blesses him with immortality. In Kailash, Ravan asks Mahadev to fulfil his wish, which he had granted him earlier. But Ravan's wish leaves everybody shocked.

videos.title: Mahadev gives Ravana a Shivaling
videos.overview: Mahadev gives Ravana a Shivaling to take back with him. Ravana does not accept it and insists that he wants to take home Mahadev in his true form. Nandi tries to make him realise his mistake. What will Ravana do?

videos.title: Ganesha tries to stop Ravana
videos.overview: Parvati turns emotional as Mahadev has to leave Kailash. He transforms into a Shivaling which Ravana takes with him. Ganesha tries to stop Ravana from taking Mahadev to Lanka.

videos.title: Ganesha tricks Ravana
videos.overview: Disguised as Baiju, Ganesha tricks Ravana and gets the Shivaling. He places it on the ground and the spot comes to be known as Baijnath, where Mahadev devotees can worship him. What will Ravana do now?

videos.title: Ravana undergoes a change
videos.overview: Ravana gets angry when he learns it was Ganesha who cheated him. Nandi advises Bhringi not to differentiate between Mahadev and Parvati, as they are one. While, Durgasur plans to attack Kailash in the absence of Mahadev, Ravana announces that his good side has died.

videos.title: Parvati teaches Bhringi a lesson
videos.overview: Mahadev explains the concept of Shiv-Shakti to Bhringi, but he continues to only worship Mahadev. Parvati teaches him a lesson which makes him accept her. Impressed with Muni Vishwanar's devotion, Mahadev grants him a wish.

videos.title: Durgasur fights with the gods
videos.overview: Narad Muni informs Lord Vishnu that Durgasur has planned to attack Trilok. Durgasur and the gods engage in a fierce battle and Durgasur captures Trilok. Sumali provokes Ravana against Mahadev. Ravana then accuses Mahadev of cheating him.

videos.title: Durga slays Durgasur
videos.overview: Durgasur attacks Mahadev simultaneously in Kashi and Kailash. Parvati takes the form of Goddess Durga and kills him. Ravana destroys his palace and swears to make mankind suffer. Mahadev and Parvati advise Ganesha and Kartikay about their duties.

videos.title: Kumbhakarna is woken up
videos.overview: Vrinda's curse on Lord Vishnu continues to trouble Devi Lakshmi. She seeks Narayan's guidance on this. Meanwhile, Ravana wakes Kumbhakarna from his long slumber and orders him to cause trouble to mankind.

videos.title: Mahadev is upset
videos.overview: While Ravana continues to misuse his powers, Ganesha uses his to save the girls from the demon Narantak. In Lanka, Mahadev talks to Ravana and asks him to not trouble mankind. But Ravana is on the path of destruction.

videos.title: Mahadev saves people from Ravana
videos.overview: Prajapati Vishwaroop requests Mahadev to get Ganesha and Kartikay married to his daughters, Siddhi and Buddhi. But Parvati asks him to wait till Ganesha and Kartikay return from Gurukul. Ravana's army tries to kill the men who constructed his palace. Mahadev saves them and asks them to fight Ravana.

videos.title: Mahadev takes a different form
videos.overview: Parvati welcomes Ganesha and Kartikay on their arrival at Kailash. Mahadev transforms into a common man to save the people from Ravana's torture. Mahadev explains to them the importance of unity and motivates them to fight against Ravana.

videos.title: Ravana releases the men
videos.overview: On Mahadev's request, Ravana releases the men from his captivity but requests him not to interfere in his kingdom. As Kartikay prepares to leave, Parvati tries to convince him to stay till Ganesha's marriage. Ganesha says he will only get married if Kartikay attends his marriage.

videos.title: Kartikay apologises to Parvati
videos.overview: On returning to Kailash, Mahadev is greeted by Ganesha. Narantak's brother Devantak, tries to keep Ganesha in captivity but fails to do so. Kartikay apologises to Parvati for hurting her feelings. He agrees to attend Ganesha's wedding.

videos.title: Kartikay's marriage is planned
videos.overview: Mahadev establishes Mallikarjuna Jyotirling. Indradev sends Devsena to divert Kartikay's attention. Lord Brahma accepts Devsena as his daughter and requests Mahadev to get her married to Kartikay. Will Kartikay agree?

videos.title: Ravana is angry
videos.overview: Parvati and Mahadev apply haldi on Ganesha. Lord Vishnu enlightens Ganesha about the importance of marital life. Ravana is furious on learning that Mahadev did not invite him to Ganesha's marriage. Ganesha arrives at Prajapati Vishwaroop's palace, along with the wedding procession.

videos.title: Ganesha's wedding
videos.overview: Prajapati Vishwaroop welcomes Ganesha. Mahadev asks Vishwakarma to lead with the wedding rituals. Mahadev recalls his wedding with Parvati. Ganesha promises that he will take care of his wives forever. Mahadev and Parvati bless Ganesha, Siddhi and Buddhi.

videos.title: Ganesha enlightens the gods
videos.overview: Prajapati Vishwaroop organises a gathering to discuss the concept of knowledge. Mahadev asks Ganesha to preside over the meeting. Ganesha enlightens the gods about Karma and destiny. Meanwhile, Ravana apologises to Pitamah for his behaviour.

videos.title: Ravana marries Mandodari
videos.overview: Kartikay gets married to Devsena in Brahmalok. Ravana visits Maydanav's palace where Mandodari catches his attention. He tells Maydanav that he wants to marry her. Ravana and Mandodari get married. Ravana soon learns why Mandodari agreed to marry him.

videos.title: Vishnu stops Mahadev
videos.overview: Ravana's attraction for Vedvati worries Devi Lakshmi. He asks Vedvati to become his devotee. She refuses and decides to sacrifice her life. Mahadev requests her not to, but she goes ahead. Mahadev decides to kill Ravana but Lord Vishnu stops him and tells him how his death will come about.

videos.title: Mahadev blesses Kaushalya
videos.overview: Mahadev informs Parvati, Ganesha and Kartikay about their future in human avatar. Pitamah tells Ravana that Kaushalya will give birth to the person who will kill him. Mahadev blesses Kaushalya to give birth to Lord Vishnu's next avatar.

videos.title: Ganesha saves Kaushalya
videos.overview: Disguised as a flower-seller, Ravana attacks Kaushalya. He throws her off a hill, but Ganesha saves her. Mahadev assures Dasharatha that Kaushalya will conceive Lord Vishnu's next avatar.

videos.title: Mahadev meets Janaka
videos.overview: Ravana is unaware that Kaushalya is still alive. Pitamah also hides the truth from him. Mahadev, disguised as a sage, meets Janaka. He turns emotional on recognising Mahadev and Parvati. Mahadev informs him that he will father a girl. Will Janaka's daughter be Devi Lakshmi's human avatar?

videos.title: The birth of Lord Rama
videos.overview: Lord Rama, a Vishnu avatar, is born as Kaushalya and Dasharatha's son. Mahadev prepares the new-born's Janampatrika. Kaikeyi gives birth to a son and Sumitra gives birth to twins. An elated Dasharatha seeks blessings from Mahadev and Parvati.

videos.title: Ravana attacks Yamraj
videos.overview: Rishi Vashistha names Dasharatha's sons, Rama, Lakshmana, Bharatha and Shatrughna. Meanwhile, Ravana's plans of capturing the nine planets in worry Mahadev. Ravana attacks Yamraj and defeats him. Mahadev informs the gods that he will be a true devotee of Lord Rama in another reincarnation.

videos.title: Dasharatha is cursed
videos.overview: Mahadev foresees Dasharatha's misfortune and warns him. Dasharatha kills Shravan Kumar. On learning about Shravan Kumar's death, his father curses Dasharatha that the king, too, will cry for lost sons.

videos.title: Janaka finds a baby
videos.overview: Dasharatha ignores Rishi Vashistha's advice to send his sons to Gurukul and asks him to tutor them in the palace. Meanwhile, Rahu and Ketu surrender to Ravana, but Surya Dev, Chandra Dev and Mangal Dev refuse and are taken captive. Janaka finds a baby girl while ploughing the earth. Mahadev names her Sita.

videos.title: Mahadev grants Mandodari a wish
videos.overview: Mahadev hands over a bow to Janaka and informs him that only Sita will be capable of lifting it. Scared of curse, Dasharatha refuses to send his children away. While Mandodari tries to stop Ravana from capturing the nine planets, she is also granted a wish by Mahadev.

videos.title: Shani Dev occupies Lanka
videos.overview: Ravana keeps Shani Dev captive for his own benefit. Shukracharya and Brihaspati destroy Ravana's Mayavi vyuh and release the planets. Shani Dev refuses to leave Lanka until he destroys Ravana.

videos.title: Vishwamitra becomes Rama's guru
videos.overview: Taraka destroys Vishwamitra's yagna. Mahadev himself teaches Lord Rama archery. He also asks Vishwamitra to become guru to Lord Rama and Lakshman. Ravana is furious, seeing his Mayavi vyuh destroyed.

videos.title: Lord Rama leaves with Vishwamitra
videos.overview: Dasharatha sends Lord Rama and Lakshmana to Gurukul. Dasharatha, Kaushalya, Kaikeyi and Sumitra bless the two princes as they leave. On the way, Vishwamitra narrates the story of Samudra Manthan and explains why Mahadev is called Neelkanth.

videos.title: Lord Rama worships Parvati
videos.overview: Taraka explains to Mahadev why she spoilt Vishwamitra's yagna. She suspects the Rishi is conspiring against her. Meanwhile, Lord Rama and Lakshman worship Parvati at Parvati Van. In Janak's palace, Sita and her sisters, Mandavi, Urmila and Shrutakeerti are trained in Sanskriti.

videos.title: Rama disobeys his guru
videos.overview: Vishwamitra teaches Rama and Lakshman various battle skills. Taraka learns of the same and increases her guards. As Rama and Lakshman get better at archery, Vishwamitra asks them to target a bird. But Rama refuses and upsets his teacher.

videos.title: Taraka attacks Vishwamitra
videos.overview: Vishwamitra tells Lord Rama him about Taraka and about the purpose of his training. But when Rama hesitates to kill a woman, Mahadev clears his confusion. Parvati, meanwhile, makes Lord Rama understand Karma. As Vishwamitra starts his yagna, Taraka and her demons attack him.

videos.title: Rama kills Taraka
videos.overview: Lord Rama kills Taraka. But before she dies, he tells her why he had to take her life. Mahadev praises Lord Rama for maintaining Vishwamitra's dignity and blesses him. Lord Brahma gifts the Brahmastra to Lord Rama.

videos.title: Sita learns about marriage
videos.overview: Sita uses the Shiv Dhanush to feed the hungry saints. Janaka apologises to Mahadev for this. Vishwamitra tells Lord Rama and Lakshmana that they have to participate in Dhanush Yagna. Janaka explains the importance of marriage to Sita.

videos.title: Parvati blesses Sita
videos.overview: Sita performs Gauri puja and Parvati comes to bless her. Sita and Lord Rama pay their tribute to the Ganga at the same time. What mistake did Rishi Gautam make that Lord Rama had to correct?

videos.title: Lord Rama goes to Mithila
videos.overview: Lord Rama helps Rishi Gautam reconcile with his wife, Devi Ahilya. Meanwhile, Sita performs Gauri puja and shares her reasons for doing so with Parvati. In Mithila, Janaka welcomes Rishi Vishwamitra, Lord Rama and Lakshman. How will Lord Rama and Sita meet?

videos.title: Lord Rama and Sita meet
videos.overview: Lord Rama and Sita finally come face to face. Parvati learns all the details of the meeting from Mahadev. Seeing her husband in Rama, Sita seeks Parvati's blessings. Parvati, meanwhile, longs to meet her sons. Will Mahadev fulfil her desire?

videos.title: Parvati visits Kishkindha
videos.overview: Ravana intends to be a part of Sita's Swayamvar. Mandodari objects, but Ravana does not listen. Meanwhile, Parvati visits Kishkindha along with Ganesha and Kartikay to meet Mahadev's son, Pawan Dev. They meet Anjani, who pays her respect to Mahadev for bestowing her with a son.

videos.title: Lord Rama and the Shiv Dhanush
videos.overview: Narad worries about Ravana's next plan. While Meghnath provokes Ravana further, Mahadev assures Narad that Ravana will not be able to do anything. Lord Rama takes Gurudev's blessing and seeks his advice on the Shiv Dhanush. Will Lord Rama be able to lift the bow?

videos.title: Indradev attacks Maruti
videos.overview: Anjani shares the stories about Maruti with Ganesha, Kartikay and Parvati. In the meantime, not knowing Maruti's true identity, Indradev attacks him. Mahadev brings him back to life as Hanuman. On hearing about Hanuman, Parvati and Ganesha desire to meet him.

videos.title: Rama meets Sita in the forest
videos.overview: On Vishwamitra's request, Lord Rama sets out for the forest to fetch some flowers for the havan. In the forest, he meets Sita, who pretends to be in search of a deer. Lord Rama stays with her and accompanies her back to the palace.

videos.title: Parvati learns about Hanuman
videos.overview: On hearing Hanuman's stories from Mahadev, Parvati wonders how he will help Lord Rama. In Mithila, as Lakshman collects fruits for Lord Rama in the forest, Urmila suspects he is stealing and attacks him. Will Lord Rama come to Lakshman's rescue?

videos.title: Ravana wants Sita
videos.overview: Hanuman continues to trouble the sages with his questions and Brighu Maharishi curses him. As Sita frets about who her husband will be, Parvati blesses her and asks her not to worry. Despite Mandodari's objection, Ravana plans to bring Sita to Lanka.

videos.title: Sita's Swayamvar
videos.overview: Janaka welcomes the guests to Sita's Swayamvar. The kings try to lift Mahadev's bow, but they all fail. Sunayna worries about Sita finding a husband. Sita is sad on learning that Lord Rama is a guest and not a participant. Will Ravana lift the bow?

videos.title: Ravana is at the Swayamvar
videos.overview: Sita prays to get married to Lord Rama. Parvati wishes to help Sita but Mahadev stops her. Ravana interrupts the Swayamvar and announces that only he is capable of lifting the bow. Janaka permits Ravana to participate in the Swayamvar. Will he win Sita's hand?

videos.title: Ravana fails to lift the bow
videos.overview: Mahadev predicts Ravana's failure. Ravana uses all his power to lift Mahadev's bow, but fails. He gets angry and declares nobody can lift the bow. Lakshman tells Janaka about Lord Rama's strength. Rishi Vishwamitra wants Janaka to give Lord Rama an opportunity to lift the bow.

videos.title: Lord Rama wins at the Swayamvar
videos.overview: Janaka permits Lord Rama to lift Mahadev's bow. Rishi Vishwamitra and Mahadev bless him and he proves his strength by lifting Mahadev's bow. Amidst praises of Lord Rama, he marries Sita.

videos.title: The Shiv Dhanush is broken
videos.overview: The destruction of Mahadev's bow angers Parshuram and he seeks an explanation from Janaka. Lord Rama apologises to Parshuram, who decides to test him. Meanwhile, an angry Ravana blames Mahadev for his defeat.

videos.title: Ravana insults Narad Muni
videos.overview: While Janaka thanks Mahadev for making Sita's Swayamvar successful, Ravana plans his next move. Narad tries to console him, but gets insulted instead. In Ayodhya, Dasharatha and Kausalya learn about Lord Rama's marriage with Sita. Is everybody happy with the news?

videos.title: Ravana plans to kill the rishis
videos.overview: Ravana's attack on the rishis angers the gods and Mahadev. Ravana orders the asuras to take revenge for his defeat by killing the rishis. To save the rishis, Lord Brahma decides to perform a yagna and seeks Mahadev's support.

videos.title: Manthara poisons Kaikeyi's mind
videos.overview: Lord Brahma starts his yagna. Even as Mahadev and Parvati support him, Ravana tries to ruin the yagna. In Ayodhya, Manthara provokes Kaikeyi to conspire against Lord Rama. Dasharatha reaches Mithila and praises Lord Rama for obeying his guru and making Sita's Swayamvar successful.

videos.title: The rishis are saved from Ravana
videos.overview: Even as Ravana attempts to ruin the yagna, Mahadev and Parvati help to make it successful. Lord Brahma and the deities thank them for saving the rishis. Meanwhile, on Dasharatha's request, his other sons marry Janaka's daughters.

videos.title: Hanuman worships Mahadev
videos.overview: Hanuman advises the Vanaras about their way of living. He prays to Mahadev to help him find answers to his questions. He then seeks Anjani's blessing and leaves towards the sun. Why does Indradev get worried seeing this?

videos.title: Hanuman seeks out Suryadev
videos.overview: Suryadev worries on seeing Hanuman approach him. Hanuman wants to become his disciple and seek knowledge from him. At first, Suryadev refuses, but later gives him a task to perform. He agrees to become his guru if he succeeds in the task.

videos.title: Rama and Sita in Ayodhya
videos.overview: Suryadev imparts knowledge to Hanuman, who expresses his gratitude to his guru. In Ayodhaya, Dasharatha and Sunayna welcome Lord Rama and Sita and bless them. Meanwhile, a child is born when Parvati covers Mahadev's eyes. This worries Lord Brahma and all the gods.

videos.title: Andhaka is born
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Parvati that since she did not heed his advice, their powers have created a blind child, Andhaka. He worries about his existence. Hiranyaksha adopts the child, not knowing that Andhaka will be responsible for the death of one of his sons.

videos.title: Mahadev worries about Andhaka
videos.overview: Parvati tries to please Mahadev and asks Lord Brahma for help. Brihaspati tries to persuade Mahadev to reconcile with Parvati, but he is lost in his worries about Andhaka. The gods pray to Parvati to help Mahadev.

videos.title: Darkness and light
videos.overview: Parvati urges Mahadev to give up his silence for the welfare of the universe. Mahadev agrees to emerge from that state. The gods are informed that the future will have both light and darkness, and that everybody has to learn how to balance both.

videos.title: Andhaka refuses to accept Mahadev
videos.overview: Aware of the destruction that will be caused by Andhaka, Narad also wants him dead. Mahadev tells him why that cannot be done. Narad educates Andhaka about Mahadev. Andhaka refuses to accept Mahadev and intends to rule the world with his power.

videos.title: Mahadev blesses Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman gets restless as he wants to know his purpose in life. Mahadev blesses him and asks him to be patient. Dasharatha decides to make Lord Rama the king of Ayodhaya. But this worries Mahadev and the gods as it would defeat Lord Rama's purpose on earth.

videos.title: Andhaka pleases Lord Brahma
videos.overview: Andhaka sacrifices his blood and eyes to please Lord Brahma. Lord Brahma blesses him and grants him a wish. In Ayodhaya, Manthara influences Kaikeyi to use a boon granted to her and make Bharath the king of Ayodhaya. What will Kaikeyi do?

videos.title: Bharath as king of Ayodhya
videos.overview: Lord Brahma worries on seeing the destruction caused by Andhaka and shares his concerns with Mahadev. Meanwhile, On Kaikeyi's insistence, Dasharatha agrees to make Bharath the king of Ayodhya. What will Lord Rama do?

videos.title: Dasharatha is ill
videos.overview: Andhaka boasts of his power in front of Mahadev. Indradev blames Mahadev for the destruction caused by Andhaka. In Ayodhaya, Lord Rama worries about Dasharatha's health and promises Kaikeyi that he will go for Vanvaas soon.

videos.title: Parvati advises Andhaka
videos.overview: Parvati decides to help Andhaka by showing him her motherly love. On hearing Andhaka, she advises him to go to the Himalayas and find his answers. Will the Himalayas change Andhaka's evil nature?

videos.title: Andhaka goes to the Himalayas
videos.overview: Nandi is called upon to look after his sick father. But he insists that he will go only after he has performed his duties to Mahadev. Meanwhile, on seeing Andhaka in the Himalayas, Parvati asks Shukracharya to accept Andhaka as his disciple.

videos.title: Shukracharya accepts Andhaka
videos.overview: Shukracharya promises Parvati that he will take care of Andhaka. However, he becomes disturbed on realising the state of Andhaka's mind. Mahadev asks Shukracharya to accept Andhaka as his disciple and guide him. Will Shukracharya succeed in showing Andhaka the right path?

videos.title: Andhaka has evil thoughts
videos.overview: Andhaka intends to attack Mahadev and gain Parvati's love. Shukracharya is enraged by Andhaka's thinking. Despite the guru's warnings, Andhaka goes ahead and asks Asuras to take his message to Mahadev. What will Mahadev do with Andhaka?

videos.title: Mahadev is furious with Andhaka
videos.overview: Mahadev gets angry at Andhaka for even thinking about taking Parvati away. Shukracharya apologises to Mahadev for his inability to correct Andhaka. As the news spreads, Indradev and other gods decide to kill Andhaka. But Mahadev and Parvati stop them.

videos.title: Mahadev takes on Andhaka
videos.overview: Andhaka reaches Kailash with his army. Kartikay vows to kill Andhaka, but Mahadev stops him. Andhaka attacks Mahadev's devotees and his children. Finally, when Mahadev comes to fight Andhaka, Shukracharya comes forward to protect him.

videos.title: Kali defeats Andhaka
videos.overview: To destroy Andhaka's evil side, Parvati transforms into Kali. She succeeds in defeating him. Andhaka repents and prays to Mahadev to end his life. However, Mahadev blesses him and asks him to start afresh. He cures Andhaka's blindness and educates him about Adishakti. Has Andhaka really learned his lesson?

videos.title: Kali's anger rages
videos.overview: Lord Brahma and Narad worry about Kali's anger. The deities find it difficult to pacify her. As Kali's anger starts destroying the world, Mahadev decides to take his Aghor form to control her. In Ayodhaya, Sita and Lakshman decide to go with Lord Rama for Vanvaas.

videos.title: Conflict of interests
videos.overview: On one hand, Rishi Bhrigu and Rishi Kashyap decide to calm Parvati down for the welfare of the universe by performing a hawan. Kali's devotees on the other hand, pray to her to stay in the terrifying form and protect them.

videos.title: Kali becomes Parvati again
videos.overview: Mahadev manages to calm Kali down. He succeeds in transforming her back to Parvati. Parvati apologises to Ganga for troubling her. But Kali's devotees are outraged and start torturing and killing innocent people. Will their devotion bring back Parvati's Kali avatar?

videos.title: Parvati leaves Kailash
videos.overview: Parvati expresses her gratitude to Mahadev for pacifying her. Mahadev tells her that he had to strive hard to rescue Ganga from Kali. He still feels that Kali has not completely transformed back into Parvati. What upsets Parvati so much that she decides to leave Kailash?

videos.title: Ganga is grateful to Mahadev
videos.overview: Kartikay discusses with Mahadev about Jalandhar and Andhaka's problem. Ganga expresses her gratitude to Mahadev for saving her life. But Parvati gets angry with Mahadev for showing such concern for Ganga and decides to leave Kailash.

videos.title: Ganga apologises to Parvati
videos.overview: Ganga apologises to Parvati for hurting her feelings. But seeing Parvati's anger, she leaves Kailash. Mahadev is also unable to control her anger. Parvati transforms herself into Bagalamukhi Devi.

videos.title: Parvati resumes the Kali form
videos.overview: Parvati becomes Kali again. Mahadev succeeds in calming her but she refuses to return to Kailash. On seeing the asuras' barbarity towards women, Parvati fights and kills them. She rescues the women and motivates them to always fight against injustice.

videos.title: Ganga's promise
videos.overview: Kali's devotees succeed in transforming Parvati back into Kali. Ganga apologises to Mahadev for annoying Parvati. She vows to bring her back to Kailash. Mahadev says that Parvati will return as per her wish. Will Ganga still try to bring Parvati back to Kailash?"

videos.title: Kali in the cave
videos.overview: Malla and Mani misuse their shakti tantra to bring Kali to their cave. They kill innocent people and perform rituals to please her. What will Mahadev have to do in order to bring Parvati back from her Kali state?

videos.title: Mahadev becomes Aghor
videos.overview: Malla and Mani capture Kali in an idol to get strength from her. Mahadev transforms himself into an aghori named Aghor. While Mani challenges Aghor to release Kali from their captivity, Malla decides to design a yantra to beat Aghor. What will Mahadev do?

videos.title: Ganga is captured
videos.overview: Ganga is determined to release Parvati from Malla and Mani. Lord Brahma worries about her and urges Mahadev to help her. Ganga warns Malla that she will destroy the universe if he does not release Parvati. Malla and Mani trap Ganga. Will Mahadev rescue her?

videos.title: Mahadev rescues Ganga
videos.overview: Malla and Mani rejoice on seeing Mahadev. They seek his blessing. Mahadev scolds them and takes Ganga with him. Ignoring Tugra's warning, Malla and Mani plan to destroy Aghor's yantra, with which he would have been able to free Kali.

videos.title: Mahadev comforts Ganesha
videos.overview: As Malla develops faith in Shweth Aghori's power, Tugra worries about Kali. Shweth Aghori warns Aghor not to challenge him, but Aghor fights and kills him. Ganesha and Kartikay worry about Parvati. Mahadev consoles them by telling them about the yantra that will be used against black powers.

videos.title: Nau Durga's Aradhana
videos.overview: Mahadev asks Ganesha and Kartikay to perform Nau Durga's Aradhana to pacify Parvati. Malla gets furious when he learns that Aghora defeated the tribals of the forest community and established Kali's idol in the area. He then makes another plan to attack Aghora.

videos.title: Malla after Aghora's life
videos.overview: Mahadev tells the rishis to perform aradhana for Parvati's release. Meanwhile, Malla heads out to attack Aghora and Lord Indra fails to stop him. Mani prays to Kali for Malla's victory. While rishis pray for Parvati's peaceful avatar, Mani prays for Parvati in her angry state.

videos.title: Malla vows to kill Aghora
videos.overview: In Kailash, Menavati tells Ganesha and Kartikay about Parvati's life and her avatars. Rishi Markandeya names Parvati's third incarnation, Chandragantha Devi. Meanwhile, Malla vows to kill Aghora. Indradev decides to help Aghora defeat Malla.

videos.title: Aghora fights the demon
videos.overview: Rajan hesitates, but agrees to release the demon on Malla's order. He plans to use the demon to kill Aghora. In the meantime, Mahadev transforms himself into a sage and requests a woman to accept and nurture the son of King Satyarth.

videos.title: Aghora saves the Kali idol
videos.overview: Aghora saves the Kali idol and defeats the demon. Malla learns about this and accepts his defeat. Malla and Mani now decide to fast for Mahadev. After killing the demon, Aghora preaches human values to the people who come to seek his blessings. But when will he free Kali from her captives?

videos.title: Rakshas Raj to kill Aghora
videos.overview: King Himavan names Parvati's fifth incarnation Skandamata. Rishi Brihaspati names Parvati's sixth incarnation as Katyayini. Mahadev gives his consent in letting Ganga name Parvati's seventh incarnation as Kaalratri. Malla orders Rakshas Raj to kill Aghora and fast for Mahadev to take his blessings.

videos.title: Mani seeks solution from Turga
videos.overview: Malla and Mani get angry when they learn of Rakshas Raj's defeat. Mani seeks a solution from Turga, but doesn't get any. The rishis name the eighth incarnation of Parvati as Gauri. Mahadev volunteers to name Parvati's ninth incarnation.

videos.title: Ravan kidnaps Sita
videos.overview: On Sita's request, Rama goes in pursuit of a golden deer. While he is away, Ravana arrives in disguise and kidnaps Sita. With the help of Hanuman and Mahadev's blessings, Rama kills Ravana and returns to Ayodhya with Sita.

videos.title: Parvati frees herself
videos.overview: As Aghora establishes the fourth idol of Kali, Malla and Mani make all attempts to stop Kali from leaving. They plan to form an army to defeat Aghora. But with the help of Aghora's meditation, Parvati frees herself from their captivity. Will she forgive Malla and Mani?

videos.title: Parvati refuses to return
videos.overview: Mahadev requests Parvati to return to Kailash, but she refuses. She decides to be reborn, as repentance for her misdeeds. Ganga also decides to take human form, to keep Parvati safe. Ganesha and Kartikay learn about Parvati's rebirth and take her blessings.

videos.title: Parvati is reborn as Mahalsa
videos.overview: Malla and Mani find Parvati, after she is born as a girl. They attack the mother and the baby. Ganga saves them. Mahadev names Parvati's human incarnation as Mahalsa. He decides to do sadhana for Mahalsa. Meanwhile, Malla and Mani plan to get Kali back.

videos.title: Mahalsa attacks Aghora
videos.overview: With Yella Koti's blessings, Mahalsa learns the art of warfare from Mangal. Malla and Mani do tapasya to please Lord Brahma and get Kali back. Mahalsa learns about Malla and Mani's whereabouts and she heads out to meet them. Aghora stops her, but she attacks him.

videos.title: Aghora disguises himself
videos.overview: Malla draws a line to detect Mahalsa's presence. Banai stops the fight between Aghora and Mahalsa. Aghora decides to disguise himself as Martand to please Mahalsa. Banai brings Martand to meet Mahalsa. He offers to marry her. But she refuses and insults him.

videos.title: Martand helps Mahalsa
videos.overview: Mahalsa gets to know about Malla and Mani's whereabouts. Martand helps her in finding them. Malla and Mani learn that Martand is Aghora in disguise. Malla orders his men to kill people responsible for sheltering him. How will Martand save Mahalsa and her mother?

videos.title: Martand saves Mahalsa
videos.overview: Martand saves Mahalsa and her mother from the fire. Mahalsa tells her mother about her mission to kill Malla and Mani. Meanwhile, Malla and Mani want Yelli Koti to predict Mahalsa's future so they can plan how to kill her.

videos.title: Mahalsa attacks Malla and Mani
videos.overview: Malla and Mani are determined to get Kali back. Yella Koti advises them to perform sadhana. But they get furious at him for not helping them in reviving Kali. Mahalsa reaches their cave and attacks them. Martand wants to help her but she refuses. Will she kill Malla and Mani?

videos.title: Mani disguises himself as Banai
videos.overview: Mani disguises as Banai and interrupts Mahalsa, while she fights with the Aghoris. Mani succeeds in trapping her. He tries to kill her, but Martand rescues her from him. Later, Mahalsa tells Martand that she has agreed to marry him. But this time, he refuses.

videos.title: Martand rallies the villagers
videos.overview: Martand motivates the villagers to fight against Malla and Mani. The villagers decide to make him their leader. As Yella Koti mesmerises the villagers with his music, Mangal leaves for Malla and Mani's cave to kill them. Ignoring Mahadev's warning, he reaches their cave.

videos.title: Mahalsa provides mukti to Mani
videos.overview: Malla and Mani torture Mangal and ask him to call Mahalsa but he refuses. Before dying, Mangal sees Mahadev in Martand. Martand multiplies himself and forms an army to fight Malla and Mani. With Mahadev and Parvati together in their human avatars, what will happen to Malla and Mani?

videos.title: Kali protects Malla and Mani
videos.overview: Malla prays to Mahalsa for his safety. Mahalsa transforms into Kali to protect her devotees. Martand transforms back into Aghora to pacify Kali and kill Malla and Mani, but she attacks him instead. What will happen to the world with Mahadev and Kali at war?

videos.title: Kali becomes a widow
videos.overview: Kali destroys Mahadev and becomes a widow. Ganesha and Kartikay urge Parvati to forgive Mahadev. Lord Vishnu tries to pacify Parvati and make her remember her relationship with Mahadev. Will Parvati regret her actions and revive Mahadev?
