videos.title: Parvati realises her mistake
videos.overview: Parvati realises her mistake and is lost in grief. She brings Mahadev back to life and repents for committing such a sin. On listening to Mahadev's prayer, Lord Vishnu reconciles with Parvati. Now, Lord Vishnu wants Malla, the one behind all this, to be killed.

videos.title: Mahalsa vows to kill Malla
videos.overview: The villagers are happy about Mani's death, but Malla is still alive. Mahalsa vows to kill him. Lord Vishnu asks Malla to correct the wrong he has done, but Malla refuses and swears to avenge Mani's death. Lord Vishnu asks Mahalsa to kill him. Mahalsa and Malla's armies get ready for war.

videos.title: Mahalsa and Malla's fight
videos.overview: Martand, Mahalsa and Yella Koti fight against Malla's armies. Malla is defeated by Mahalsa. He prays for his life and then attacks Martand. Martand succeeds in killing him. Now that Mahalsa's mission has been completed, will she and Martand get married?

videos.title: Martand and Mahalsa get married
videos.overview: Martand and Mahalsa get married. He promises to always take care of her. Ganesha and Kartikay learn that Mahalsa is returning to Kailash and prepare to welcome her. In Mahalsa's village, Mahadev installs an idol of himself. He asks the villagers to worship the idol as Khandoba Mahadev.

videos.title: Ganesh and Kartikey welcome Mahadev and Parvati to Kailash
videos.overview: Ganesh and Kartikey welcome Mahadev and Parvati to Kailash. They desire to organise a grand feast in Kailash, and want to invite Indralok and Patal Lok for the same. However, Parvati gives her disapproval, as she wishes to spend time with her family. Ripunjay intends to challenge the deities. Daksh enlightens him about the deities. Shukracharya forbids the asuras from attacking the deities in Kailash, during Mahadev and Parvati's felicitation. He urges Diti to help him regarding the same.

videos.title: Indradev in Kailash
videos.overview: Parvati is shocked to see Indradev in Kailash for the grand feast. As Mahadev consoles her, Ganesha and Kartikay apologise for hurting her sentiments. But Indradev has come to Kailash with the intention of annoying the Asuras. Diti tries to make him realise his mistake, but will he understand?

videos.title: Diti pays her gratitude
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati establish a Shivaling for Kartikay. As everyone gears up for the grand feast, Mahadev makes Indradev realise he has made a mistake by ill-treating Diti. In Kashi, the people are lured by money and give up praying. Daksh asks Ripunjay to believe in the gods.

videos.title: Mahadev enjoys the grand feast
videos.overview: Mahadev and the deities celebrate with a grand feast. Indradev decides to insult the Asuras in Kailash. Brihaspati prevents him from doing so. On Narad and Nandi's request, Indradev agrees to join the celebration. Mahadev also enlightens Rishi Kashyap about his past relationship with Diti.

videos.title: Ripunjay performs a yagna
videos.overview: In Kashi, Ripunjay wishes to perform a yagna. He assures Daksh that he will respect the Devas and invites him to the yagna. Meanwhile, in Kailash, even as Rishi Kashyap and Diti are happy to meet, Indradev tries to create conflict between the gods and the Asuras.

videos.title: Indradev provokes the gods
videos.overview: Ripunjay prays to the gods to make the yagna successful. But they are occupied with the grand feast in Kailash. Indradev insults the Asuras during the feast, but Mahadev controls the situation. Diti thanks him for doing so. Will Indradev stop instigating the gods?

videos.title: Ripunjay vows to revenge
videos.overview: Parvati makes Mahadev understand the significance of Kailash and wants him to allow the Asuras to enter Swarg Lok. Meanwhile, Ripunjay is furious with the gods for not attending the yagna. Daksh warns him not to take revenge, but he refuses to listen.

videos.title: Ripunjay decides to end his life
videos.overview: Gauri and her parents express their gratitude to Mahadev and Parvati for solving Kashi's problems. An angry Ripunjay decides to end his life because the Devas ignored the yagna. Indradev gets furious on seeing the Asuras in Swarg Lok. Diti thanks Mahadev for his concern for the Asuras.

videos.title: Ripunjay insults Mahadev
videos.overview: Lord Brahma grants Ripunjay a wish. He misuses it and stops the entry of the gods into Kashi. He gets annoyed when he sees Mahadev and Parvati in Kashi and asks them to leave. Mahadev agrees to go, but Parvati refuses. How will she respond to Ripunjay’s insult?

videos.title: Parvati worries about Kashi
videos.overview: Parvati worries about Kashi. The people of Kashi become emotional when Mahadev and Parvati leave. On Mandranchal's request, they decide to stay on Mandranchal mountain. Ripunjay forbids the public from respecting the gods and Daksh is angry when he hears this.

videos.title: Devas and the Asuras go to war
videos.overview: Daksh is upset with Ripunjay for insulting Mahadev. He apologises to Mahadev on his behalf and leaves Kashi. In Kailash, Indradev succeeds in creating a war between the gods and the Asuras. Kartikay tries to stop the war, but fails. What will be the outcome of this war?

videos.title: The Asuras insult Kartikay
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Kartikay about Indradev's conspiracy against the Asuras. Everybody is upset about the fight between the Asuras and the Devas. Meanwhile, a priest prevents Mahananda from performing Pradosha Vrata in the temple and threatens to curse her if she doesn't leave. Will Mahadev come to her rescue?

videos.title: Mahadev saves Mahananda
videos.overview: Mahadev disguises himself as Vaishyanath and visits Nandigram. He saves Mahananda and another woman, who is in danger. He also helps Mahananda perform Pradosha Vrata by giving her a Shivaling. In Swarg Lok, Indradev confronts Daityaraj for capturing his throne.

videos.title: Parvati's determination
videos.overview: As Vaishyanath plays the veena for Mahananda and her students, Narad tells him about the situation in Kashi and Swarg Lok. Indradev convinces Parvati to help him get rid of the Asuras from Swarg Lok. Will Mahadev be with the Asuras or the Devas?

videos.title: Mahadev grants Mahananda a wish
videos.overview: On seeing the priest stop Mahananda from entering the temple, Vaishyanath tells him about Mahadev's omnipresence. The priest understands and apologises. Vaishyanath then transforms himself back into Mahadev. How does he plan to control the situation in Swarg Lok?

videos.title: Ganesha stops the Asuras
videos.overview: On Parvati's request, Ganesha restricts the asuras from entering Swarg Lok. Brihaspati blames Indradev for Ganesh's action. Mahadev asks Ganesh to allow the asuras into Swarg Lok. Will Ganesha listen to Mahadev or follow Parvati's orders?

videos.title: Mahadev threatens Ganesha
videos.overview: Mahadev orders Ganesha to allow the Asuras to enter Swarg Lok, but he refuses and tells his father that he is following Parvati's orders. Mahadev is furious and threatens Ganesha. Brihaspati advises Kartikay and Nandi to summon Parvati. Will she come to Ganesha's rescue?

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Diti
videos.overview: Parvati makes Mahadev realise that the Asuras are taking advantage of his boons in Swarg Lok. Ignoring Mahadev's request, she herself blocks the entrance to Swarg Lok. Later, Mahadev explains the ideas of hell and heaven to Diti.

videos.title: Parvati worries about Kashi
videos.overview: Parvati refuses to go to Kailash till everything is normal in Kashi. Ganesha assures her that he will win the respect back for the gods and sets out for Kashi. Seeing Ripunjay's ego, Lord Brahma challenges him to perform Dashashwamedh Yagna. Will Ripunjay be able to complete this task?

videos.title: Ganesha as Dhundiraj
videos.overview: Parvati worries about the success of the Dashashwamegh Yagna, which is for the welfare of Kashi. Meanwhile, Ganesh disguises himself as Dhundiraj to build Ripunjay's trust in the gods and Mahadev. How will Ganesha accomplish his mission?

videos.title: Ripunjay learns about Mahadev
videos.overview: On Dhundiraj's insistence, Ripunjay joins him to receive offerings from the residents of Kashi. But the people refuse to give Ripunjay anything. Dhundiraj then explains the importance of Mahadev to him. Will Ripunjay understand and apologise to Mahadev and Parvati?

videos.title: Mahadev and Parvati visit Kashi
videos.overview: Ripunjay regrets insulting Mahadev and decides to give up his throne, but Daksh stops him. On his prayer, Mahadev and Parvati visit Kashi. He takes their blessing and expresses his gratitude to Ganesha. Mahadev blesses Mandranchal for taking care of him and Parvati, before heading back to Kailash.

videos.title: Nandi's concerns
videos.overview: Nandi expresses his concern to Mahadev, about the condition of animals on Earth. Parvati assures all that this will be taken care of by her devotee, Manika. In Swarg Lok, Indradev annoys and upsets Kamdhenu by not protecting her from the Asuras.

videos.title: Manika seeks Loknath's help
videos.overview: Mahadev disguises himself as Loknath to help Manika. He educates the villagers on the importance of animals and urges them to care for them. Manika seeks Loknath's help in saving Raja Pandayan's horses from his cruelty.

videos.title: Mahamantri's conspiracy
videos.overview: Mahamantri of Raja Pandayan conspires against Loknath. He intends to kill a cow after accusing her of swallowing a necklace belonging to a farmer. Loknath tells his wife that the cow did so to save her master. What was the cow protecting her owner from?

videos.title: Indradev fears losing his throne
videos.overview: Loknath proves the innocence of the farmer and the cow. Raja Pandayan is disappointed that the Mahamantri’s plan failed. He threatens Loknath with an ultimatum. In Kailash, Indradev fears losing his throne if he is unable to bring back Kamdhenu. But where will he find her?

videos.title: Brihaspati worries about the five deities of Swarg Lok
videos.overview: Nandi pays his gratitude to Mahadev and Parvati for giving justice to the animals. Mahadev consoles Kamdhenu and asks her to stay in Kailash. Kamdhenu wishes to stay at her daughter's house. Brihaspati worries about the five deities of Swarg Lok. Indradev panics on thinking about Kamdhenu. On Brihaspati's advice, he strives to find Kamdhenu, but in vain. Surya Dev asks the deities to leave Arunasur's place. Loknath helps Mahamantri and Manika in arranging for the horses for Raja Arivardhan.

videos.title: Raja Arivardhan is annoyed with Loknath
videos.overview: Raja Arivardhan is annoyed with Loknath for showing his compassion for the animals. He scolds Loknath for supporting Manika and Mahamantri. Loknath berates Raja Arivardhan for slaughtering the horses in the yagya. Arunasur pretends to show his concern for the five deities of Swarg Lok. He urges them to stay at his place. Indradev enquires with Subhadra about Kamdhenu. Raja Arivardhan's soldier kills a bird to challenge Loknath. Loknath proves his power to them by bestowing a new life to the bird.

videos.title: Mahadev saves Manika from Raja Arivardhan
videos.overview: Arunasur discusses about Surya Dev with his Mahamantri. Raja Arivardhan becomes furious at Manika for protesting against his barbarity towards the horses. He gives a death sentence to Manika, but Mahadev saves him. Parvati punishes Raja Arivardhan for his misdeeds. Raja Arivardhan pays his gratitude to Mahadev and Parvati. Mahadev asks Manika to take care of the animal community. Indradev learns about the whereabouts of the five deities of Swarg Lok. Surya Dev learns about Arunasur's ploy.

videos.title: Arunasur challenges Bhoothnath
videos.overview: Arunasur believes that he can bring his mother back to life by using the powers of the gods, but fails. First, he prays to Bhoothnath to breathe life back into his mother's body. And then, he challenges Bhoothnath to release the gods.

videos.title: Bhoothnath defeats Arunasur
videos.overview: Parvati performs sadhana for the safety of the five Devas. On the battlefield, Bhoothnath tries to weaken Arunasur by reminding him of his past. He defeats Arunasur in the first round but Arunasur comes back to fight further.

videos.title: Arunasur uses all his powers
videos.overview: Parvati tells Kartikay about her role in protecting the universe. Mahadev explains to Suryadev why Parvati cannot give him back his duties, even after his release from captivity. Ignoring Suryadev's warning, Arunasur uses all his powers and continues to fight Bhoothnath.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Kartikey about Parvati's karma
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens Kartikey about Parvati's karma for the sake of the universe. Parvati thanks Mahadev for supporting her in performing sadhana. On Brihaspati and Shukracharya's request, Mahadev allows them to perform puja for Shakti Peeth. The deities and the rishis perform yagya for Parvati's sake. Bhoothnath and Arunasur continue fighting with each other. Lord Vishnu enlightens the deities about Mahadev's omnipresence in Shakti Peeth's puja. The deities and the rishis pay gratitude to Mahadev.

videos.title: Arunasur's determination
videos.overview: Arunasur remains adamant on defeating Bhoothnath. But Bhoothnath again defeats him and helps Varun Dev free himself.  Will Arunasur realise his mistake? Will Parvati forgive him for the sins he has committed?

videos.title: Parvati falls unconscious
videos.overview: Bhoothnath continues to fight against Arunasur to make him realise that he is sinning against the gods. Parvati restores the powers and duties of the five Devas. But as soon as she does so, she falls unconscious to the ground.

videos.title: Mahadev plans to perform sadhana
videos.overview: Mahadev is shocked on seeing Parvati's condition. He transforms himself into Vaidyanath and cures Parvati. He then decides to perform sadhana, alone. What will Parvati do to bring Mahadev back to his peaceful state?

videos.title: Mahadev gets furious at Parvati
videos.overview: Ganesha gives Bilva leaves to Parvati so she can call Mahadev back. But when Parvati puts the Bilva Patra on the Shivaling, Mahadev gets angry. In order to please him, Narad plays the veena, but his anger continues. Only Parvati can do something to calm him.

videos.title: Controlling Mahadev's krodhagni
videos.overview: Parvati promises to pacify Mahadev, as his anger is causing natural disasters and calamities. Parvati, along with the five Devas, establishes various Shivalings and performs puja. But nothing seems to control Mahadev's krodhagni.

videos.title: Akhilandeshwari Devi
videos.overview: In order to help Mahadev, Parvati transforms herself into Akhilandeshwari Devi. The gods and Parvati continue to worship the Shivalings. Lord Vishnu even disguises himself as a farmer to make Mahadev realise the severity of the crisis on earth. Will Mahadev understand?

videos.title: Mahadev is pacified
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu and Parvati succeed in pacifying Mahadev. Mahadev gets his trishul and damaru from Parvati. He then plays his damaru and brings happiness back to the universe. Meanwhile, Arunasur is planning to misuse the boon Lord Brahma granted him.

videos.title: Parvati fears for Kamdhenu
videos.overview: Arunasur prepares for another war with Mahadev. He tries to blackmail and harm Van Devi. He also intends to torture the animals to take revenge on Pashupatinath. Knowing his intentions, Parvati fears for Kamdhenu's safety. What will Mahadev do to keep all of them safe?

videos.title: Arunasur tortures the animals
videos.overview: Arunasur tortures the animals and ill-treats Kamdhenu, while challenging Pashupatinath. Mahadev and Parvati perform sadhana for the welfare of the universe. But somebody interrupts their sadhana.

videos.title: Mahadev rescues the animals and Kamdhenu from Arunasur
videos.overview: Mahadev makes Arunasur realise about his concern for the animals. He rescues the animals and Kamdhenu from Arunasur. Arunasur insists Mahadev to revive his mother. Mahadev wants Arunasur to expiate for his sin. On Mahadev's request, Parvati pardons Indradev for interrupting her sadhana. Mahadev pays his gratitude to Van Devi for making his sadhana successful in the forest. Arunasur demonstrates his hatred for the deities, and intends to attack Yamraj. Kartikey gets ready to fight with Arunasur.

videos.title: Kartikay's decision
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Parvati about the war between Kartikay and Arunasur. On the battlefield, Arunasur starts fighting against Yamraj and defeats his army. Kartikay then decides to fight him and save Yamraj. Meanwhile, with Parvati and Mahadev's consent, Indradev takes Kamdhenu to Swarg Lok.

videos.title: Mahadev motivates Kartikey to fight with Arunasur
videos.overview: Mahadev motivates Kartikey to fight with Arunasur and blesses him to win the war. Yamraj and Arunasur fight with each other in the battle field. Kartikey challenges Arunasur to fight with him, but he refuses to accept the same. Kartikey tries to attack Arunasur, but Arunasur succeeds in defending himself. The deities worry about Kartikey. Arunasur takes Kartikey to his kingdom, in order to revive his mother. On seeing the dead body of Arunasur's mother, Kartikey stops fighting with him.

videos.title: Kartikey promises Arunasur to revive his mother
videos.overview: On being provoked by Arunasur's army, Kartikey becomes compassionate about Arunasur's mother. He promises Arunasur to revive his mother, and ends the war with him. Lord Brahma and the rishis worry on learning about the same. Kartikey urges Mahadev to revive Arunasur's mother, but he refuses. Kartikey vents his anger on Mahadev and Nandi for the same. Parvati berates Kartikey for his behaviour. Mahadev finds it difficult to revive Arunasur's mother on thinking about its bad consequences.

videos.title: Kartikay leaves Kailash
videos.overview: Mahadev worries about Kartikay's promise to Arunasur. Parvati and Ganesha make Kartikay realise that he has made a mistake, but Kartikay is adamant. He leaves Kailash, upset with Mahadev and Parvati for not standing by him.

videos.title: Parvati worries about Kartikay
videos.overview: As Arunasur continues to perform Parvati's sadhana, Parvati worries about Kartikay going to Kritika. She decides to bring him back to Kailash. Mahadev forbids her from doing so, but she refuses to listen. Mahadev worries about the consequences of Parvati's decision.

videos.title: Kartikey becomes outraged at Indradev
videos.overview: Indradev decides to stop Kartikey from resurrecting Arunasur's mother, on thinking about it's bad consequences in Swarg Lok. Brihaspati forbids Indradev from meeting Kartikey. Nevertheless, Indradev interrupts Kartikey, and insists him to take back his decision of reviving Arunasur's mother. Kartikey becomes outraged at Indradev for criticising Mahadev. Out of anger, Kartikey transforms himself into Krodh Agni. The deities worry about Kartikey and urge Mahadev to liberate him from Krodh Agni.

videos.title: Kartikay is upset with Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev succeeds in releasing Kartikay from his Krodhagni state. Parvati blames Indradev for misleading Kartikay and decides to punish him. She tries to please Kartikay. But Kartikay tells Lord Vishnu that he is upset with Mahadev for not treating him like his son.

videos.title: Kartikay returns to Kailash
videos.overview: Kartikay returns to Kailash. Parvati learns about his compassion for Arunasur's mother. She decides to help him keep his promise to Arunasur. But Parvati’s support to Kartikay worries Mahadev further. Will he stop her from doing something wrong out of motherly love?

videos.title: Kartikay's realisation
videos.overview: Parvati decides to grant Arunasur's wish. She explains to Kartikay about the love parents have for their children. On her insistence, he apologises to Nandi. By now, Kartikay realises how Arunasur used him and decides to take revenge.

videos.title: Arunasur feels cheated
videos.overview: Before granting Arunasur's wish, Parvati tells him about his sins and asks him to reconsider his wish. She brings back his mother, but she isn't happy to be revived. She scolds Arunasur and requests Parvati to liberate her soul. He blames Mahadev and Parvati for cheating him.

videos.title: Arunasur attacks Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev pardons Arunasur and gives him a chance to correct his wrongdoings. But Arunasur attacks him. Mahadev realises that Arunasur cannot be killed by him, as he is protected by Lord Brahma's boon. Parvati transforms herself into Bhramari Devi to kill Arunasur.

videos.title: Bhramari Devi's anger
videos.overview: The deities worry on seeing the destruction caused by Bhramari Devi's anger. Mahadev meditates to pacify Parvati. Ganesh and Kartikay pray for their mother. Out of guilt, Kartikay resigns from the post of Senapati. Will Mahadev take another avatar to calm Parvati again?

videos.title: Vishnu takes the form of Mohini
videos.overview: The deities and Mahadev worry about the negativity in the universe. Lord Vishnu transforms himself into Mohini to pacify Bhramari Devi. Meanwhile, Mahishi decides to take revenge on Parvati for killing her brother. Mahadev knows that Parvati will not be able to kill Mahishi. Who will save Parvati?

videos.title: Mohini pacifies Parvati
videos.overview: On seeing Mohini, Parvati remembers Lord Vishnu's concern for her. Mohini succeeds in pacifying Parvati. But Mahishi has sworn vengeance against Parvati and the gods, so she tortures the rishis and the innocent people. The Devas worry about how Mahishi will be defeated, as she is blessed with immortality.

videos.title: Hariharaputra is born
videos.overview: Mahadev performs leela to bring peace to the universe. In the process, his son Hariharaputra is born. Heeding Raja Rajasekhara's prayers, Mahadev hands over Hariharaputra to him and asks him to raise the child as his son. Mahadev names Hariharaputra as Manikantan. Mahishi plans to kill Manikantan.

videos.title: Mahishi attacks Manikantan
videos.overview: The Mahamantri of Raja Rajasekhara conspires against Manikantan, to prevent him becoming Raja Rajasekhara's heir. He plots with Raja Rajasekhara's wife, the Maharani. In the forest, Mahishi attacks Manikantan.

videos.title: Parvati frees herself
videos.overview: Manikantan succeeds in killing Mahishi. Parvati liberates herself from Bhramari Devi avatar. Raja Rajasekhara apologises to Manikantan on behalf of the Mahamantri and Maharani. Mahadev helps him establish a temple for Manikantan. He declares that Manikantan will be worshipped as Ayyappa.

videos.title: Lakulesh emerges from his sadhana
videos.overview: Mahadev's devotee Lakulesh desires to go to his temple. Mahadev is disturbed when Lakulesh emerges from his sadhana. He tells Parvati about Lakulesh's devotion. Mahadev then decides to reveal the secret of Sati to his devotee.

videos.title: Mahadev rescues Lakulesh
videos.overview: Lakulesh refuses to eat the prasad offered by a priest and the Maharaja. The Maharaja gets furious when he separates Shiva and Parvati's idol. Mahadev disguises himself as a saint to save Lakulesh from the Maharaja. How will Lakulesh react when he discovers the truth?

videos.title: Lakulesh decides to visit Kailash
videos.overview: Bhola helps Lakulesh drink 'Mansarovar Jal'. Later, Lakulesh realises that Bhola was Mahadev in disguise. He feels bad that he couldn't recognise him and decides to visit Kailash. Parvati wishes to welcome him and that becomes a worry for Mahadev.

videos.title: Lakulesh's instructions
videos.overview: Ganesh, Nandi and the Shivgans welcome Lakulesh to Kailash. Parvati's presence shocks him and he insists she should stay away from Kailash to preserve Mahadev's sanctity. Still, Parvati helps him meet Mahadev. The gods worry on seeing Lakulesh's behaviour.

videos.title: Mahadev plans to perform sadhana
videos.overview: Lakulesh forbids Mahadev from eating the food prepared by Parvati. Mahadev scolds him for insulting Parvati. He tries to make Lakulesh realise that Parvati is his wife and is Adi Shakti. Lakulesh refuses to believe and leaves Kailash. Mahadev decides to perform sadhana for him.

videos.title: Bhairavi forbids Lakulesh from destroying himself
videos.overview: Lakulesh tortures himself on thinking about Mahadev. Mahadev performs sadhana for Lakulesh in the cremation ground. Parvati worries about the consequences of Mahadev's sadhana. She transforms herself into Bhairavi to safeguard Tridev from the destruction. Bhairavi forbids Lakulesh from destroying himself. She tries to persuade Lakulesh about Mahadev's relationship with Adi Shakti, but he refuses to believe her. Lakulesh becomes glad on seeing Mahadev performing sadhana, and trusts in his sanctity.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Lakulesh about his powers and incarnations
videos.overview: Lakulesh insists Mahadev to stop his sadhana. Bhairavi tries to make Lakulesh realise about Mahadev's relationship with Sati and Adi Shakti. However, Lakulesh trusts in Mahadev's sanctity. Mahadev performs sadhana using Sati's skull. On Bhairavi's insistence, Lakulesh puts his vision on the skull, and learns about Mahadev and Sati's relationship. Mahadev completes his sadhana, and enlightens Lakulesh about his powers and incarnations. He decides to tell Lakulesh about Sati's secret.

videos.title: Mahadev tells Lakulesh about the past incidents
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Lakulesh about the past incidents, related to Daksh. Lord Vishnu enlightens Daksh and Angira about Mahadev's renunciation. Lord Brahma becomes impressed with Daksh's intellectuality, and wishes to appoint him as the Prajapati. Daksh proves his power during the yagya, and seeks blessings of Lord Brahma and Lord Vishnu. On Lord Vishnu's advice, Daksh worships the shivlings. He prays to Mahadev to bless him with the power of undertaking the responsibilities of the Prajapati.

videos.title: Daksh vents his anger on Narad
videos.overview: Daksh consoles Prasuti on seeing her worried about him. He organises a havan, and invites the deities and the rishis. Daksh becomes annoyed on learning that Narad has motivated his sons to take renunciation. He vents his anger on Narad, and curses him. Daksh urges the rishis to marry his daughters. The innocent people face the atrocities of Daksh's army. Mahadev helps them to fight against the injustice. Daksh's army tries to attack Mahadev, but in vain.

videos.title: Mahadev cuts off the fifth head of Lord Brahma
videos.overview: Mahadev defeats Daksh's army, and rescues the innocent people. Daksh gets his daughters married to the rishis. On Lord Brahma's advice, Daksh performs sadhana for Mahadev and Adi Shakti. He prays to Adi Shakti to reincarnate as his daughter, and vows to get her married to Mahadev. Adi Shakti reincarnates as Daksh's daughter, Sati. Mahadev cuts off the fifth head of Lord Brahma as he criticises the Vedas. Daksh vents his anger on learning the same, and curses Mahadev. Prasuti takes care of Sati.

videos.title: Daksh organises a 'Vasant Utsav'
videos.overview: Daksh organises a 'Vasant Utsav' for Sati. He forbids her to leave the palace, but she defies him and heads north. Meanwhile, Lord Brahma worries about Mahadev's condition. Nandi and the Shivgans request Mahadev to return from his Krodhagni avatar.

videos.title: Mahadev's reclusive state
videos.overview: Narad gets worried on seeing Mahadev's condition. He and Nandi's father strive to pacify Mahadev, but he decides to live a reclusive life. Will meeting Sati make him change his mind? Meanwhile, Sati discusses her future husband with her sisters.

videos.title: Angira vents his anger
videos.overview: In the forest, Mahadev tries to create a statue but is unable to do so. At Daksh's palace, Sati tries to draw a picture, but fails to do so. In Brahma Lok, Angira vents his anger on Lord Brahma for not appointing him Prajapati and insulting his son, Sadhbhish.

videos.title: Sati proceeds to Angira's yagna
videos.overview: Sati proceeds to Angira's yagna but they get stuck on the way. In the forest, Mahadev saves Sati from a tiger. Her sisters worry when she loses consciousness. But Mahadev treats her with his powers. Sati recovers and Mahadev's anger cools down.

videos.title: Sadhbhish's plan
videos.overview: Sati's voice lures Mahadev to her location. Seeing a stranger, Daksh's army tries to attack Mahadev, but fails. Sadhbhish decides to kill Daksh's daughters and seize power. Meanwhile, Nandi and the Shivgans continue to be worried by Mahadev's angry state.

videos.title: Sati is drawn to the damaru
videos.overview: Mahadev plays the damaru and the sound calls out to Sati. She goes towards the forest in search of Mahadev and finds an incomplete idol. Back home, Sadhbhish's army attempts to kill Sati, but Mahadev's power saves her.

videos.title: Sati fails to recognise Mahadev
videos.overview: When Sati meets Mahadev, she fails to recognise him as he wears the look of an ascetic. She asks him about his identity, but Mahadev ignores her. His reaction makes her angry and she decides to find her way back home.

videos.title: Sati gets lost in the forest
videos.overview: Mahadev gets furious at Sati for disrespecting him. Still, he saves her from drowning in a river. Sati finds it hard to protect herself in the forest and worries about her future.

videos.title: Attack on Daksh's daughters
videos.overview: Sati requests Mahadev to protect her for the night. She becomes mesmerised listening to Mahadev's damaru and understands his concern for her. At the palace, Daksh decides to perform a yagna and asks Rishi Bhrigu to take care of his daughters. But Sadhbhish's men are determined to kill his daughters.

videos.title: Sati tries to impress Mahadev
videos.overview: Ignoring Mahadev's warning, Sati eats a fruit in the forest and falls ill. Mahadev helps her recover. She then tries to impress him and get his help to find her way out of the forest, but in vain. Will she be able to get out of the forest without Mahadev's help?

videos.title: Sati strives to reconcile
videos.overview: Sati remains upset with Mahadev for not helping her. She apologises to him and he guides her out of the forest. She halts for the night and meets Mahadev yet again. Will she be able to convince him to abandon his reclusive state?

videos.title: Mahadev becomes outraged at Sati
videos.overview: Mahadev becomes outraged at Sati after she insists him to renounce his reclusive life. He asks Sati to leave the forest. Rishi Bhrigu worries about Sati's whereabouts. He suspects Shatbhish's Mantri of conspiring against Daksh. Mahadev forbids Angira's army from cutting the trees. He enlightens them about their importance. Daksh becomes furious on learning about Sati's visit to the forest. He decides to investigate about the matter.

videos.title: Sati is attacked in the forest
videos.overview: Sati remains annoyed with Mahadev as she leaves the forest. Constant thoughts of Sati make Mahadev even more furious. Sati panics when she is attacked by arrows in the forest. But she somehow manages to escape from all the arrows. Is Mahadev saving her?

videos.title: Mahadev's devotees wait for him
videos.overview: Mahadev's devotees wait for his visit during the Shivratri festival. Mahadev's ardent devotee, Rishi Dadhichi, assures them of his visit on the occasion of Maha Shivratri. He gets ready to perform the puja and prays to Mahadev. Will Mahadev return?

videos.title: Shatbhish's army attacks Sati
videos.overview: While Mahadev's devotees worry over his return from the forest, he worries about Sati's safety. He suddenly leaves the Shivratri puja and goes to save Sati as he senses Shatbhish's army attacking her. Angira gets annoyed as all of Shatbhish's plans are failing. What will be their next move?

videos.title: Mahadev refuses to accept Sati
videos.overview: Nandi tries to reveal Mahadev's identity to Sati, but he stops him and asks him to take Sati away. In her tent, she discusses Mahadev with her sisters. Even on Lord Brahma and Lord Vishnu's insistence, Mahadev refuses to accept Sati, as he knows their future. He also threatens Kaamdev from uniting him and Sati.

videos.title: Mahadev is back at Kailash
videos.overview: Mahadev is back at Kailash but in his reclusive state. Sati again gets attracted to the sound of his damaru and starts moving towards Kailash. Khyati and Aditi bring her back to the camp. Daksh becomes furious on learning about her meeting with their biggest enemy.

videos.title: Daksh vents his anger on Sati
videos.overview: Everybody is happy to see Mahadev in his original form. But he says that he would renounce his reclusive life only after establishing his relationship with Sati. In the forest, Daksh vents his anger on Sati for meeting Mahadev. Meanwhile, Vasuki decides to meet Mahadev for Sati's welfare.

videos.title: Sati's suffering
videos.overview: Vasuki informs Mahadev about Sati's suffering. He refuses to leave Kailash till Mahadev promises to take care of her. Meanwhile, Lord Brahma and Lord Vishnu tell Narad about Garud's hostile relationship with the snakes. Indradev worries over what will happen, when Mahadev learns of the same.

videos.title: Garud attacks the snakes
videos.overview: Vasuki is furious on learning about Garud's atrocities against the snake community. Mahadev heeds Vasuki's prayer and decides to protect the snakes. However, he is shocked to learn who has been instigating Garud to attack the snakes.

videos.title: Mahadev accepts the challenge
videos.overview: Mahadev accepts Lord Vishnu's challenge. The gods worry about the war and its consequences. Lord Vishnu reveals to Mahadev that he had plotted to fight him for the welfare of the universe. On hearing this, Mahadev blesses Vasuki and wears him around his neck.

videos.title: Lakulesh learns the truth
videos.overview: Rishi Bhrigu tells Daksh about Mahadev's reconciliation with Tridev. Daksh gets angry and decides to perform yagna to destroy Mahadev and Sati's relationship. However, Sati is united with Mahadev and later sacrifices her life for him. How will Lakulesh react to the truth about Sati?

videos.title: Indradev commits crime by killing a rishi
videos.overview: Parvati devotes herself in performing sadhana. Mahadev becomes grateful to her for supporting Lakulesh. Ganesh and Kartikey worry about Parvati. Mahadev's devotee, Maharani, performs yagya for the sake of her kingdom. On listening to her prayer, Mahadev makes her yagya successful. Indradev misbehaves with a rishi when he meditates. He attacks the rishi for not obeying him. The rishi curses him while dying. Lord Vishnu and Lord Brahma ask Mahadev to take action against Indradev.

videos.title: Ganesh learns about his duties
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Ganesh about his duty to spread knowledge and destroy anti-social elements in the universe. Meanwhile, a Maharaja attempts to commit suicide, when he contracts a terrible disease. However, Mahadev stops him.

videos.title: Indradev leaves Swarg Lok
videos.overview: Motivated by Mahadev, the Maharaja decides to serve leprosy patients. However, will the people of his kingdom forgive him for his earlier misdeeds and accept his gesture? Meanwhile, Indradev apologises to Mahadev for his mistakes and leaves Swarg Lok.

videos.title: Priests want to punish Maharaja
videos.overview: The priests provoke the citizens to punish the Maharaja. Mahadev, in the form of Shambhu, stops them and makes them realise that the Maharaja wants to make amends by taking care of them. The priests get annoyed with Shambhu for protecting the Maharaja and challenge him.

videos.title: Indrani insults Nahush
videos.overview: Nahush takes Mahadev's blessings and begins his work as the Devraj of Swarg Lok. However, Indrani opposes Mahadev's decision. She insults Nahush and Ashok Sundari. A furious Nahush vents his anger on Ashok Sundari and Mahadev.

videos.title: The priests plot an attack
videos.overview: Mahadev consoles Ashok Sundari, telling her that Nahush has become the leader of Swarg Lok because of his abilities. Meanwhile, the priests plot to attack Shambhu and the Maharaja and take over the kingdom. On Shambhu's motivation, the Maharaja and his citizens vow to fight their enemies.

videos.title: Nahush misbehaves with Indrani
videos.overview: Nahush's arrogance comes in the way of his duties and he misbehaves with the gods. On Brihaspati's advice, Indrani negotiates with Nahush for the sake of Swarg Lok. However, Nahush misbehaves with her, too.

videos.title: Shambhu defeats the enemies
videos.overview: Nahush insults the rishis. Mahadev advises them to fight against injustice. Nahush even plans to ruin Indrani's reputation. Ashok Sundari warns him against doing so, but he does not listen. The Maharaja meets his enemies on the battleground. Shambhu fights with his opponents and defeats them.

videos.title: Shambhu cures the Maharaja
videos.overview: The Maharaja succeeds in defeating his enemies with Shambhu's support. Shambhu transforms himself into Mahadev. He cures the Maharaja and his citizens of leprosy. The priests apologise to Mahadev. Will he forgive them?

videos.title: Rishi Agastya curses Nahush
videos.overview: In Swarg Lok, Nahush insults the rishis by ordering them to carry him on their shoulders. Ashok Sundari and Indrani pray to Mahadev to stop Nahush from committing sins. Rishi Agastya curses Nahush for humiliating him. Who will save Nahush from this curse?

videos.title: Indradev returns to Swarg Lok
videos.overview: On seeing Indradev's sadhana, Mahadev reappoints him as the Devraj of Swarg Lok. As Ashok Sundari expresses her pain to Parvati, Indrani welcomes Indradev to Kailash. Indradev apologises to the gods and Brihaspati for his offences and promises to work towards their welfare.

videos.title: The forbidden worship
videos.overview: Kalbheet's father, Raj Purohit, forbids him from worshipping Mahadev. He fails to perform a yagna for Kalbheet. Mahadev and Ganesh disguise themselves as Nat Bhairav and Natesh respectively, and reach the village. They assure the villagers that they will take care of Kalbheet.

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Indradev about Kalbheet
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens Indradev about Kalbheet's sufferings. Pushpadant, a devotee of Mahadev, steals flowers from the Maharaja's pushpa vatika, to worship the shivling. The Maharaja fails to perform Mahadev's puja without flowers, and wants to punish the thief. His soldiers succeed in arresting Pushpadant. Nat Bhairav consoles Raj Purohit. Kalbheet's mother worries as he has not eaten food since the last two days. Natesh (Ganesh) succeeds in feeding him.

videos.title: Mahadev's judgement
videos.overview: Nat Bhairav and Natesh succeed in liberating Kalbheet from his reclusive life. On Nat Bhairav's advice, Kalbheet mends his relationship with his parents. Meanwhile, Mahadev must decide whether Pushpadant should be punished or not.

videos.title: Kalbheet's decision
videos.overview: Nat Bhairav explains to Kalbheet's parents how they misguided their son. They apologise and thank Nat Bhairav. However, the villagers challenge Raj Purohit that Kalbheet will not come out of the house. On Nat Bhairav's insistence, Kalbheet emerges to prove he can mix with society.

videos.title: Pushpadant steals the Shivaling
videos.overview: Provoked by the soldiers of the Maharaja, Pushpadant enters the Shiva temple and takes away the Shivaling. Though Nat Bhairav tries to make him realise his mistake, he does not listen and worships the stolen Shivaling. Will Pushpadant be punished for the theft?

videos.title: Pushpadant gets death sentence
videos.overview: Pushpadant realises his mistake and returns the Shivaling to the Maharaja. As stealing from the temple cannot be forgiven, the Maharaja punishes him with the death sentence. Will Mahadev again save Pushpadant?

videos.title: Mahadev and Parvati return
videos.overview: The Maharaja saves Pushpadant from the death penalty when he learns about his devotion for Mahadev. Mahadev returns to Kailash and helps Parvati in her sadhana. However, as he and Parvati are welcomed to Kailash, Lord Brahma foresees trouble and talks about it to Narayan.

videos.title: Lord Brahma's prediction
videos.overview: Mahadev is impressed by Banasur's devotion for him. Even as Narad and Lord Vishnu stop him from blessing Banasur, he bestows Banasur with a boon and rescues him from his enemy, Sonit Raj. Banasur becomes powerful and succeeds in killing Sonit Raj. Lord Brahma's prediction scares all the gods.

videos.title: Banasur is provoked
videos.overview: Banasur misuses his power, leading to death and destruction. Mahadev tells the gods that an evil spirit is provoking Banasur to commit sins. Banasur realises his mistakes, but is unable to control his actions. Mahadev predicts the incidents that will occur in Kailash.

videos.title: Mahadev leaves Kailash
videos.overview: Parvati offers prasad to the gods during a ceremony. When it is offered to Banasur, he hesitates. He prays to Mahadev to liberate him from the evil powers. Mahadev asks Bhairav to take care of Banasur, but he refuses. Mahadev then leaves for Sonitpur to help Banasur.

videos.title: Banasur and the citizens of Sonitpur felicitate Mahadev
videos.overview: Banasur thanks Mahadev for being compassionate towards him and visiting his kingdom, Sonitpur. Mahadev assures Banasur of keeping him away from the evil power. He asks Banasur not to misuse his boon. Kartikey is sad after Mahadev leaves Kailash. Banasur and the citizens of Sonitpur felicitate Mahadev. Bhairav restricts Nandi and the shivgans from entering Maan Sarovar, for the safety of Kailash. Parvati stops him from doing so. Banasur strives to eliminate his evil intentions against Mahadev.

videos.title: Kartikay decides to fight Bhairav
videos.overview: Banasur arranges for Mahadev's stay in Sonitpur. His ego is hurt as he is ignored and everybody's attention is on Mahadev. Meanwhile, Bhairav stops Parvati from leaving Kailash. Kartikay decides to fight him for disobeying Adishakti.

videos.title: Bhairav kills the intruders
videos.overview: Ganesh stops Kartikay and Bhairav from fighting. He persuades Bhairav not to hinder the freedom of the residents of Kailash. Later, Bhairav overreacts and kills some intruders in Kailash. Meanwhile, Banasur's evil side provokes him to attack his neighbouring kingdoms.

videos.title: Banasur regrets his actions
videos.overview: Mahadev stops Banasur from attacking the Maharaja of a neighbouring kingdom. Banasur regrets misusing his power and apologises to Mahadev. However, later, he scolds his wife Vaani for giving importance to Mahadev. How will Banasur control the evil within him?

videos.title: Banasur attempts to kill Mahadev
videos.overview: The rishis and Vaani condemn Banasur for insulting Mahadev. Out of anger, Banasur attempts to kill her and challenges Mahadev. Parvati is shocked on learning this and decides to protect Mahadev. However, Bhairav stops her. What will happen if Parvati gets even angrier?

videos.title: Banasur apologises to Parvati
videos.overview: Banasur questions Mahadev about the evil inside him. In Kailash, Parvati curses Bhairav for stopping her. She leaves for Sonitpur to destroy Banasur. Instead of destroying him, she blesses Vaani with a child. Mahadev asks Banasur to use his powers for a noble cause. However, Banasur again commits a crime.

videos.title: Banasur and Vaani are blessed
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati bless Banasur and Vaani with a daughter, Usha. Banasur tries to kill a Mahamantri for not considering Usha his daughter. Vaani decides to keep Usha away from Banasur to protect her.

videos.title: Banasur plans to attack Indradev
videos.overview: Banasur is outraged on learning that Vaani has left the palace with Usha. He decides to attack Indradev for giving shelter to Vaani. Provoked by his evil side, Banasur decides to kill the gods. Kartikay seeks Mahadev's blessings to fight Banasur.

videos.title: Parvati vows to destroy Banasur
videos.overview: Indrani urges Parvati to protect Vaani and Usha from Banasur. Despite Mahadev protecting Banasur, Parvati vows to destroy him. She warns Banasur not to attack the gods, but he doesn't listen. Will Mahadev continue to protect Banasur?

videos.title: Vaani returns to Banasur
videos.overview: For the sake of Mahadev and Parvati, Vaani returns to Banasur with Usha. Banasur gives up his weapons and apologises to Mahadev and Parvati. As Usha grows up, she becomes Parvati's devotee. In Kailash, Lord Brahma hears of the Yaduvanshis attacking the Asuras, and tells Narad about Balram.

videos.title: Usha proves herself to Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev decides to test Usha by arranging a sword fight between her and Kartikay. She wins the fight by diverting Kartikay's attention. She proves to Mahadev that intelligence is more important than strength. Later, she questions Mahadev about the boon he gave to Banasur.

videos.title: Ganesh organises Usha's farewell
videos.overview: As Kailash prepares for Usha's farewell, Sonitpur prepares for her arrival. Usha thanks Mahadev, Parvati, Ganesh and Kartikay for taking care of her. Banasur and Vaani also visit Kailash for Usha's farewell ceremony. On Mahadev's insistence, Balram and Banasur vow not to fight each other.

videos.title: Banasur gets furious at Usha
videos.overview: Usha gets emotional while leaving Kailash. Mahadev advises her to follow the right principles in life. At Sonitpur, she remembers her days at Kailash and praises some gods. Banasur cannot tolerate Usha praising others. He decides to show her his strength by attacking his enemies.

videos.title: Banasur challenges Balram
videos.overview: Banasur gets furious at Vaani when she tries to stop him from fighting the Yaduvanshis. He visits Dwarka and challenges Balram to a fight. Kartikay and Narad urge Mahadev to stop the war. Whom will Mahadev protect, Balram or Banasur?

videos.title: Banasur vows to attack Mahadev
videos.overview: Banasur challenges Balram to a fight. Balram defeats him but doesn't kill him as he is protected by Mahadev. Banasur gets furious at Mahadev for interfering. He vows to attack Mahadev and the gods. In Kailash, Kartikay faces Banasur's army. Lord Brahma worries about the consequences of the war.

videos.title: Kartikay surrenders to Banasur
videos.overview: Banasur goes to Kailash to attack the gods. Nandi and Kartikay warn him to return to Sonitpur, but he refuses. Kartikay finds it difficult to fight Banasur because of Mahadev. He defends himself but doesn't attack. Later, Kartikay surrenders to Banasur. How will Mahadev protect Kartikay from Banasur?

videos.title: Mahadev's prediction
videos.overview: Despite repeated warnings, Banasur refuses to listen to Mahadev. He predicts Banasur's downfall and tells him that Parshuram will destroy him. He challenges Parshuram to a fight, but Parshuram refuses to do so. Banasur goes back to Sonitpur and declares himself king of the universe.

videos.title: Mahadev tries to pacify Parvati
videos.overview: Parvati is annoyed with Kartikay’s defeat. Mahadev tries to calm her. In Sonitpur, Banasur ignores Usha's plea and decides to fight Parshuram. Meanwhile, Aniruddha fights the Asuras.

videos.title: Aniruddha is brought to Sonitpur
videos.overview: As Aniruddha fights the Asuras, Chitralekha apprehends him using her magical powers. Usha thanks her for bringing Aniruddha to Sonitpur. In Kailash, Mahadev questions Agni Dev about his duties as the Senapati of the gods. This annoys Agni Dev.

videos.title: Agni Dev creates destruction
videos.overview: The gods worry as Agni Dev experiments with his powers, which lead to destruction in Swarg Lok. Indradev warns him, but to no avail. Mahadev foresees Agni Dev's downfall. In Sonitpur, Usha seems to be falling in love.

videos.title: Narad visits Dwarka
videos.overview: While Agni Dev continues to trouble the gods, Mahadev wants Kartikay in Kailash as soon as possible. Meanwhile, Mahadev asks Narad to meet Krishna. What will Narad say if Krishna asks him about the purpose of his visit?

videos.title: Agni Dev attacks Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev meets Agni Dev in disguise and warns him not to cause more destruction. Agni Dev doesn't listen and attacks Mahadev. What will be the consequences of Agni Dev's ego? Meanwhile, the gods want Kartikay to resume duty as Senapati.

videos.title: Agni Dev's torture continues
videos.overview: Ignoring Kartikay's warning, Agni Dev continues to burn innocent people. He wants Kartikay to refuse the post of Senapati. In Sonitpur, Banasur decides to fight the Yaduvanshis. What will happen when he discovers Usha is in love?

videos.title: Usha gets married
videos.overview: The Mahamantri informs Banasur that Usha has brought Aniruddha to Sonitpur, but Banasur scolds him for casting aspersions on his daughter. Meanwhile, Aniruddha and Usha get married. What will happen when the truth is revealed?

videos.title: Agni Dev steps down as Senapati
videos.overview: Seeing Mahadev open his third eye in anger, Agni Dev apologises to him and steps down as Senapati. Krishna pacifies Mahadev by worshipping the Shivaling. Meanwhile, Banasur challenges Aniruddha to a fight, defeats him, and humiliates him.

videos.title: Krishna frees Aniruddha
videos.overview: After defeating Aniruddha, Banasur challenges the Yaduvanshis. Krishna reaches Sonitpur to take Aniruddha and Usha back to Dwarka, but Banasur refuses to let them go. What will Krishna do?

videos.title: Banasur seeks Mahadev's help
videos.overview: Banasur vents his anger on Usha for showing concern for Aniruddha. He requests Mahadev to help him defeat the Yaduvanshis. Mahadev agrees reluctantly, as he is committed to protecting Banasur. Mahadev and Krishna worry about the consequences of this war.

videos.title: Banasur's challenge
videos.overview: Ganesh, Kartikay and Nandi vow to support Mahadev in the war between the Yaduvanshis and the Asuras. Banasur blames the Yaduvanshis for bringing Usha and Aniruddha together.  Krishna and Balram accept Banasur's challenge.

videos.title: Mahadev and Krishna's fight
videos.overview: Krishna tells Aniruddha about the principles of war. The war between the Yaduvanshis and Banasur's army begins. Aniruddha defeats Nandi and fights Kartikay. Later, Krishna defeats Ganesh and Kartikay. Is it time for Mahadev and Krishna to fight each other?

videos.title: Krishna attacks Mahadev
videos.overview: Krishna obeys Mahadev's command and fights with him on the battlefield. The gods worry about the impact of this war. On Mahadev's insistence, Krishna uses his astra to attack him. Krishna's arrow puts Mahadev in an energy field and he disappears.

videos.title: Mahadev disappears
videos.overview: Mahadev disappears from the battleground. Kartikay and the gods worry about Mahadev's whereabouts. Krishna condemns Banasur's arrogance and attacks him with his brahmastra. Lord Brahma stops Krishna from killing him. Will Banasur be given another chance to pay for his sins?

videos.title: Usha and Aniruddha's marriage
videos.overview: Banasur realises his mistake and apologises to Usha. He organises Usha and Aniruddha's marriage ceremony in Sonitpur. Mahadev, Parvati, Krishna, the rishis and the gods bless the couple. Later, on Vasuki's request, Mahadev blesses him with a sister, Manasa.

videos.title: Vasuki can't take care of Manasa
videos.overview: Aniruddha and Usha compete with each other in archery. In Kailash, Parvati worries about Banasur. Vasuki takes Manasa to Mahadev as he unable to take care of her. Mahadev advises him to hand over Manasa to Rishi Halahal for her upbringing.

videos.title: Parvati is suspicious of Banasur
videos.overview: Parvati again becomes suspicious of Banasur's intention. Mahadev gives Kartikay some valuable tips on warfare. Later, Lord Brahma discusses the future of Kailash with Mahadev. Is there something to worry about?

videos.title: Adi tries to please Lord Brahma
videos.overview: After fighting Kartikay, Ganesh realises why Mahadev organised the fight and why Kartikey received training from Nandi. Meanwhile, Andhaka's son, Adi, does tough penance to please Lord Brahma. Rishi Halahal worries about Manasa's whereabouts after she visits Mrityu Lok.

videos.title: Manasa reveals her true self
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Parvati about Lord Brahma's boon to Adi. Parvati panics on hearing about it. The rishis fear that if Manasa wanders about, she might reveal her true self to others. Their fears come true when Manasa loses her temper and shows her true form.

videos.title: Adi fails to prove his strength
videos.overview: Indradev reminds Mahadev about Andhaka's misdeeds. He wants Kartikay to stay away from Adi. In Kailash, Adi fails to prove his strength when Mahadev tests him. Then, Mahadev agrees to train him, but on one condition.

videos.title: Manasa falls into a trap
videos.overview: Mahadev tests Adi's power and asks him to fight with Nandi. Will Adi pass this test? Meanwhile, Manasa convinces Rishi Halahal to let her go out of his ashram. In the forest, she falls into a trap and is in pain.

videos.title: Adi succeeds at entering Kailash
videos.overview: Parvati gets suspicious as Adi tries to please everybody by gifting them with Shivalings. Manasa kills a villager's child. The villagers come to Rishi Halahal for justice. He takes the blame and gets punished by the villagers.

videos.title: Manasa kills Rishi Halahal
videos.overview: Manasa rescues Rishi Halahal from the villagers. She gets furious at them for attacking him. Later, her own Krodhagni kills Rishi Halahal. She blames Mahadev for not taking care of her father. She causes destruction in the universe through her powers. How will Mahadev pacify her?

videos.title: Mahadev, Parvati pacify Manasa
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati perform sadhana for Manasa's well-being. They succeed in pacifying her by using the power of Jal Tatva. Adi causes destruction in Kailash in Mahadev and Parvati's absence. He misuses the power of Lord Brahma's boon. He plans to take over Kailash by making the gods fight with each other.

videos.title: Mahadev plans to destroy Adi
videos.overview: Adi continues torturing the denizens of Kailash. Meanwhile, Mahadev and Parvati remain busy performing sadhana for Manasa. As soon as Mahadev learns about Adi's misdeeds, he invokes another power to destroy him. However, Adi will be given a last chance to correct his mistakes.

videos.title: Adi's destruction in Kailash
videos.overview: Veerbhadra attacks Adi for deceiving Mahadev and orders him to leave Kailash. Later, Adi, disguised as Veerbhadra, creates havoc in Kailash. Mahadev punishes him for misusing Lord Brahma's boon. Adi explains to Mahadev the reasons for his actions.

videos.title: Manasa blames Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati discuss about Manasa with the inhabitants of Kailash. Even though Manasa returns to Rishi Halahal's ashram, she continues to blame Mahadev for her father's death. What will happen when she discovers who her real father is?

videos.title: Manasa is taken to Kailash
videos.overview: Ganesh and Kartikay learn about Usha and Aniruddha's reincarnation. Mahadev names Usha Behula. Diti and Vasuki fail to build Manasa's faith in the gods. Manasa visits Kailash in search of some answers. She meets Parvati, who is shocked by the extent of Manasa's hatred.

videos.title: Parvati gets furious at Manasa
videos.overview: Manasa is disappointed with Mahadev for not protecting her and Rishi Halahal. Mahadev and Parvati try to make her realise that she is responsible for his death. Parvati and Diti ask her to leave Kailash. While Mahadev sympathises with Manasa, Parvati wonders if she deserves another chance.

videos.title: Manasa shows disrespect
videos.overview: Parvati remains annoyed with Manasa. Vasuki and Diti try convincing Manasa that she should respect Mahadev. However, Manasa shows her hatred for Mahadev and Parvati by stopping people from worshiping them. Later, Parvati gets annoyed with Mahadev when he grants a wish to his devotee, Bhilni.

videos.title: Parvati tests Mahadev's loyalty
videos.overview: Parvati disguises herself as Bhilni to test Mahadev. Mahadev praises her for serving him delicious food and taking care of him. Parvati gets annoyed, but continues testing him. While the Asuras kill innocent people, Manasa provokes them to fight and protect themselves.

videos.title: Manasa's hatred for Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev decides to stay with Bhilini (Parvati) forever. Parvati is sad about it and decides to put Mahadev through a final test. Meanwhile, Manasa continues to show her hatred for Mahadev. She rescues innocent people from the Asuras and then prevents them from worshipping the gods.

videos.title: Manasa misleads the devotees
videos.overview: Manasa decides to protest against Mahadev in Kailash. She misleads his devotees and takes them with her. Mahadev is with Bhilni, but his mind is occupied by Manasa's actions. He tells Bhilni to let him go, but she refuses to do so.

videos.title: Manasa protests against Mahadev
videos.overview: Manasa gathers Mahadev's devotees in Kailash to protest against him. Ganesh handles Manasa and tries to clear her doubts about Mahadev. Parvati tries to do the same, but in vain. Meanwhile, Mahadev promises to grant Bhilni's wish after returning from Kailash.

videos.title: Mahadev decides to test Manasa
videos.overview: Mahadev's devotees apologise to him for losing faith. He tries to clear Manasa's misunderstandings, but she wishes to be worshipped as a goddess. He agrees to allow it, but only if she passes a test. After this, Mahadev tells Parvati that he needs to go to Bhilni.

videos.title: Manasa goes to Chandradhar
videos.overview: As Parvati worries about losing Mahadev, he assures Bhilni that he will marry her. Manasa, meanwhile, goes to Chandradhar, Mahadev's most ardent devotee. She tries to make him her devotee, which he refuses.

videos.title: Parvati fears losing Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati loses her faith in Mahadev after he decides to marry Bhilni. Does this mean Mahadev will have two wives? Meanwhile, Manasa tries to force Chandradhar to become her devotee. She threatens to attack his sons if he doesn't do her bidding.

videos.title: Manasa kills Chandradhar's sons
videos.overview: Parvati admits to Mahadev how she had tested him. He makes her realise that he was aware of her intentions all the time. Manasa gets angry at Chandradhar for refusing to become her devotee and kills his sons.

videos.title: Manasa's warning
videos.overview: Chandradhar and his wife are lost in grief after Manasa kills their sons. Manasa insists that Chandradhar should become her devotee, else she will kill Lakshmi Chandra. On Lord Brahma's advice, Ganesh vows to take care of Lakshmi Chandra by getting him married to Behula.

videos.title: Manasa's atrocities continue
videos.overview: On hearing about Manasa's atrocities against the brothers of Lakshmi Chandra, Behula consoles him. Meanwhile, Diti and Vasukhi forbid Manasa from attacking Lakshmi Chandra. Mahadev is impressed with Chandradhar's devotion. Lakshmi Chandra and Behula get married.

videos.title: Manasa poisons Lakshmi Chandra
videos.overview: While Behula strives to protect Lakshmi Chandra from Manasa, Mahadev condemns Manasa for misusing her power. On Manasa's insistence, Behula tries to persuade Chandradhar to become her devotee. An angry Manasa attacks Lakshmi Chandra by injecting poison into him.

videos.title: Behula prays to Mahadev
videos.overview: While Nandi and Kartikay worry about Behula, Mahadev and Parvati perform sadhana to pacify Manasa. Despite Diti and Vasuki's attempts to stop her, Manasa is adamant on making Chandradhar her devotee. As Behula worships Mahadev to heal Lakshmi Chandra, Manasa tries to distract her.

videos.title: Mahadev visits Chandradhar
videos.overview: While taunting Behula, Manasa insists that Chandradhar should become her devotee. Chandradhar and Behula's prayers are answered and Mahadev appears before them. Manasa boasts about her power, but is unable to rid Lakshmi Chandra’s body of the poison.

videos.title: Manasa becomes a goddess
videos.overview: A repentant Manasa is enlightened about devotion by Mahadev. She apologises to him and Chandradhar and heals Lakshmi Chandra. She also seeks redemption from Parvati. In return, she is blessed by Mahadev and Parvati to be worshipped as a goddess.

videos.title: Brahma rebukes Saraswati
videos.overview: Mahadev helps Parvati overcome her grief and they are felicitated by the Shivgans and Rishis. Meanwhile, a defeated Indradev is challenged by Pururava. At the same time, Saraswati is saddened when Lord Brahma rebukes her for praising Pururava. Saraswati decides to become a recluse.

videos.title: Gyan Murti insults Saraswati
videos.overview: King Durdumb decides to punish his Mahamantri and his son. Mahadev condemns Acharya Gyan Murti for disrespecting Saraswati. Meanwhile, Acharya Gyan Murty supports Durdumb's torture of innocent citizens. Ganesh and Kartikay decide to take action against them.

videos.title: Mahadev in Durdumb's kingdom
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati decide to help Saraswati. Incognito, they enter Durdumb's kingdom to fight against the atrocities there. Mahadev rescues some children from Durdumb's soldiers. The citizens are motivated by Mahadev to rise against Durdumb.

videos.title: Mahadev rescues the parents
videos.overview: The parents of Gangey and Uma thank Mahadev and Parvati for rescuing them from the soldiers. The parents tell them more about Durdumb's atrocities. Meanwhile, Acharya Gyan Murty continues to support the misdeeds of Durdumb.

videos.title: Gyan Murty punishes the learned
videos.overview: While Gyan Murty decides to proscribe education and punish the intellectuals, Mahadev motivates Taranath and the acharyas to fight Gyan Murty and Durdumb. As Mahadev enlightens the citizens, Gyan Murty decides to punish him for disregarding his decree.

videos.title: Saraswati is pacified
videos.overview: The enlightened students of Mahadev sing Saraswati Vandana to pacify her. Gyan Murty accuses Mahadev of going against his decree and decides to punish him by death. Mahadev challenges Gyan Murty to shastrartha and vows to open a gurukul for his students.

videos.title: Parvati motivates the women
videos.overview: Parvati condemns King Durdumb for humiliating women. She motivates the women to fight against him. An enraged Durdumb orders Gyan Murty to punish Mahadev with Jal Samadhi. Will Gyan Murty succeed in his evil plans and can Durdumb overwhelm Mahadev?

videos.title: Gyan Murti attacks Durdumb
videos.overview: Gyan Murty falsely declares that he has won over Mahadev in shastrartha and wants to punish him. Durdumb declares Mahadev the winner and punishes Gyan Murty with Jal Samadhi. In retaliation, Gyan Murty, along with the Asuras, attacks Durdumb.

videos.title: Saraswati meets Gyan Murty
videos.overview: Gyan Murty atones for disrespecting Sarawati and worships her. Lord Vishnu and Brahma pacify Saraswati and she appears before Mahadev and Gyan Murty. Saraswati blesses Gyan Murty and expresses her gratitude to Mahadev. Meanwhile, the protesting women attack Durdumb's soldiers.

videos.title: Gayatri decides to kill Durdumb
videos.overview: An adamant Durdumb orders his soldiers and Asuras to attack the women and apprehend Gayatri, another form of Parvati. The women fight back and seek Adi Shakti's protection. The Asuras are slayed by Gayatri and she decides to punish Durdumb by death.

videos.title: Durdumb atones for his sins
videos.overview: Durdumb apologises for his sins and the women forgive him. Mahadev motivates him to follow the righteous path. Durdumb appoints Sumukh as his successor with Mahadev’s blessings. Taranath and Shilavanti thank Mahadev, who predicts the reincarnation of Shivansh.

videos.title: Andhaka praises Mahadev
videos.overview: Worried, the gods want to stop Shivansh's reincarnation, but Brihaspati stops them. Meanwhile, to the surprise of the Asuras, Andhaka pays tribute to Mahadev. Kartikay intervenes and forbids Andhaka from entering Kailash. He alerts Mahadev that Andhaka is seeking revenge for the death of his son.

videos.title: Andhaka is sorry
videos.overview: A repentant Andhaka apologises to Mahadev and Parvati for Adi's misdeeds. Kartikay forbids him to stay in Kailash, but Mahadev and Parvati allow him to be there. Indradev, in order to stop Shivansh's reincarnation, urges Natyacharya to master the Tandav from Mahadev.

videos.title: Lord Vishnu is suspicious
videos.overview: Both Andhaka and Natyacharya endeavour to impress Mahadev. Lord Vishnu's suspicions are aroused and on his advice, Parvati tries to stop Mahadev from teaching the Tandav to Natyacharya. Will Mahadev heed her warning?

videos.title: Lohitang is born
videos.overview: Despite Parvati's advice, Mahadev teaches Natyacharya the Tandav. Narad enlightens the gods about Mahadev's Tandav. Parvati joins Mahadev while he performs the dance. Later, Shivansh is reborn and is named Lohitang. Prithvi Devi and Mahadev bless him.

videos.title: Indradev is upset with Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev entrusts Andhaka with the care of Lohitang. Mahadev also blesses Natyacharya and condemns the Asuras. As a result, the Asuras vent their anger on Andhaka for accepting Mahadev's advice. Indradev and Kartikay are also upset with Mahadev for supporting Andhaka.

videos.title: Vishnu to be in Yoga Nidra
videos.overview: While Mahadev enlightens Parvati about Bali and Vamana, Lord Vishnu decides to lead his life in Yoga Nidra for some time. This worries Lord Brahma. Meanwhile, protesting against Andhaka for supporting the Devas, the Asuras decide to leave Patal Lok.

videos.title: Andhaka has a plan
videos.overview: Andhaka's grand design includes misleading Lohitang against Mahadev. This information upsets both Mahadev and Parvati. Meanwhile, Lord Vishnu entrusts the universe into the care of Lakshmi.

videos.title: Andhaka trains Lohitang
videos.overview: Indradev and Brihaspati are worried about Lord Vishnu's decision to lead his life in Yoga Nidra. Parvati requests the gods to cease hostilities with the Asuras and asks Mahadev to visit Patal Lok. Meanwhile, Andhaka is training Lohitang to fulfill a mission.

videos.title: Lohitang is made king
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Parvati, Indradev and Brihaspati about the evil designs of Andhaka and predicts the consequences. Meanwhile, Andhaka provokes Lohitang against Mahadev and appoints him the ruler of his kingdom.

videos.title: Lohitang targets the gods
videos.overview: Ganesha wants the gods and Asuras to co-exist in peace and seeks Mahadev's blessings for it. Lohitang, under the influence of Andhaka, misuses the power of his boon and provokes an Asura called Nikas to attack the gods.

videos.title: Mahadev blesses Kartikay
videos.overview: Kartikey vows to protect the deities from the Asuras and on Ganesha's advice, seeks Mahadev's permission to support the deities in a yagna. Mahadev warns them about the consequences. He is saddened when Kartikay criticises him for supporting Andhaka, but gives his blessings anyway.

videos.title: Lohitang learns about Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati informs Prithvi Devi about Andhaka misguiding Lohitang against Mahadev. Prithvi Devi showers Lohitang with compassion and enlightens him about Mahadev's greatness. He wishes to meet Mahadev. However, Andhaka asks him to focus on his training.

videos.title: Parvati hears the story of Jeevak
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens Parvati about a devotee, Jeevak, who turned into a demon after killing a holy man, Brihath. Jeevak now converts greedy people into demons. Meanwhile, Lohitang experiences serenity in Asur Lok, and wishes to stay away from Andhaka.

videos.title: Jeevak gets redemption
videos.overview: Adi's mother provokes Lohitang to act against Mahadev. However, Mahadev is able to pacify him. He offers redemption to Jeevak and some other demons. Will Jeevak apologise for his sins?

videos.title: Narad teaches music to Lohitang
videos.overview: Jeevak's men thank Mahadev. Meanwhile, Narad informs Kartikay about Prithvi Devi's concern for Lohitang and educates him in music and art. Lohitang also receives Narad's Veena. Dev Kampan is furious that Lohitang has refused to be his disciple.

videos.title: Andhaka ruins Indradev's yagna
videos.overview: Lord Brahma and Mahadev condemn the Asuras for misusing their powers, while Indradev and Brihaspati perform a yagna. Andhaka decides to ruin the yagna, and Lohitang learns about this. Andhaka plans to take Lakshmi with him to Patal Lok.

videos.title: Andhaka angers Mahadev
videos.overview: Lakshmi berates Andhaka for disrespecting Parvati. He, in turn, accuses Parvati and Mahadev of injustice against Adi and himself. Parvati reasons with him, but he orders her and Lakshmi to accompany him to Patal Lok. Mahadev is enraged.

videos.title: The end of Andhaka
videos.overview: Mahadev attacks Andhaka and he dies. Before dying, he asks Lohitang to avenge his death. Lohitang then vows to destroy Mahadev. Prithvi Devi tries to pacify him, but fails to calm him down.

videos.title: Lohitang vows revenge
videos.overview: Lohitang declares his hatred for Mahadev and vows to avenge Andhaka's death. Lohitang continues with his training under Dev Kampan, who wants him to discontinue his sadhana. Will Lohitang follow his advice?

videos.title: Lohitang completes his training
videos.overview: Indradev and Brihaspati succeed in acquiring Arthashastra to protect the gods, but Mahadev condemns the move. Indradev expresses his gratitude to Kartikay for his support. Meanwhile, Lohitang becomes powerful on completing his training under the tutelage of Dev Kampan.

videos.title: Lohitang takes on the gods
videos.overview: Prithvi Devi urges Lohitang to respect Mahadev, but it has no effect on him. He declares his hatred for Mahadev and Parvati. The Asuras felicitate Lohitang and he provokes them into fighting against Mahadev and the other gods. Will Lohitang become Raj Asur by destroying Mahadev?

videos.title: Tuhund gets a boon from Brahma
videos.overview: Tuhund becomes powerful after being granted a boon by Lord Brahma. He prepares to attack the Devas, who begin to worry. Dev Kampan enlightens Lohitang about Tuhund. Meanwhile, Kartikay is welcomed back to Kailash by his parents and he regrets disobeying Mahadev.

videos.title: Lohitang attacks Tuhund
videos.overview: Ganesha pacifies Kartikay, while Tuhund boasts about his powers to Lohitang. An enraged Lohitang attacks him and demonstrates his superiority. He asks Tuhund to support him in his war against the gods.

videos.title: Tuhund and Lohitang join hands
videos.overview: Tuhund agrees to support Lohitang. Mahadev forbids Indradev from using the Arthashastra against the Asuras. Brihaspati apologises to Mahadev for supporting Indradev. Meanwhile, Lohitang intends to utilise the powers of Bhandasur, even as Ganesha vows to counter him.

videos.title: Kartikay prepares for war
videos.overview: Kartikay seeks Mahadev's blessing and asks Ganesha to take care of Kailash before setting out for war. Bhandasur, meanwhile, is ready to fight the gods. Indradev confronts Brihaspati for siding with Mahadev, who enlightens Parvati about Bhandasur.

videos.title: Kartikay fights Lohitang
videos.overview: Accepting Lohitang's challenge, Kartikay fights him. Meanwhile, Mahadev predicts how the war will end and assures Parvati of Lohitang's defeat and atonement. Meanwhile, an emotional Ganesha recalls a past experience with Bhandasur.

videos.title: Bhandasur tries to enter Kailash
videos.overview: While Mahadev sympathises with Prithvi Devi, Tuhund attacks the gods and they fight back. Tuhund and Indradev take on each other and Kartikey engages Lohitang. Meanwhile, Bhandasur attempts to enter Kailash, only to be stopped by Ganesha.

videos.title: Bhandasur gets redemption
videos.overview: The rishis manage to pacify an angry Parvati. On Kartikay's advice, Indradev avoids deploying the Arthashastra and surrenders to Tuhund. Meanwhile, Ganesha makes Bhandasur realise his mistakes and offers him redemption. The rishis and Shivgans express their gratitude to Ganesha.

videos.title: Mahadev gives Lohitang a chance
videos.overview: An enraged Lohitang challenges Mahadev to a duel, but the lord condemns him for misguiding Tuhund and the Asuras. Mahadev offers him a chance to atone for his sins. Lohitang repents, while Indradev thanks Mahadev for protecting him.

videos.title: The story of Shankchur
videos.overview: Lohitang realises the magnitude of Mahadev's powers and regrets not doing justice to the cause of Andhaka and the Asuras. Meanwhile, Shankchur rescues Lohitang when Indradev's army attempts to kill him. Later, Mahadev enlightens Ganesha about Shankchur.

videos.title: Shankchur tends to Lohitang
videos.overview: Mahadev reveals to Ganesha that Shankchur was Sridhama in his previous birth. Indradev accuses his soldiers of failing him, while Shankchur takes care of a sick Lohitang. Prithvi Devi requests Mahadev to show his compassion for Lohitang and Mahadev asks Narad to heal him.

videos.title: Indradev misguides Shankchur
videos.overview: Mahadev holds a discussion with Narad and Parvati about Lohitang. Indradev conspires against Lohitang and Shankchur, which shocks Brihaspati. Indradev criticises Andhaka and misleads Shankchur about Lohitang. Will Lohitang rise up and attack Mahadev again?

videos.title: Prithvi Devi blesses Lohitang
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati condemn Indradev for his treachery. Lohitang alerts Shankchur about Indradev's conspiracy. Parvati enlightens the rishis about Anusuya Devi, while Prithvi Devi blesses Lohitang.

videos.title: Mahadev won't protect Indradev
videos.overview: Shankchur apologises to Lohitang for misunderstanding him and together, they plan to attack Indradev. Mahadev refuses to save Indradev because he disrespected Tulsi. Lohitang is shocked on learning about Shankchur and Tulsi's devotion to Lord Vishnu.

videos.title: Dev Kampan advises Lohitang
videos.overview: Lohitang prepares to attack Mahadev. He vents his anger in front of Dev Kampan, who enlightens him about Tridev. Lohitang refuses to believe in Tridev's powers. Dev Kampan advises him to meet Rishi Dadhichi's son Pippalada.

videos.title: Lohitang at Dadhichi's ashram
videos.overview: Pippalada reminds Mahadev about past incidents involving Rishi Dadhichi and praises him for renouncing the worldly life for the sake of humanity. Mahadev motivates Pippaladi to guide Lohitang. Meanwhile, Lohitang creates a nuisance at Rishi Dadhichi’s ashram.

videos.title: Pippalada enlightens Lohitang
videos.overview: Pippalada enlightens Lohitang and continues to worship the Shivaling. Indradev condemns Lohitang and suspects that he will seek the support of demons against Lord Vishnu. Pippalada enlightens Lohitang about the powers of Prakash Punj. Lohitang becomes eager to learn about Jyotirlinga.

videos.title: Lohitang has an evil plan
videos.overview: Pippalada tells Lohitang about Ravana and Jyotirlinga. Lohitang pretends to revere Mahadev, but intends to destroy Jyotirlinga. Ganesha discusses about Lohitang with Mahadev and he tries to clear his doubts. Shankchur prepares to attack Indradev and conquer Swarg Lok.

videos.title: Lohitang is set on vengeance
videos.overview: Mahadev asks Parvati not to worry about Lohitang. Shankchur is shocked to hear about Indradev’s plan to attack Nigas. Dev Kampan berates Lohitang for disrespecting Pippalada, while Lohitang vows justice for Andhaka. Pippalada enlightens Lohitang about Somnath and Chandrama.

videos.title: Mahadev makes a prediction
videos.overview: While Parvati continues to worry, Mahadev predicts that Lohitang will attack him. Lohitang informs Dev Kampan that Indradev had conspired to attack him and Shankchur. Pippalada enlightens Lohitang about Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga and Kartikey. Lohitang abuses Mahadev again, annoying Dev Kampan.

videos.title: Lohitang attacks Pippalada
videos.overview: Lohitang declares his hatred for Kartikay. Dev Kampan is upset by Lohitang's intention to harm Parvati. Meanwhile, Pippalada strives to clear Lohitang's doubts about Mahadev. He enlightens Lohitang about Nandi and Mahakleshwar Jyotirlinga. However, Lohitang's mind is set on revenge.

videos.title: Mahadev thanks Nandi
videos.overview: Dev Kampan berates Pippalada for hurting Lohitang's sentiments. Pippalada predicts that Lohitang's actions will have bad consequences. Mahadev, Parvati and Kartikay express their gratitude to Nandi. Dev Kampan consoles Lohitang, who vents his frustration on Mahadev.

videos.title: Story of Rameshwaram Jyotirlinga
videos.overview: Lohitang tries to prove his powers to Pippalada, who reasons with him to change his ways. Brihaspati informs Mahadev about the designs of Indradev. Pippalada enlightens Lohitang about Lord Vishnu's relationship with Mahadev and Ram, and about the establishment of Rameshwaram Jyotirlinga.

videos.title: Lohitang's lessons continue
videos.overview: Lohitang and Dev Kampan discuss about Lord Vishnu and Mahadev. Meanwhile, Brihaspati endeavours to save Nigas from Indradev. Pippalada enlightens Lohitang about Ghushmeshwar Jyotirlinga and perceives that Lohitang is not Mahadev's devotee.

videos.title: The story of Vindhya
videos.overview: Mahadev predicts Lohitang's future, while Pippalada narrates the significance of Omkareshwar to Lohitang. Pippalada tries to enlighten Lohitang about Mahadev's supremacy and how Vindhya, too, had abandoned his ego on learning about Mahadev.

videos.title: The significance of Om
videos.overview: Vindhya apologises to Mahadev for digressing from the path of truth, and Mahadev offers him redemption. He elucidates the importance of Tridev, Omkareshwar and Amleshwar to Vindhya. Meanwhile, Pippalada educates Lohitang on the significance of Om and Tridev.

videos.title: Indradev seeks support from Nigas
videos.overview: Lohitang fears leading the life of a recluse and is comforted by Prithvi Devi. She also convinces him about the power of Omkareshwar. Lohitang also wishes to learn about Ganga's relationship with Mahadev. Meanwhile, Indradev tries to get the Nigas to support him against Lohitang.

videos.title: Lohitang chants Om
videos.overview: Pippalada tells Lohitang how Mahadev had rescued Rishi Gautam and had asked him to worship Ganga. Meanwhile, Dev Kampan is angry with Lohitang for disobeying Pippalada. Dev Kampan learns that the chanting of Om is having a positive effect on Lohitang.

videos.title: Lohitang learns about Kedarnath
videos.overview: Narad wants Indradev to win despite his evil design and conveys this to Mahadev. Indradev again asks Nigas to support him. Lohitang wants to learn about the Jyotirlinga, established by a demon. Pippalada tells him about the demoness Daruka and enlightens him about Kedarnath and the story of Nar and Narayan.

videos.title: Lohitang is pleased with Nigas
videos.overview: Dev Kampan tells Lohitang about Narsimha's fight with Sarveshwar. Meanwhile, Brihaspati informs Indradev that Lohitang had sent Shankchur to help Nigas. Lohitang is delighted to know about Nigas' ability to swallow Lord Vishnu.

videos.title: Dev Kampan agrees to help
videos.overview: Pippalada warns Lohitang that he will not narrate the remaning Jyotirlings if he leaves the gurukul. Lohitang requests Dev Kampan to take his proposal to Nigas.
