He learns that Bhimasur worshipped Brahma for a boon. But Pippalada informs him later that Bhimasur imprisoned Kamrupeshwar.

videos.title: Nigas refuses Lohitang's plan
videos.overview: Pippalada informs Lohitang that Mahadev had established Bhimashankar on Kamrupeshwar’s request. Meanwhile, Nigas tells Dev Kampan that Mahadev has protected him from Indradev’s immortality. Dev Kampan speaks about Lohitang’s proposal but Nigas refuses it. What will Lohitang do?

videos.title: Lohitang's dilemma
videos.overview: Pippalada informs Lohitang that Mahadev established Jyotirling in Manikarnika. Lohitang informs Pippalada of giving him gurudakshina by sparing his life. He tells Dev Kampan that he has learned about the Jyotirlings and he will convince Nigas. How will Lohitang convince them?

videos.title: Nigas agrees to swallow Vishnu
videos.overview: Lohitang decides to divert Mahadev’s attention from Lord Vishnu with the help of Shankhchur. He lies to Nigas and orders them to swallow Lord Vishnu using his boon. Indradev learns of the plan and informs Rishi Brihaspati that he wants to stop the disaster from happening. Will he succeed?

videos.title: Nigas refuse to believe Indradev
videos.overview: Lohitang informs Shankhchur to attack Indradev and also tells him that the Nigas have agreed to swallow Lord Vishnu. Meanwhile, Indradev informs Nigas about Lohitang’s intention of destroying Mahadev. He convinces the Nigas that Lohitang is taking advantage of his powers, but in vain.

videos.title: Parvati warns Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev informs Ganesh about his role in the battle between Indradev and Shankhchur. Meanwhile, Indradev informs Shankhchur that he will surrender to him if he kills Nigas. Shankhchur informs Indradev that he will have to follow his orders if he wins the battle. Who will win the battle?

videos.title: Nigas swallows Lord Vishnu
videos.overview: Mahadev, Lord Brahma and Parvati try to calm Goddess Laxmi. Meanwhile, Mahadev tries to make Lohitang realise his mistakes. Indradev requests Mahadev to protect him from Shankhchur. In the meantime, Nigas swallows Lord Vishnu. Will Lohitang realise his mistakes?

videos.title: Kartikey is furious at Lohitang
videos.overview: Parvati tries to calm Kartikey who is furious with Lohitang for insulting Mahadev. She informs Kartikey about Mahadev fulfilling Lord Vishnu’s responsibilities. Meanwhile, Nigas informs Mahadev that he has fulfilled his duties as his devotee. Indradev vows to destroy Mahadev.

videos.title: Shankhchur becomes king
videos.overview: Lohitang is delighted as Indradev fails to conspire against him and Shankhchur. Indradev surrenders and relinquishes Swarg Lok to Lohitang, who appoints Shankhchur as the King of Swarg Lok. Meanwhile, Nigas apologises to Mahadev for his misdeed.

videos.title: Narad criticises Lohitang
videos.overview: Shankhchur decides to undertake the responsibilities of Swarg Lok. Meanwhile, Narad makes Lohitang realise Mahadev’s compassion for him. Parvati becomes furious at Lohitang for his misdeed. Lohitang decides to create chaos in Kashi. Will he succeed?

videos.title: Kartikey vows to fight Lohitang
videos.overview: Lohitang is adamant on destroying Kashi. He vows to Tulsi to take care of Shankhchur. Shankhchur instructs the deities to follow the new rules.  Meanwhile, Parvati alerts Ganesh and Kartikey about Lohitang’s plan against Mahadev. Therefore, Kartikey decides to fight Lohitang. Will he win the fight?

videos.title: Tridevi protest against Lohitang
videos.overview: Mahadev is occupied in performing sadhana for Lord Vishnu’s sake. Meanwhile, Lord Brahma is elated on learning about Kashi’s destruction. Kartikey fights Lohitang for the welfare of Kashi, while Ganesh protects the citizens of Kashi from Lohitang. Who will win the battle?

videos.title: Lohitang vows to attack Mahadev
videos.overview: The deities are elated when Dattatreya appears in front of them. Narad captivates Dattatreya with his devotion. Mahadev offers his blessings to fulfill his responsibilities. Meantime, Mahadev tries to bring Lohitang on the right path. Nevertheless, Lohitang vows to destroy him.

videos.title: Lohitang learns of Dattatreya
videos.overview: Lord Brahma makes Kartikey aware of Lohitang’s intention against Jyotirlinga and Mahadev. But Mahadev is worried about Lohitang’s resentment towards him, and witnesses his sufferings. Pippalada explains about Dattatreya’s powers to Lohitang. Nigas atones for his sin by worshipping the Shiv-Ling.

videos.title: Lohitang protects Shankhchur
videos.overview: Prithvi Devi strives to protect Lohitang from devastation, and tries to make him realise his mistake. Pushpadant and Indradev plan to kill Shankhchur. Lohitang protects Shankhchur and attacks Indradev, but fails to kill him. Will Lohitang be defeated?

videos.title: Mahadev offers redemption
videos.overview: Mahadev assures Nigas of his innocence. Nigas decides to sacrifice his life for Lord Vishnu’s welfare. Lord Vishnu returns to the deities and Mahadev offers redemption to Nigas. The deities protest against Shankhchur and Lord Vishnu orders him to surrender. How will he make Shankhchur surrender?

videos.title: Shankhchur wants Kailash
videos.overview: Dev Kampan alerts Shankhchur and Lohitang to be careful of the deities. Shankhchur refuses to surrender in front of the deities and vows to attack Mahadev in order to conquer Kailash. Kartikey decides to fight against Shankhchur for holding back the deities’ freedom.

videos.title: Prithvi Devi condemns Lohitang
videos.overview: Lohitang assures Tulsi that he will stop Shankhchur from fighting. Meanwhile, the deities and the asuras battle it out. Ganesha and Shivgans defeat Shankhchur’s army. Later, Prithvi Devi condemns Lohitang for disrespecting Mahadev. What will Lohitang do?

videos.title: Lohitang misuses power of music
videos.overview: The deities warn Shankhchur to surrender before them. But Shankhchur still decides to fight Mahadev. On Mahadev’s advice, Parvati transforms into Kali to defeat Shankhchur. In the meantime, Lohitang misuses the power of music to destroy Mahadev. Will Lohitang succeed?

videos.title: Shankhchur fights the deities
videos.overview: Dev Kampan urges Lohitang to fight Mahadev using the power of music. Meanwhile, Kartikey challenges Shankhchur in the battlefield and Ganesh offers him a final chance to surrender. Parvati transforms herself into Kali and destroys Shankhchur. Later, the deities try to pacify Kali.

videos.title: Mahadev succeeds in calming Kali
videos.overview: Dev Kampan stops Lohitang from fighting against the deities. Meanwhile, Mahadev succeeds in placating Kali. Shankhchur challenges Parvati to defeat him. Lord Vishnu insists Shankhchur to hand over Tulsi’s suraksha kavach and surrender. Will Shankhchur surrender?

videos.title: Redemption for Shankhchur
videos.overview: Shankhchur accuses Lord Vishnu and Mahadev of deceiving him and attacks Mahadev in front of the deities. Mahadev destroys Shankhchur out of anger. Meantime, Lohitang condemns Lord Vishnu for his injustice against Tulsi and vows to destroy Mahadev. Will Lohitang succeed?

videos.title: Tulsi is angry at Lord Vishnu
videos.overview: Tulsi is tormented to see Shankchur’s dead body. She confronts Lohitang for not protecting him. Lord Vishnu vows to free Tulsi from grief but she vents her anger on Lord Vishnu. Meanwhile, Lohitang curses Mahadev and Lord Vishnu for destroying Shankhchur.

videos.title: Lord Vishnu offers redemption to Tulsi
videos.overview: A bereaved Tulsi continues to believe that Lord Vishnu destroyed Shankhchur but she expiates for cursing Lord Vishnu after he elucidates his concern for Shankhchur to her. On Tulsi's request, Lord Vishnu offers her redemption. Tulsi's death traumatises Lohitang. How will he deal with losing Tulsi?

videos.title: Lohitang mourns Tulsi's death
videos.overview: Lohitang mourns Tulsi's death and vows to destroy Mahadev with the power of Tandava. Aware of Lohitang's intentions, Mahadev and Parvati set out to tame him. Meanwhile, Prithvi Devi fails to placate Lohitang. Will Lohitang realise Prithvi Devi's pain and take heed of her words?

videos.title: The deities condemn Lohitang's negativity
videos.overview: Prithvi Devi elucidates Mahadev’s omnipotence to Lohitang. For the welfare of Lohitang, Pippalada strives to guide him on the right path. But Lohitang is fixated on the idea of fighting against Mahadev. Will Lohitang be able to recognise his folly before it’s too late?

videos.title: Lohitang challenges Mahadev and the deities
videos.overview: Prithvi Devi regrets on failing to placate Lohitang. Lohitang, with an intention of destroying Mahadev, proceeds towards Kailash. He challenges Mahadev and the deities, in the battle field. What will the consequences of the war be?

videos.title: Lohitang and Mahadev's tandava
videos.overview: Lohitang's aggressive attitude against Mahadev reaches its extreme. He applies the power of music to attack Mahadev and the deities, which leads to destruction in the universe. Prithvi Devi fails to placate them, and loses her consciousness. Will Lohitang be tamed?

videos.title: Mahadev placates Lohitang
videos.overview: Despite several attempts, Lohitang fails to attack Mahadev. The miraculous power of Mahadev's damaru placates Lohitang, who in a state of bereavement, recalls Andhaka, Shankhchur and Tulsi. Mahadev continues to try and eliminate Lohitang’s negativity. Will Lohitang expiate for his sins?

videos.title: Mahadev enlightens Lohitang
videos.overview: Mahadev enlightens Lohitang of Prithvi Devi’s greatness and her affection for Lohitang, who then apologises to Mahadev, Prithvi Devi and other deities for his transgressions. Will Lohitang be offered redemption after what he did?

videos.title: Kailash is at peace
videos.overview: The war comes to a halt. Kailash is tranquil and serene. Menavati and Himavan worry about Parvati's well-being. A premonition leaves Parvati teary-eyed. What did Parvati see happening in the future?

videos.title: Parvati has a premonition
videos.overview: Parvati is elated when Menavati and Himavan visit Kailash. Mahadev endeavours to commiserate with Parvati but Parvati is troubled by a premonition. Ganga warns Kronch to not cause destruction but he challenges her instead. Will Ganga succeed in stopping Kronch’s barbarous acts?

videos.title: Kronch boasts of his power
videos.overview: The deities strive to stop Kronch from causing destruction, while Kronch goes on a rampant display of his power. On Ganga's insistence, Mahadev allows her to fight against Kronch's atrocities. Will Ganga be able to stop Kronch?

videos.title: Kronch teams up with Banasur
videos.overview: Kartikey and many sages attend Mahadev’s sermon. Meanwhile, Kronch teams up with Banasur to destroy Himavan, but Vaani opposes their decision. Mahadev foresees Kronch’s destruction and sympathises with Rishi Agastya. What will Kronch bring upon himself by meddling with Rishi Agastya?

videos.title: Parvati leaves Kailash
videos.overview: Parvati leaves Kailash for the welfare of Menavati and Himavan. Indradev intends to mislead Kronch but Kronch discovers his true intentions. Banasur encourages Kronch to attack Himavan. Parvati protests against Kronch and warns him to not cause destruction. Will Kronch take heed of Parvati’s words?

videos.title: Parvati warns Kronch
videos.overview: Parvati warns Kronch that he will have to fight against her if he attacks Himavan. She condemns Banasur for misusing Mahadev's power, while Banasur aims to rule over the universe and challenges Parvati. Will Kronch take heed of Parvati’s words or risk his well-being?

videos.title: Kartikey to fight against Kronch
videos.overview: Banasur misleads Kronch, and is keen to become the King of the Himalayas. Meanwhile, Menavati and Parvati are annoyed with Kronch, who challenges Himavan in the battlefield. Kartikey decides to fight against Kronch to get justice for Himavan and Parvati. What will the consequences of the war be?

videos.title: Kartikey destroys Kronch
videos.overview: Rishi Agastya fails to take back his curse on Kronch. Kartikey offers a chance to Kronch to surrender before Himavan but he refuses. Eventually, Kartikey fights Kronch and succeeds at destroying him. Banasur intends to attack Himavan to rule the Himalaya. Will he succeed in his endeavour?

videos.title: Menavati is traumatised
videos.overview: Kronch's death traumatises Menavati and she condemns Banasur for misguiding Kronch. Kartikey is dejected on witnessing Menavati's condition. Parvati and Mahadev sympathise with him. On Menavati's insistence, Parvati vows to destroy Banasur. Will she be able to leave Mahadev?

videos.title: Parvati departs from Mahadev
videos.overview: Parvati's departure leaves Mahadev feeling dejected. Lord Vishnu says that Parvati has to be reborn as a virgin teenage girl to destroy Banasur. He decides to organise a yagya. Mahadev leads a reclusive life and engrosses himself in sadhana. Will Lord Vishnu make the yagya successful?

videos.title: Parvati is reborn as Kumari
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu succeeds in organising the yagya with the support of the saints. Parvati is now reborn as Kumari. Banasur fails to stop the yagya and sets out to destroy Kumari. Lord Vishnu advices Kumari's parents to distract Kumari's attention from Mahadev. Will they follow Lord Vishnu's advice?

videos.title: Vaani condemns Banasur
videos.overview: Vaani condemns Banasur for his misdeed. Mahadev and Parvati's families interact with Kumari. On Lord Brahma's advice, Lord Vishnu makes Kumari his disciple. Banasur insists that the virgin teenage girls get married at the earliest opportunity. What will the consequences be?

videos.title: Nandi’s inspiration for marriage
videos.overview: Nandi narrates the story of how Mahadev and Parvati inspired him to get married. He gets upset on recalling Mahadev's reclusive life. Meanwhile, Kumari is eager to know about her marriage. Will she learn that she was Parvati in her previous life?

videos.title: Kumari focuses on training
videos.overview: Kumari seeks Guru Pratyaya’s guidance for enlightenment about Rudraksha. Guru Pratyaya foresees Banasur's destruction. He and Murugan train Kumari to fight against Banasur, while Natesh guides Kumari in crafting. Will Banasur succeed in getting Kumari married against her will?

videos.title: Kumari saves girls from trouble
videos.overview: Banasurs army tortures teenage girls and tries to get them married against their will. However, Kumari, Natesh, Nandi and Murugan fight against them and save the girls. Mahadev deputes Bhoothnath to stop the injustice. Banasur intends to challenge Bhoothnath.

videos.title: Kumari remains outraged
videos.overview: Banasur sets out to attack Adi Shakti, and desperately searches for her. Meanwhile, Kumari remains outraged and Lord Vishnu tries to placate her. Despite being defeated by Bhoothnath, Banasur boasts of his power and declares himself as the supreme being. Will Banasur’s ego be snubbed?

videos.title: Kumari reminisces about Mahadev
videos.overview: Under Lord Vishnu's guidance, Devi Lakshmi gives dancing lessons to Kumari in order to placate her. However, Kumari is lost in thought about Mahadev which disturbs Lord Vishnu. Lord Vishnu expects Kumari to focus on her mission. Will Kumari live up to Lord Vishnu's expectations?

videos.title: Banasur's ill-intentions
videos.overview: Kumari continues to think of Mahadev. In a desperate state, she insists that Guru Pratyaya speak of Mahadev to her. Banasur attempts to misguide Kumari and her parents regarding Shiv and Shakti. He intends to get Kumari married to someone of his choice. Will Banasur be able to accomplish his mission?

videos.title: Kumari's devotion to Mahadev
videos.overview: Guru Pratyaya enlightens Kumari about the power of Mahadev and the significance of Shiv and Shakti. Meanwhile, Kumari's parents are dejected, thinking about Banasur. Kumari is adamant about marrying Mahadev. Will Guru Pratyaya be able to divert Kumari's attention from Mahadev?

videos.title: Kumari decides to marry Mahadev
videos.overview: Kumaris devotion to Mahadev makes her anxious to marry him and the deities are distressed to witness it. Meanwhile, Banasur intends to establish close proximity between Shiv and Shakti. Kumaris prayers distract Mahadev from his sadhana.

videos.title: Kumari awaits Mahadev’s arrival
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu stops Mahadev from meeting Kumari. Meanwhile, Kumari desperately expects Mahadev to meet her. Mahadev, in disguise, motivates Kumari to destroy Banasur. Will Kumari perform her duty for the welfare of the universe?

videos.title: Kumari destroys Banasur
videos.overview: Banasur attempts to mislead Kumari about Mahadev, but Kumari succeeds in destroying Banasur. Later, glimpses of her past occur to her in a flash and she transforms back into Parvati. A serene atmosphere is established in the universe and the deities are relieved. Will Parvati meet Mahadev?

videos.title: Ganesh is blessed with two babies
videos.overview: Ganesh is blessed with two babies. Parvati names the babies Kshema and Labha. Mahadev comes out of meditation and advises Ganesh about how to be a good father. Meanwhile, Mahadevs devotees decides to worship Mahadev. How will they do so?

videos.title: Mahdev enlightens about unity
videos.overview: Devotees belonging to different communities worship Mahadev.  Mahadev tells that the greatest devotion to him is to help the needy and distressed. He enlightens about unity and diversity, which leaves the devotees delighted.
